items.description: Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential. We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy. Position Overview The Data Architect will define and lead the enterprise data architecture for Cordance Commerce, with primary responsibility for unifying reporting platforms, data models, and analytics capabilities across Solutions, Secure Retail, Upright, and Pearl Dive. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who can turn fragmented operational data and customer-specific reporting into a scalable, governed, and reliable data platform. The role partners closely with Database Administrators, Business Intelligence professionals, Engineering, Product, Finance, Customer Success, and business leaders. The Data Architect will establish a practical migration strategy that separates analytical workloads from transactional systems, protects product performance, preserves critical customer reporting, and enables a trusted source of data across the portfolio. Key Responsibilities Own the target-state data architecture and roadmap for a unified reporting and analytics platform across Cordance Commerce products. Assess current transactional databases, data pipelines, reporting tools, standard BI reports, and customer-specific reports; document dependencies, duplication, performance risks, and migration constraints. Define a shared enterprise data model, canonical business definitions, master-data strategy, and system-of-record ownership for core entities such as customer, item, store, employee, transaction, inventory, donation, processing, and e-commerce activity. Design the separation of transactional and analytical workloads using fit-for-purpose patterns such as a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse; evaluate platforms including Snowflake and recommend the appropriate solution based on scale, security, cost, operability, and business needs. Create the phased migration strategy for consolidating reporting from Solutions, Secure Retail, Upright, and Pearl Dive while maintaining business continuity and customer commitments. Develop patterns and standards for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, semantic models, APIs, data quality, lineage, metadata, retention, archival, and observability. Partner with BI professionals to rationalize the Solutions standard report catalog and reduce the support burden created by hundreds of Secure Retail customer-specific reports through reusable datasets, governed self-service analytics, and configurable reporting patterns. Guide DBAs and engineering teams on database architecture, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL modernization, replication or change-data-capture patterns, performance isolation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness. Establish data governance practices covering data ownership, access controls, privacy, security, auditability, quality thresholds, and change management. Lead technical discovery, architecture reviews, proofs of concept, and vendor evaluations; translate findings into actionable designs, sequencing, estimates, risks, and investment recommendations. Provide hands-on technical guidance to delivery teams, review implementation designs, and ensure new product capabilities align with the target architecture instead of creating additional data silos. Enable trusted enterprise dashboards and cross-product reporting that support operational, customer, financial, and executive decision-making. Competencies: Enterprise Data Architecture: Converts complex, fragmented data estates into pragmatic target-state architectures and phased roadmaps. Technical Depth: Designs modern warehouses or lakehouses, dimensional and relational models, pipelines, semantic layers, and reporting platforms. Business Translation: Connects architecture decisions to customer value, product performance, operational efficiency, and measurable business outcomes. Data Governance: Establishes clear ownership, definitions, lineage, quality, security, and lifecycle controls without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. Migration Leadership: Plans incremental transitions that protect customer reporting and production stability while retiring duplication and technical debt. Influence and Collaboration: Builds alignment across DBAs, BI, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders. Ownership: Drives decisions through implementation, manages ambiguity, and remains accountable for platform adoption and results. AI and Analytics Readiness: Designs governed, reusable data foundations suitable for advanced analytics and AI-enabled workflows. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years of experience in data engineering, database architecture, analytics engineering, or business intelligence, including 3+ years in a data architecture or senior technical leadership role. Demonstrated experience designing enterprise data warehouses, lakehouses, or analytical platforms and migrating data from multiple operational systems. Strong data-modeling expertise across conceptual, logical, and physical models, including dimensional modeling and normalized transactional designs. Hands-on proficiency with SQL, relational databases, ETL/ELT patterns, orchestration, data quality, metadata, lineage, and BI semantic models. Experience separating reporting workloads from high-volume transactional systems and designing for performance, resilience, scalability, and cost control. Experience with cloud data platforms and modern data integration patterns, including APIs, replication, and change data capture. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present architecture decisions and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with Snowflake and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Experience with PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL, including modernization or migration initiatives. Experience consolidating reporting platforms following acquisitions or across a multi-product SaaS portfolio. Experience rationalizing large libraries of standard and customer-specific reports and enabling governed self-service analytics. Familiarity with retail, point-of-sale, inventory, e-commerce, donation, or thrift/resale data domains. Knowledge of data privacy, security, role-based access, audit, retention, and compliance practices. Experience enabling machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI use cases through governed enterprise data products. Relevant cloud, Snowflake, data-management, or architecture certification is a plus. What We Offer Work with a mission-driven team building impactful software solutions for the thrift and resale industry. Opportunity to shape shared technology capabilities across a growing portfolio of commerce products. Collaborative culture that values innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and transparency. Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for career growth. Success Measurements Architecture & Roadmap Completes an agreed current-state assessment and target-state architecture covering all Commerce reporting platforms and critical data domains. Delivers an approved, sequenced migration roadmap with clear dependencies, costs, risks, and ownership. Unified Data & Reporting Establishes common business definitions and governed data models that are adopted by reporting and product teams. Reduces duplicated datasets and one-off reporting solutions while preserving priority customer capabilities. Enables reliable cross-product operational and executive reporting from trusted data sources. Performance, Reliability & Quality Moves resource-intensive analytics away from transactional systems where appropriate and measurably reduces reporting-related production impact. Implements measurable data-quality, freshness, lineage, observability, and recovery standards for critical data products. Migration & Adoption Achieves agreed migration milestones without material disruption to customer reporting or operational workflows. Builds strong adoption among DBAs, BI professionals, engineers, business users, and product stakeholders. Governance & Cost Effectiveness Establishes accountable data ownership and access controls for priority domains. Provides transparent platform usage and cost metrics and demonstrates progress toward a scalable, supportable reporting model. Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies. Why Join Us? At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance: Health and Wellness: Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment. Retirement Savings: 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested. RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested. Paid Time Off: Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life. Parental Leave: 12 weeks paid leave for all employees. Remote Work Support: Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely. Holidays: Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones. Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one! If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Our customers, who include marketers, researchers, HR teams, and nonprofits, rave about how quick and easy it is to use Tremendous — check the ratings on G2 . Yet there’s a lot of complexity under the hood, including over 2,500 redemption options and plenty of banking infrastructure. This duality makes working here a fun challenge. Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. Join us before our next international offsite. About the role We are hiring an experienced data analyst to partner across our go-to-market teams (Sales, RevOps, Marketing, and Customer Success) and connect the full revenue funnel from acquisition through retention. Tremendous values data as a first-class citizen and believes insights unlock significant growth. You will collaborate closely with the data team and company-wide stakeholders. What you'll do Apply a range of analytics methods to gain insights across our go-to-market teams (sales, RevOps, marketing, and customer success), such as conversion funnels and attribution. Consolidate diverse facts and findings into compelling narratives that can be applied across Tremendous. Advocate for data-informed decisions by partnering with key stakeholders and senior leaders. Identify and implement improvements within the Data team by standardizing processes, developing innovative practices, providing mentorship, and fostering new expertise. Join a growing team of analysts and actively contribute to team collaboration and culture. What you'll bring You have extensive experience with B2B GTM analytics across some or all of marketing, sales, RevOps, and customer success, and you are familiar with the related tools. You write sophisticated SQL with a preference for well-architected data models, optimized query performance, and documented code. You are proficient with at least one visualization & business intelligence platform (e.g., Sigma, Tableau, Mode). Strong verbal and communication skills. You can articulate why something should be built a certain way and how it will impact the business. You expedite projects forward, favoring rapid and incremental development in parallel with problem-solving short-term obstacles. You employ a structured approach to handle ambiguous exploratory analysis, balancing thoroughness with the MVP mindset. You use data to achieve ambitious goals and influence company-level outcomes. Experience as a technical lead or manager is a plus. You use excellent judgment and sharp business and product instincts that allow you to prioritize. Bonus Experience with forecasting and predictive modeling. Experience with operational tools and systems like Segment, Amplitude and Hubspot (or other CRM tools). Experience with dbt, Fivetran or Census. Experience in Python or R. What's cool about the role Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $175k to $225k. Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave. Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook .

items.title: Technical Product Owner, Data
items.summary: ** This is an opportunity to join our top-notch product delivery team working closely together on interesting projects for our clients.
items.description: ** This is an opportunity to join our top-notch product delivery team working closely together on interesting projects for our clients. This position is fully remote (indefinitely).** Emergent Software is looking for a Technical Product Owner (Data) with 5+ years of experience leading requirements gathering and delivery efforts for data engineering, analytics, and business intelligence projects. You will work closely with clients, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to define priorities, manage backlogs, and deliver modern data solutions that drive measurable business value. This 100% remote role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, experience working on cloud-based data platforms, and a solid understanding of data warehousing, reporting, governance, and agile delivery practices. Highlights & Benefits of working at Emergent Software Work closely with other talented software engineers and analysts . Our vetting process means you can count on your team members to know what they are talking about. Work from home or work remotely from anywhere you want Flexible work schedule meaning you can work regular hours or whenever you work best Work-life balance is essential and highly valued at Emergent Software . If you choose to work more than 40 hours, you’ll be compensated for the extra work! Work on interesting projects solving complex business problems with custom software. 100 hours per year to focus on your professional development . We invest in your growth! Profit sharing bonus means as we’re successful, you’re successful Excellent benefits package including medical insurance, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, FSA, disability, life insurance, and paid parental leave Primary Duties Partner with clients to establish product vision and backlog Partner with clients to assist them in performing the Product Owner role In depth requirements gathering and analysis. Document requirements as Features and User Stories to share with team. Work with your team and client to create a plan for delivering on project objectives and achieving business value. Partner with technology teams to establish client technology roadmap Collaborate heavily with technology experts (architects and engineers) to vet requirements for technical feasibility. Speak with intelligence on technology topics to clients to establish trust and confidence. Partner with delivery teams to execute on established plans Communicate technical and business requirements to delivery team. Collaborate with senior delivery team members to solve complex challenges. Demonstrate strong understanding of custom software development concepts and best practices in all interactions. Ensure projects stay on target by regularly communicating status, risks, and change as they occur. Be a champion of the agile software development process Work directly with clients to manage project delivery while encouraging and fostering an agile delivery method. Apply agile concepts in real world settings, adapting principles to client’s level of agile sophistication and working to improve maturity over time. Own backlog health and communicate deviation to expected value delivery proactively. Act as a servant leader to your delivery team. Required Qualifications Product Ownership experience 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst on complex data engineering projects. Experience in delivering data engineering projects on modern cloud data platforms and familiarity with concepts around data warehousing, medallion architecture, Power BI, master data management, data governance, etc. Experience in crafting cost estimates to deliver components or entire projects. Strong technical writing, verbal communication, and presentation skills are a must. Experience operating as the liaison between agile development teams and users in defining requirements, performing business analysis, and driving delivery in the right direction. Technology knowledge Experience utilizing AI tools in product development, product delivery, or project management. A solid understanding of how websites, web applications, APIs, databases, and the cloud function at a high level. Strong technical background enabling you to provide credible leadership to development teams and accurately evaluate complex project risks and issues. Experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach Solid understanding of software development life cycle models including expert knowledge of Agile principles. Experience with agile work organization tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, Trello, Basecamp, Rally). A proven track record of successfully implementing custom web application projects using Agile methodologies. Experience with Traditional Project Management concepts Experience with scope, schedule, budget, and risk management Must be viewed as a trusted source of truth by stakeholders through consistent, transparent, and confident communication. Owns the narrative around project delivery, ensuring stakeholders are informed, aligned, and reassured throughout the lifecycle. Occasional travel to client sites may be requested for activities such as annual planning meetings. Although travel is not expected to be frequent, the ability to accommodate occasional travel is required. Nice to Have Experience Strong preference towards candidates with experience delivering projects to client expectations, especially in a consulting capacity, software as a service environment, or delivering AI-accelerated (agentic) solutions. Industry recognized Agile process certification (PMI-ACP, Scrum Alliance CSM or CSPO, Scrum.org PAL, SAFe, or equivalent) Industry recognized Project management certification (PMP or equivalent) Microsoft Azure technology certifications (AZ-900, DP-900, AI-900) Experience on projects utilizing Microsoft stack technologies such as .NET, SQL Server, and Azure as well as JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, and Vue.js Some examples of profiles/backgrounds that we feel would do well in this role: Scrum master turned product owner Independent consultant with previous experience on agile delivery teams (any role) Someone who is a product owner with a passion for the technical side of software development Our Vetting Process At Emergent Software , we work hard to find the best analysts capable of delivering high quality software for our clients. If you think you’re one of those, please understand that the effort put into this by people like yourself helps us be successful in surrounding you with other top-notch people. Here are the steps of our vetting process for this position: Application (5 minutes) Online Assessment (40-50 minutes) Initial Phone Interview & Technology Knowledge Assessment (45 minutes) Challenge Interview (75 minutes) Final Interview (90 minutes) Job Offer! Benefits Package Details Medical Insurance: up to 90% of your monthly medical premium (HSA options available) HSA Contribution: up to $200month Dental & Vision Insurance: up to 50% of your monthly dental and vision premium costs 401(k) plan: company match up to 4% of salary Profit sharing bonus: up to 15% of salary paid quarterly Extra compensation: get paid extra for work over 40 hours/week Employee referral & customer referral bonuses Flex Spending Account (FSA) for Dependent Care & Healthcare Costs Dependent Care FSA Contribution: $90/month Short Term Disability: $500/week for 12 weeks Long Term Disability: up to $6,000/month Group term life and AD&D insurance: $50k PTO, standard holidays, 2 floating holidays Paid parental leave: 2 weeks Staff development program: 100 hours/year plus training costs About Emergent Software Emergent Software is a fast-growing software development, cloud consulting, and data engineering company serving clients across the country. We are regularly adding to our team of talented software engineers, cloud architects, data engineers, UX designers, technical product owners and more who can help us deliver high quality services for our clients. We are a remote-first company Since our inception, we've embraced a remote-friendly culture, promoting work flexibility beyond the norm. When the pandemic struck in 2020, our transition to fully remote work was seamless—just a matter of cleaning out the fridge. Recognizing an opportunity, we adopted a remote-first approach and began hiring talent from anywhere. We continue to offer our signature Minnesota-nice, Midwest-friendly attitude, ensuring everyone feels valued, whether or not they're familiar with the skyway system. Your career grows with us Working with talented engineers on interesting projects creates an engaging environment for software development enthusiasts. By working directly with our experienced team, participating in our staff development program, and solving complex problems across a variety of projects, you’ll find numerous opportunities for long-term career growth. At Emergent Software , your ideas will be heard, you will grow exponentially as a master of your craft, and you will enjoy working other dedicated team members to deliver software solutions for our clients. Check out what others say Visit our Glassdoor page to discover how employees enjoy our remote working structure, flexible hours, profit sharing program, and more! #EmergentSoftware #IND5 Highlights In this role, you'll plan and deliver projects by understanding scope, cost, and timeline, while tracking progress and communicating status, risks, and changes. items.title: Finance Analyst
items.summary: We are looking for a highly analytical, technology-forward Senior Financial Analyst to help improve financial visibility, accountability, and predictability across a multi-location business.
items.description: We are looking for a highly analytical, technology-forward Senior Financial Analyst to help improve financial visibility, accountability, and predictability across a multi-location business. This is not a traditional accounting role. The ideal candidate can analyze individual branch P&Ls, reconcile expenses and allocations, identify inconsistencies and opportunities, build financial models, and transform financial and operational data into clear, actionable dashboards for leadership. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with P&Ls, developing advanced Excel models, investigating changes in branch profitability, and using AI and business intelligence tools to automate reporting and uncover insights. The goal is to provide leadership with better financial visibility to support faster, more informed decisions around operations, staffing, investments, and business growth. Key Responsibilities Branch P&L Management & Reconciliation Own the review and reconciliation of individual branch P&Ls. Partner with Accounting, Finance, Operations, and branch leadership to validate expenses, allocations, revenue, compensation, and other financial activity. Research and resolve discrepancies between expected and actual branch expenses. Create standardized processes for reviewing branch financials and identifying errors before they become recurring issues. Maintain clear documentation around expense allocations and financial assumptions. Develop monthly branch-level financial reporting that allows leadership to quickly understand: Revenue Direct and allocated expenses Payroll and compensation Cost per unit Revenue per unit Contribution margin Branch profitability Break-even production Budget vs. actual performance Month-over-month and year-over-year trends Financial Modeling & Decision Support Build dynamic financial models to help leadership evaluate business decisions before capital is committed. Develop models covering: Branch profitability and break-even analysis New location pro formas Recruiting and hiring economics Compensation scenarios Headcount and staffing models Production and revenue forecasting Fixed vs. variable cost analysis Marketing ROI Office and occupancy costs Margin sensitivity Volume and profitability scenarios Create scenario models to evaluate potential changes in production, staffing, compensation, expenses, and other business variables. Analyze the financial impact of business decisions and identify opportunities to improve profitability and resource allocation. Determine break-even points, potential risks, and expected returns for proposed investments or initiatives. Dashboards & Business Intelligence Design and maintain executive dashboards that turn complex financial information into simple, actionable insights. Develop branch scorecards that allow leadership to quickly identify: Top and bottom-performing branches Expense anomalies Margin compression Profitability trends Cost-per-unit trends Staffing efficiency Production changes Budget variances Emerging financial risks Integrate financial and operational data from multiple systems wherever possible to reduce manual reporting. Build dashboards designed for decision-making rather than simply data presentation. AI, Automation & Process Improvement Use AI tools to improve financial analysis, reporting, reconciliation, and forecasting. Identify repetitive financial processes that can be automated. Use modern AI tools to assist with: Data analysis Variance detection Financial modeling Dashboard development Data cleanup Reporting automation Trend identification Executive summaries Forecasting and scenario analysis Continuously evaluate new tools and technologies that can improve the speed and accuracy of financial reporting. Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to streamline workflows, improve data quality, and support more efficient financial decision-making. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise 5+ years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, corporate finance, accounting analytics, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role. Strong understanding of P&Ls, general ledger activity, expense allocations, accruals, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including complex formulas, financial models, scenario analysis, pivot tables, and large datasets. Experience building dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar business intelligence platforms. Strong working knowledge of AI tools and demonstrated ability to use AI to improve analytical or reporting workflows. Experience combining and analyzing information from multiple data sources. Ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable recommendations for executives and non-financial leaders. Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and challenge questionable data. Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Experience supporting multi-location, distributed, franchise, retail, or other organizations with branch- or unit-level financial reporting is highly preferred. Benefits Above market salary HMO on Day 1 for principal and two dependents Government-mandated benefits Performance-based Incentives Quarterly Company Events 1,000 PHP De Minimis Equipment and software provided Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Job Location: Remote About the Role:Sun King is seeking a high-impact GIS Specialist to significantly strengthen how geospatial insights inform our work across Africa.
items.description: Job Location: Remote About the Role: Sun King is seeking a high-impact GIS Specialist to significantly strengthen how geospatial insights inform our work across Africa. We have already established a strong foundation in using geospatial data to assess energy needs alongside our market reach. This role will build on that momentum by shaping our technology stack, sourcing high-quality data, and developing a reliable platform that enables the effective use of geospatial insights across the organisation. This role applies advanced spatial methods to inform key business areas, contributing to improved sales planning, operational effectiveness, policy engagement, and participation in subsidy programmes. The successful candidate brings strong GIS expertise within the energy sector, familiarity with African electrification and socio-demographic datasets, and experience developing production-ready GIS tools and platforms. Equally important is the ability to work across teams and ensure geospatial insights are meaningfully applied throughout the organisation. What you would be expected to do: Geospatial Infrastructure & Data Management Design, build, and maintain Sun King ’s internal geospatial data environment, consolidating electrification plans, socioeconomic datasets, grid maps, demographic layers, mobility data, and other spatial resources across markets. Develop and maintain geospatial databases with a strong focus on data quality, consistency, and ease of access. Integrate Sun King ’s proprietary data (sales performance, agent networks, customer locations, asset positions, and operational activity) into GIS platforms. Advanced Spatial Work & Business Integration Streamline GIS workflows and develop custom scripts to improve processing speed and efficiency. Work closely with Data & BI teams to incorporate GIS outputs into company dashboards and planning tools (for example, Tableau or Power BI). Develop or coordinate interactive, web-based visualisation platforms and layered GIS maps that combine demographic, economic, and infrastructure data for use by internal and external stakeholders. Partner with software development teams to integrate GIS data and market potential models into mobile applications used by field teams. Knowledge Exchange & Stakeholder Engagement Present complex spatial insights in clear, practical ways that enable action among non-technical teams. Enable internal teams to apply geospatial tools and outputs effectively in their work. Coordinate relationships with external GIS partners, research institutions, and data providers. You might be a strong candidate if you have: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geography, GIS, Remote Sensing, Data Science, Energy Planning, or a related field. Experience applying GIS within the energy sector, including electrification planning, grid expansion modelling, or off-grid market assessments. Experience working with open-source and/or commercial GIS platforms (such as ArcGIS, QGIS, or equivalent enterprise systems) for modelling, data management, and spatial work. Experience automating workflows using scripting languages, preferably Python (for example, GeoPandas and related libraries). Familiarity with visualisation and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau for incorporating spatial insights into organisational dashboards. Familiarity with African electrification and development datasets, including grid maps, electrification models, census data, night-time lights, demographic surveys (DHS, LSMS), and national energy plans. Experience contributing to end-to-end GIS systems that align with broader organisational workflows, including exposure to cloud-based data pipelines and APIs (such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud). The ability to work across teams and translate spatial insights into clear, usable outputs. Strong communication and storytelling skills, with an ability to use maps to convey engaging narratives. What Sun King offers: Professional growth in a dynamic, rapidly expanding, high-social-impact industry An open-minded, collaborative culture made up of enthusiastic colleagues who are driven by the challenge of innovation towards profound impact on people and the planet. A truly multicultural experience: you will have the chance to work with and learn from people from different geographies, nationalities, and backgrounds. Structured, tailored learning and development programs that help you become a better leader, manager, and professional through the Sun Center for Leadership. We place great importance on sustaining a diverse, inclusive work environment. We believe that innovation and understanding comes from diversity on every spectrum. We work to make sure every Sun King team member knows that they belong, knowing that sustaining an inclusive workplace requires conscious effort and is a continuous journey, not an end-state. Sun King recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes people based on their experience, skills, effort, and results. We explicitly prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, religion, caste, national origin, color, gender, marital status, family structure, sexual orientation, HIV/AIDS status, or disability. items.description: Who are we? At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk. We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface. We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. Our product is central to that next chapter. We're investing heavily in new products and features, with an exciting roadmap to keep building out UpGuard's best-in-class platform. In an era where third-party risk is more complex than ever, we maintain a highly collaborative, consultative culture that puts the customer's security posture above all else. Where does this role fit in? As UpGuard continues its rapid growth trajectory, we are seeking an experienced data scientist to support our Product team. Reporting to the Director of Analytics, this critical role is responsible for driving significant business value by quantifying product performance, illuminating what good engagement and adoption look like across the platform, and translating ambiguous product questions into durable data models and insights. This role will partner closely with Product Managers, Operations, Design, and Engineering to help the Product team define KPIs and milestones, understand what's working, and see how usage translates into retention and growth — while also acting as the interface between Product and Sales/CS to drive adoption of what's being built. This is an autonomous, lead role: you'll own product analytics end-to-end, supporting UpGuard's product portfolio across both established and emerging product lines. This is a ground-up build: the models and metric definitions this person creates will form the governed semantic layer that both humans and AI/agentic analytics tools query, so clarity and rigor in the modelling layer compounds directly into AI-enabled self-service. What will you do? Actionable Insight: Generate compelling and actionable insights from complex, multi-source product and usage data sets that directly inform roadmap prioritisation, feature investment, and engagement strategy. Stakeholder Engagement: Establish strong collaborative relationships with Product Managers, Operations, Design, Engineering and Success, delivering high-impact analytics initiatives that translate loose, evolving requirements into clear deliverables. KPI & Milestone Definition: Design, define, and maintain the product KPIs and engagement milestones for UpGuard – from activation and onboarding through to what "good" ongoing engagement looks like – and clearly communicate the trade-offs and assumptions behind each definition. Product & Feature Analytics: Develop a deep, first-principles understanding of the product funnel across onboarding, activation, feature adoption, and retention, and build the metrics, models, and dashboards that let PMs and feature owners self-serve their performance. Data Products: Partner with the data engineering team to design, construct, and maintain foundational product and usage data assets – translating loose product requirements into well-specified dbt models and a governed semantic/metrics layer that both humans and AI agents can reliably query and traverse. Business Intelligence: Partner strategically with Product stakeholders to provide robust self-service and conversational and agentic analytics capabilities, using design thinking principles to build user-friendly dashboards for engagement health, feature adoption, and activation performance. Deep Dive Analysis: Personally conduct thorough, hands-on, technical analysis to diagnose and solve the most significant product challenges – from onboarding drop-off and feature underperformance to engagement decay and churn risk. Commercial & Adoption Analysis: Act as the connective tissue between Product and Sales/CS, translating product usage and engagement signals into adoption plays, health scores, and expansion/renewal risk signals in ways that Sales, CS, and the executive team trust. What will you bring? Proven Experience: 4+ years delivering analytics solutions for Product teams within a high-growth SaaS company. Product Domain Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of product analytics – activation, engagement, feature adoption, and retention – including how KPIs and milestones are defined, instrumented, and measured, and fluency in translating engagement data into a north star metrics framework. Statistical Rigor: Comfort with core statistical reasoning — significance, confidence, sample size, variance, and the risk of misleading metrics from small or noisy cohorts — applied to keep KPI definitions and dashboards honest. Sales & CS Fluency: Understanding of how product usage and engagement signals are consumed by Sales and Customer Success – health scores, expansion signals, renewal risk, and adoption plays – and how to package product data for those audiences. Requirements Translation: A demonstrated ability to take loose, ambiguous, or evolving product requirements from PMs, Operations, Design, and Engineering and translate them into well-structured dbt models, clear metric definitions, and insights stakeholders can act on. Data Infrastructure Expertise: Strong understanding of modern data infrastructure (e.g., cloud data warehouses like BigQuery; ETL/ELT tools; dbt model development; modern data visualisation tools like ThoughtSpot, Omni, Looker). Exceptional Business Acumen: Ability to quickly understand complex product and business problems, identify key performance indicators, and translate data into strategic insights that drive tangible business value. Communication & Influence: Excellent communication (verbal and written) skills, with the ability to articulate complex analytical concepts – including KPI definitions and engagement trade-offs – to both technical and non-technical audiences and influence decision-making. Strategic & Analytical Thinking: Highly analytical and strategic mindset, with a proven track record of developing and executing data strategies that align with product and business objectives. Data Development: Directly engage in the creation of fundamental data and Business Intelligence (BI) infrastructure and assets, including hands-on dbt model authorship. AI Fluency: Fluency leveraging AI/LLM tools to accelerate analysis, code development, and documentation. What will give you an edge? Data Science / AI Engineering: Proven experience as a data scientist or AI engineer, ideally within a SaaS company environment, with exposure ing, engagement scoring, causal inference techniques, or building/evaluating the tool-calling and retrieval layers that let LLM agents query structured business data. Product Tech Stack: Hands-on experience with product analytics and CS tools such as Segment, Mixpanel, Amplitude, HubSpot, and Salesforce, and an understanding of how their data shapes downstream analytics. SaaS Metrics Fluency: Strong grasp of core B2B SaaS metrics – NRR/GRR, activation and time-to-value, product-qualified leads, expansion and churn drivers – and how to connect product engagement data to these outcomes. What's in it for you? Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries. 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work Stock Options: Share in UpGuard's growth and long-term success. UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why! As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, LA, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC. Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks. Also, please note that at this time, we cannot support candidates requiring visa sponsorship or relocation.

items.title: Senior Data Engineer
items.summary: Who are we, and why are we hiring? We're based on over 15 years of success, producing world-class video content and building, developing, and managing a number of high-traffic websites.
items.description: Who are we, and why are we hiring? We're based on over 15 years of success, producing world-class video content and building, developing, and managing a number of high-traffic websites. Our award-winning content and websites are created exclusively by us and directly for the use of millions of users worldwide. At Kodify, we're not just pushing boundaries in online entertainment—we're rewriting the script! Our goal is to empower our people with everything they need to pioneer innovation in our industry. Our culture is our secret sauce, and we're committed to preserving and enhancing it every step of the way. Join our crew, where the Kodify team is not just an asset, it's our crown jewel. We prioritize their growth and well-being above all else, ensuring they're set up for success and always inspired to deliver their best work. As a rapidly expanding company with diverse hubs across the globe and over 20 vibrant national cultures, working with us means embracing thrilling challenges tailor-made for a star Senior Data Engineer! At Kodify, data is at the heart of how we make decisions. From product and marketing to finance and operations, every team relies on trustworthy data delivered at the right time. We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help us raise the bar — building the pipelines, models, and platforms that turn raw events into reliable insight at scale. What will you do? You'll help to evolve a data platform that supports products serving close to 100M unique visitors a month. Design, build, and own robust data pipelines from source systems (Postgres, MongoDB, event streams, third-party APIs) into our warehouse. Architecture - Make pragmatic decisions about ingestion, storage, transformation, and serving layers, including our columnar/analytical serving layer. Balance speed, cost, and maintainability. Modeling - Drive our dbt project: structure, conventions, testing, documentation, and CI. Make it a platform other people love to contribute to. Semantic layer - Own and evolve our semantic layer so metrics are defined once, governed centrally, and consumed consistently across BI, product, and finance. Governance & lineage - Champion data cataloging, documentation, and end-to-end lineage so everyone can find, trust, and understand our data. Quality & Reliability - Own data quality end-to-end: tests, monitoring, alerting, lineage, and SLAs. If a dashboard is wrong, you care. Performance - Optimize warehouse and columnar query performance. Know where the bottlenecks are before stakeholders do. Collaborate with the BI team, Product, Development, Marketing, and Finance to understand what they need and translate it into clean, reusable data models. Mentor the wider BI/Data team — code reviews, pairing, raising the technical bar on SQL, dbt, Python, and engineering practices. Duties - Becoming a valued team member, providing feedback about tech, development lifecycle and processes. Take ownership of your code / task / role. Goal - Be proud of the data platform you help build, and be one of the driving forces behind always making it better. Where and when: From wherever you want, the position is fully remote in the EU. We're very flexible about when you get your work done, but we do have some core hours where we like to overlap in order to promote collaboration and low-latency communication between team members (10:00 to 15:00 CET/CEST). Our daily virtual stand-ups are important for us but other than that, you're free to manage your own time. What we offer: Fully remote position or, if preferred, working in our awesome Barcelona office! Agile environment Top-notch tech stack! Flexible working hours + core hours! 10% on top of your salary for learning and development - of your choice! Latest tech equipment - Macbook Pro Company Amazon book account! Modify off-sites, on-sites, events, and team activities! Amazing international team! 1 day off on your birthday Generous vacation and personal days 1 month paid sabbatical after 3 years Health & Wellness budget Requirements Senior-level experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or similar — you've done this before, at scale, and you can show it. Expert-level PostgreSQL — complex transformations, window functions, performance tuning, the lot. Hands-on production experience with a columnar/analytical database (ClickHouse strongly preferred; BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, or similar also relevant) — modeling for it, loading into it, and tuning queries against it. Solid building experience using AI - understanding AI harnessing best practices such as , hooks, skills, rules, mcps, plugins etc. Strong production experience with dbt — not just writing models, but structuring projects, testing strategy, macros, and CI/CD. Experience with a semantic/metrics layer (Cube.dev, dbt MetricFlow, LookML, or similar) — defining governed, reusable metrics. Experience with data cataloging, documentation, and lineage tooling (OpenMetadata, DataHub, or similar) — you treat discoverability and lineage as first-class, not an afterthought. Solid Python for data engineering — pipelines, scripting, APIs, data manipulation. Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and MongoDB as source systems (replication, CDC, schema evolution, the realities of pulling data out of them). Experience designing and maintaining data warehouses and dimensional/analytical models. Comfort with Git, code review, and modern software engineering practices applied to data. Strong sense of ownership — you don't wait to be told something is broken. A team player who likes to help others and solve problems together. Experience of mentoring junior engineers Investigation of new technologies. Advocate of clean code and clean architecture — applied to data. Passionate about testing — data tests, unit tests, end-to-end checks. You have a real 'Can Do' work ethic - We are results-based, not clock-based! You love to have fun while you work! Nice to have: Docker AWS Experience with high-traffic / high-volume data environments Understanding of Agile principles Experience working remotely Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: At Instructure , we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in: This role sits at the critical intersection of top-of-funnel strategy and operational execution, serving as the primary operational partner for our global Sales Development organization. As the Senior Manager of Sales Development Operations, you will lead the strategic design, process governance, and technical enablement required to maximize pipeline generation and sales efficiency. You will act as the key liaison between Sales Development leadership and the broader Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, and Business Intelligence teams. This is a highly visible, strategic role designed for a hands-on leader who can architect sophisticated capacity and territory models, establish rigorous data governance standards, and optimize our modern sales technology stack to support predictable, scalable growth. What You'll Do GTM Strategy & Financial Governance Capacity & Quota Planning: Design and execute headcount capacity models, annual target allocations, and quota-setting frameworks for the global pipeline generation team. Incentive Compensation Management: Partner with Finance and Compensation teams to design, model, and execute monthly and quarterly commission plans and incentive structures that align representative behaviors with corporate pipeline goals. Fiscal Modeling: Provide predictive forecasting and analysis on pipeline generation targets, analyzing performance against historical benchmarks. Process Optimization & System Governance Lead Lifecycle Tracking: Partner with Enterprise Systems and Data Operations to establish robust system tracking for the entire customer lifecycle, ensuring accurate date/time capture for every stage transition from lead creation to won deal. Routing & Segmentation Logic: Own and optimize the automated routing frameworks and account segmentation models within Salesforce to ensure rapid, accurate inbound lead distribution. Data Hygiene & Standardization: Audit and consolidate CRM workflows, standardizing lead dispositioning, stage progressions, and call outcomes to reduce database complexity and improve reporting accuracy. System Integration Management: Lead strategic system consolidation projects, including platform merges, routing logic synchronization, and testing/UAT cycles. Cross-Functional Collaboration Marketing & Sales Alignment: Serve as the strategic bridge between Sales Development, Marketing Operations, and Field Marketing to establish automated feedback loops regarding lead quality, campaign performance, and service-level agreements (SLAs). Technical Liaison: Collaborate closely with Salesforce Administrators, Data Engineering, and BI teams to prioritize system requirements, build pipeline dashboards, and translate business requirements into technical solutions. Sales Tech Stack & Tool Optimization Portfolio Management: Oversee the administration, user provisioning, and performance tracking of core sales enablement tools, including Sales Engagement Platforms, Account-Based Marketing (ABM) engines, and B2B data enrichment providers. Capacity & Contract Compliance: Manage software license allocation and vendor relationships, optimizing usage to support headcount growth and operational budget guidelines. What you'll need to know/have 5+ Years of Experience: Demonstrated success in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Strategy, with specific expertise supporting outbound and inbound sales development functions. Core RevOps Competencies: Deep hands-on experience in territory carving, capacity modeling, quota setting, and process governance. System Design & Administration: Advanced proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC) reporting, workflow mechanics, and lead-routing tools. Strong experience collaborating on system architecture changes is required. Technical Savvy: Experience working with modern business intelligence platforms (e.g., Tableau, Sigma, PowerBI) and data-driven enablement tools. Analytical Problem Solver: Proven capability to translate messy, disparate pipeline data into structured, actionable insights for senior executive presentation. Change Management Champion: Excellent communication skills with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment, managing system rollouts, and training sales teams on process governance. It would be a bonus if you also had Prior experience operating in an enterprise SaaS or high-growth B2B technology environment. Direct experience managing integrations, database merges, or system consolidation projects. Familiarity with lead-routing software, conversational marketing tools, and account-based intelligence platforms. Get in on all the awesome at Instructure! We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect: Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success. Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location. Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs. Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth The technology and tools you need to do your best work Motivosity employee recognition program A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes. Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate. All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws. Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

items.summary: Who We AreSpread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology.
items.description: Who We Are Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products! As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the (Senior) Web Analyst (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. What Will Your Role Be We're looking for a Senior Web Analyst to own and evolve our digital measurement ecosystem. You'll help us understand how millions of users interact with our digital products and turn that understanding into better product and business decisions.You'll work at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Engineering, ensuring that our tracking is accurate, scalable and future-proof. From defining measurement strategies to implementing tracking solutions and uncovering actionable insights, you'll play a key role in improving our digital products and customer experience. This is not a generic Data Analytics or Data Science role. We're looking for someone with a strong background in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics who enjoys solving real business problems through reliable data. What You´ll Do Own Digital Measurement Own and continuously improve our digital measurement landscape across multiple digital products. Design, implement and optimise client-side and server-side tracking solutions. Ensure accurate, scalable and privacy-compliant data collection. Drive Measurement Strategy Translate business questions into measurement concepts and technical tracking requirements. Define KPIs and success metrics together with Product, Marketing and business stakeholders. Develop tracking specifications for new products, features and customer journeys. Generate Insights Analyse user behaviour, customer journeys and conversion funnels. Build dashboards and reporting solutions that enable data-informed decision making. Identify optimisation opportunities and provide actionable recommendations. Experiment and Optimise Design, implement and evaluate A/B tests and experimentation initiatives. Measure the impact of new features, campaigns and product improvements. Continuously improve tracking quality, measurement standards and analytics processes. Collaborate Across Teams Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and Marketing teams. Present analytical findings in a clear and actionable way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Help establish analytics best practices across the organisation. What You´ll Bring Several years of experience in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics. Hands-on experience with modern tracking implementations and digital measurement architectures. Practical experience with tag management systems such as Adobe Experience Platform Tags or Google Tag Manager. Experience with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4 or comparable enterprise analytics platforms. Solid knowledge of JavaScript and experience with SQL and/or Python. Experience with client-side and server-side tracking. Strong analytical thinking combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset. A solid understanding of data quality, tracking validation and analytics governance. Confidence working independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. Excellent written and spoken English. Nice to Have Experience with Product Analytics platforms. Experience with Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau. Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake or similar cloud data environments. Experience with experimentation platforms. Knowledge of privacy regulations and consent management. Experience in e-commerce or digital consumer products. Why Should You Join Us Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business. Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so. We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another. Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company. Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change. The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together. Equal Opportunity Employer We value diversity at Spread Group . We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital or disability status. Extraordinary teams building inspiring projects: Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place. Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations. Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments . They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report . Project Overview: The rapid growth of AI and digitalization is fueling unprecedented demand for data centers that require large, reliable sources of energy. In response to this market trend, the Renewables & Clean Power (R&CP) team has signed an early works contract to build one of the largest gas-fired power generation facilities in the U.S. Our team is helping the customer progress early-stage development, that would lead to the start of full EPC delivery in 2026. The candidate will act as the Field Systems Technician on the Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) Project in Cheyenne, Wyoming. The candidate may start in the home office in Reston-VA to support planning, ahead of project mobilization to the field, when the candidate will locate on a long-term assignment to the project in Cheyenne, Wyoming. This position is contingent upon project award. Job Summary: Reporting to the EPC Automation Lead role, the Field Tech Coordinator is responsible for the implementation, configuration and support of jobsite digital/automation applications. The successful candidate can expect to deploy a broad range of automation, innovation, and AI solutions in the field. Working under the direction of the EPC Automation Lead, this position works with the site team to help implement digital solutions - mobile applications, configurations, troubleshoot system issues, prepare dashboards, documentation, and assist with user support and training. This role contributes to the overall digital delivery strategy and ensures site teams can effectively use automation tools to drive safe and efficient execution. #LI-RM1 Major Responsibilities: Assist the EPC Automation Lead and Lead Field Tech Coordinator in the deployment and management of Bechtel Standard Applications (BSAPs) and related workflows in line with Bechtel standard work processes. Assist the EPC Automation Lead in coordinating with the Project Field Engineer, project IS&T Lead, and other automation leads (procurement and project controls, commissioning, etc.), as well as Bechtel functional leads, to support AWP processes. Audit data exchanges to and from field applications and ensure they are correctly configured to support construction & Commissioning work activities. Review any application deviations raised by the project team, evaluate their impact on other applications, data integration, and work processes, and work with the project EPC Automation Lead, Lead Field Tech Coordinator, and Construction Automation teams for verification and approval of deviations. Develop and maintain reporting solutions, including performance curves, metrics, dashboards, and trackers to drive insights and continuous improvement. Provide day-to-day operational support, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, system monitoring, and escalation of complex technical issues. Lead training, onboarding, and user support, including the development of user guides and training materials for project teams, contractors, and suppliers. Ensure contractor and supplier compliance with automation, data quality, and reporting requirements across construction workflows. Participates in the rollout of new technologies, services, and security remediations by working with the project EPC Automation Lead, GBU Innovation Manager, AI Program Manager, and BEO. Support execution planning and digital adoption, including upskilling initiatives and alignment of automation solutions with project delivery objectives. Champion innovation and digital transformation, including AI, robotics, and field data capture technologies (e.g., drones), fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Education and Experience Requirements: Bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Construction Management, or a related discipline with less than 1 year of experience or 4-5 years of relevant work experience in lieu of degree. Required Knowledge and Skills: Required Knowledge and Skills: Basic knowledge of engineering and construction methods, workflows, and capital project execution processes, including cross-functional integration across Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Project Controls, Startup, Safety, Quality, and Client teams. Experience in data analysis and management, including understanding data relationships, performing validation, identifying anomalies, and developing corrective or recovery actions. Understanding of system integration, configuration, and change management practices, including configuration control, troubleshooting, and support of construction automation systems. Familiarity with 3D modeling and construction visualization tools (e.g., Navisworks) to support planning and coordination activities. Strong problem-solving capability with a practical, hands-on, and self-directed approach, combined with adaptability to learn new tools and technologies (e.g., Power Platform, drones/GIS). Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with field teams, contractors, and global stakeholders, build relationships, gather feedback, and drive continuous improvement. Commitment to safety, including knowledge of Bechtel's "Zero Incidents" program and a demonstrated focus on maintaining a safe and healthy work environment. Preferred Qualifications: Basic understanding of EPC automation applications and associated work processes (e.g., installed quantities, work packaging, turnover/completions, technical correspondence) and ability to articulate construction requirements across functions. Working knowledge of construction progress measurement processes (e.g., QURR) and related reporting practices. Experience in Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint Online) for solution development and automation. Experience with 4D planning/visualization (Synchro) and Autodesk ecosystem tools (e.g., Revit, Navisworks) to support construction sequencing and analysis. Experience with project turnover and completions processes, including data readiness and system handover requirements.
