The Lead Analyst, Energy Forecasting & Advanced Analytics will help build GE Vernova's next-generation forecasting platform by contributing to model development, data engineering, auto
items.description: Software Engineering Job Description Summary GE Vernova is modernizing its forecasting capabilities to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and strategic value of its power system outlooks. The Lead Analyst, Energy Forecasting & Advanced Analytics will help build GE Vernova's next-generation forecasting platform by contributing to model development, data engineering, automation, advanced analytics, and operational execution. This hands-on technical role will help translate strategy into scalable, production-ready forecasting capabilities while supporting the adoption of modern analytics and AI-enabled workflows across the forecasting function. Job Description Model Development and Execution Build and maintain components of capacity expansion models, production cost and dispatch models, and scenario and sensitivity analysis frameworks. Translate business and domain inputs into structured, testable model logic. Data Engineering and Pipeline Development Develop and maintain data pipelines for internal and external datasets. Clean, transform, and validate large datasets for modeling use. Support data governance practices and standardized modeling inputs. Advanced Analytics and Programming Develop analytical tools in Python, R, Julia, or similar languages to modernize spreadsheet-based workflows. Implement automation for recurring forecasting processes. Contribute to reusable code, libraries, and analytics modules that improve scalability and consistency. AI-Enabled Analytics Apply AI tools to support data extraction and processing from structured and unstructured sources. Use AI-enabled approaches to summarize market reports and datasets and enhance modeling inputs. Support experimentation with emerging AI methods across forecasting workflows. Operational Support and Continuous Improvement Execute forecasting runs and calibrate, validate, and interpret model outputs. Identify and resolve model, data, and workflow issues. Improve the performance, scalability, and usability of forecasting models over time. Collaboration and Insight Development Partner with domain experts to understand assumptions, market logic, and forecasting requirements. Contribute to analysis of market trends and model outputs. Help prepare clear insights and decision-support materials for internal stakeholders. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in engineering, data science, economics, or a related field from an accredited university or college. 3-5 years of experience in energy analytics, forecasting, power markets, advanced analytics, data science, or a related technical field with strong interest in energy. Strong proficiency with modern analytical tools and programming languages such as Python, R, Julia, or similar. Experience working with large datasets and analytical workflows. Demonstrated experience applying AI, advanced analytics, data science, or quantitative methods in market analysis, forecasting, or decision support. Desired Characteristics Experience with energy system models, including capacity expansion, production cost, dispatch, power system optimization, or related models. Experience with data tools such as SQL, cloud platforms, APIs, Power BI, Python, or similar tools. Familiarity with power markets, generation technologies, and energy policy. Exposure to AI, machine learning, or generative AI tools in analytics workflows. Experience transitioning analytical workflows from Excel into scalable modeling environments. Ability to partner effectively with domain experts and translate between technical, economic, and business perspectives. Experience building or modernizing analytics capabilities in an enterprise environment. Strong curiosity, continuous learning mindset, attention to detail, and ability to organize and prioritize multiple projects with urgency. Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to distill complex issues into clear, simple messages. Advanced degree such as an MBA, master's degree, or PhD in a relevant field. Resumo da Descrição do Cargo A GE Vernova está modernizando suas capacidades de previsão para melhorar a precisão, a eficiência e o valor estratégico de suas perspectivas sobre sistemas de energia. A pessoa Analista Líder, Previsão de Energia e Análises Avançadas ajudará a construir a plataforma de previsão de próxima geração da GE Vernova, contribuindo para desenvolvimento de modelos, engenharia de dados, automação, análises avançadas e execução operacional. Esta função técnica e prática ajudará a transformar a estratégia em capacidades de previsão escaláveis e prontas para produção, ao mesmo tempo em que apoiará a adoção de análises modernas e fluxos de trabalho habilitados por IA na área de previsão. Funções e Responsabilidades Desenvolvimento e Execução de Modelos Criar e manter componentes de modelos de expansão de capacidade, modelos de custo de produção e despacho, além de estruturas de análise de cenários e sensibilidades. Traduzir informações de negócios e domínio em lógica de modelo estruturada e testável. Engenharia de Dados e Desenvolvimento de Pipelines Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados para conjuntos de dados internos e externos. Limpar, transformar e validar grandes conjuntos de dados para uso em modelagem. Apoiar práticas de governança de dados e entradas padronizadas para modelagem. Análises Avançadas e Programação Desenvolver ferramentas analíticas em Python, R, Julia ou linguagens similares para modernizar fluxos de trabalho baseados em planilhas. Implementar automação para processos recorrentes de previsão. Contribuir para código reutilizável, bibliotecas e módulos analíticos que melhorem a escalabilidade e a consistência. Análises Habilitadas por IA Aplicar ferramentas de IA para apoiar a extração e o processamento de dados de fontes estruturadas e não estruturadas. Usar abordagens habilitadas por IA para resumir relatórios de mercado e conjuntos de dados e aprimorar entradas de modelagem. Apoiar experimentações com métodos emergentes de IA em fluxos de trabalho de previsão. Suporte Operacional e Melhoria Contínua Executar rodadas de previsão e calibrar, validar e interpretar resultados de modelos. Identificar e resolver problemas de modelo, dados e fluxo de trabalho. Melhorar continuamente o desempenho, a escalabilidade e a usabilidade dos modelos de previsão. Colaboração e Desenvolvimento de Insights Atuar em parceria com especialistas de domínio para compreender premissas, lógica de mercado e requisitos de previsão. Contribuir para a análise de tendências de mercado e resultados de modelos. Ajudar a preparar insights claros e materiais de apoio à decisão para stakeholders internos. Qualificações Necessárias Bacharelado em engenharia, ciência de dados, economia ou área relacionada por universidade ou faculdade acreditada. 3 a 5 anos de experiência em análises de energia, previsão, mercados de energia, análises avançadas, ciência de dados ou área técnica relacionada, com forte interesse em energia. Proficiência sólida em ferramentas analíticas modernas e linguagens de programação, como Python, R, Julia ou similares. Experiência trabalhando com grandes conjuntos de dados e fluxos de trabalho analíticos. Experiência comprovada na aplicação de IA, análises avançadas, ciência de dados ou métodos quantitativos em análise de mercado, previsão ou apoio à decisão. Características Desejadas Experiência com modelos de sistemas de energia, incluindo expansão de capacidade, custo de produção, despacho, otimização de sistemas de energia ou modelos relacionados. Experiência com ferramentas de dados, como SQL, plataformas em nuvem, APIs, Power BI, Python ou ferramentas similares. Familiaridade com mercados de energia, tecnologias de geração e políticas energéticas. Exposição a IA, machine learning ou ferramentas de IA generativa em fluxos de trabalho analíticos. Experiência na transição de fluxos de trabalho analíticos baseados em Excel para ambientes de modelagem escaláveis. Capacidade de atuar em parceria com especialistas de domínio e traduzir perspectivas técnicas, econômicas e de negócios. Experiência na construção ou modernização de capacidades analíticas em ambiente empresarial. Forte curiosidade, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de organizar e priorizar múltiplos projetos com senso de urgência. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, incluindo a capacidade de transformar temas complexos em mensagens claras e simples. Pós-graduação, como MBA, mestrado ou doutorado em área relevante. Résumé de la description du poste GE Vernova modernise ses capacités de prévision afin d'améliorer la précision, l'efficacité et la valeur stratégique de ses perspectives sur les systèmes électriques. L'Analyste principal, Prévision énergétique et analyses avancées contribuera à bâtir la plateforme de prévision de prochaine génération de GE Vernova en travaillant au développement de modèles, à l'ingénierie des données, à l'automatisation, aux analyses avancées et à l'exécution opérationnelle. Ce rôle technique et concret aidera à transformer la stratégie en capacités de prévision évolutives et prêtes pour la production, tout en soutenant l'adoption d'analyses modernes et de flux de travail habilités par l'IA dans la fonction de prévision. Rôles et responsabilités Développement et exécution de modèles Créer et maintenir des composantes de modèles d'expansion de capacité, de modèles de coûts de production et de dispatching, ainsi que des cadres d'analyse de scénarios et de sensibilités. Traduire les intrants métier et les connaissances de domaine en logique de modèle structurée et testable. Ingénierie des données et développement de pipelines Développer et maintenir des pipelines de données pour les ensembles de données internes et externes. Nettoyer, transformer et valider de grands ensembles de données pour l'utilisation dans les modèles. Soutenir les pratiques de gouvernance des données et les intrants normalisés pour la modélisation. Analyses avancées et programmation Développer des outils analytiques en Python, R, Julia ou langages similaires afin de moderniser les flux de travail fondés sur des feuilles de calcul. Mettre en œuvre l'automatisation des processus récurrents de prévision. Contribuer à du code réutilisable, à des bibliothèques et à des modules analytiques qui améliorent l'évolutivité et la cohérence. Analyses habilitées par l'IA Appliquer des outils d'IA pour soutenir l'extraction et le traitement de données provenant de sources structurées et non structurées. Utiliser des approches habilitées par l'IA pour résumer des rapports de marché et des ensembles de données, et améliorer les intrants de modélisation. Soutenir l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes d'IA dans les flux de travail de prévision. Soutien opérationnel et amélioration continue Exécuter les cycles de prévision et calibrer, valider et interpréter les résultats des modèles. Identifier et résoudre les problèmes liés aux modèles, aux données et aux flux de travail. Améliorer au fil du temps la performance, l'évolutivité et la convivialité des modèles de prévision. Collaboration et développement d'insights Collaborer avec des experts de domaine afin de comprendre les hypothèses, la logique de marché et les exigences de prévision. Contribuer à l'analyse des tendances du marché et des résultats des modèles. Aider à préparer des insights clairs et des supports d'aide à la décision pour les parties prenantes internes. Qualifications requises Baccalauréat en génie, science des données, économie ou domaine connexe délivré par une université ou un établissement accrédité. 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en analyses énergétiques, prévision, marchés de l'énergie, analyses avancées, science des données ou domaine technique connexe, avec un fort intérêt pour l'énergie. Solide maîtrise des outils analytiques modernes et des langages de programmation tels que Python, R, Julia ou similaires. Expérience du travail avec de grands ensembles de données et des flux de travail analytiques. Expérience démontrée dans l'application de l'IA, des analyses avancées, de la science des données ou de méthodes quantitatives à l'analyse de marché, à la prévision ou à l'aide à la décision. Caractéristiques souhaitées Expérience avec des modèles de systèmes énergétiques, notamment l'expansion de capacité, les coûts de production, le dispatching, l'optimisation des systèmes électriques ou des modèles connexes. Expérience avec des outils de données tels que SQL, plateformes infonuagiques, API, Power BI, Python ou outils similaires. Connaissance des marchés de l'énergie, des technologies de production et des politiques énergétiques. Exposition à l'IA, à l'apprentissage automatique ou aux outils d'IA générative dans les flux de travail analytiques. Expérience dans la transition de flux de travail analytiques fondés sur Excel vers des environnements de modélisation évolutifs. Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des experts de domaine et à faire le lien entre les perspectives techniques, économiques et commerciales. Expérience dans la création ou la modernisation de capacités analytiques dans un environnement d'entreprise. Grande curiosité, esprit d'apprentissage continu, souci du détail et capacité à organiser et prioriser plusieurs projets avec un sens approprié de l'urgence. Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, y compris la capacité de simplifier des sujets complexes en messages clairs. Diplôme avancé, comme un MBA, une maîtrise ou un doctorat dans un domaine pertinent. It is extremely important to us that anyone who joins loves sharing their taste for high-quality products and pays attention to deta
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Barcelona, Connecticut, Spain Job description At Kodify we manage several high traffic web platforms developed using the latest technologies and we work hard to provide the best experience for our users. It is extremely important to us that anyone who joins loves sharing their taste for high-quality products and pays attention to detail. We also value respect, openness, and diversity amongst our teams. We are an international team of around 150 with 13 different nationalities, spread around the world in our different office locations: Barcelona, Altea, Montréal, Los Angeles and several other European countries for the team that works remotely. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced, strategic Senior Product Manager to lead the development and growth of our web-based products. In this role, you will own the full product lifecycle; from discovery and strategy through execution and optimization, working cross-functionally to deliver exceptional user experiences that drive business impact. You will define product vision and roadmap, prioritize features based on user needs and business value, and partner closely with engineering, design, marketing, and analytics teams to bring products to market. This role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, with a strong focus on data-driven decision making and continuous improvement. What You'll Do Product Strategy & Vision Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with company objectives Conduct user research, market analysis, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities Make strategic decisions on feature prioritization using frameworks like RICE, value vs. effort, and customer impact analysis Product Development & Execution Own the full product lifecycle from discovery through launch and post-launch optimization Define project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements for engineering teams Work within Agile methodologies (SCRUM or Kanban) to manage product backlogs and sprint planning Build prototypes and collaborate with UX/UI designers to create intuitive user experiences Data & Experimentation Design and oversee A/B tests and experiments to validate hypotheses and optimize conversion Monitor product KPIs, user behavior analytics, and funnel performance to identify improvement opportunities Conduct cohort analysis, customer segmentation, and unit economics analysis to inform decisions Partner with data teams to build dashboards and reporting for product performance tracking Stakeholder Management & Communication Interface with leadership, marketing, customer support, and other teams to align on priorities Present product updates, insights, and recommendations to executive stakeholders Build strong relationships across the organization to facilitate cross-functional collaboration Advocate for user needs while balancing business objectives and technical constraints Growth & Optimization Drive initiatives across the full customer lifecycle: acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization Optimize conversion funnels, pricing strategies, and user onboarding flows Build a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement within the team Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in product management What You'll Bring Experience & Background 5-7+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of shipping successful digital products Experience managing products in high-traffic consumer web platforms, subscription businesses, e-commerce, adtech, or SaaS Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product ownership and measurable business impact Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working with cross-functional development teams Technical & Analytical Skills Expert-level proficiency with product analytics tools (Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar) Hands-on experience with experimentation platforms (Optimizely, VWO, Google Optimize, or similar) Solid understanding of web technologies, APIs, and technical architecture to collaborate effectively with engineering Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) Product & Business Acumen Strong analytical and mathematical skills with ability to translate data into actionable insights Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO), funnel analysis, and growth strategies Understanding of UX/UI principles, customer journey mapping, and user research methodologies Knowledge of online marketing channels, SEO fundamentals, and digital acquisition strategies Familiarity with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) Soft Skills & Working Style Exceptional communication skills with ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels Strategic thinker who can also roll up sleeves and execute tactical work Data-driven decision maker who balances quantitative insights with qualitative user feedback Comfortable with ambiguity and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment Collaborative team player with a growth mindset and passion for continuous learning Complete fluency in English is essential Nice to Have Technical background or experience working as a developer, data analyst, or UX designer Degree or postgraduate qualification in business, computer science, mathematics, statistics, or related field Understanding of payment processing, subscription billing, or monetization strategies About You You're a natural leader who can inspire teams and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders You have an eye for great design and user experience, with high standards for product quality You balance user empathy with business pragmatism to make smart tradeoffs You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and iterating based on learnings You thrive on solving complex problems and turning ambiguous challenges into clear action plans You're passionate about building products that users love and that drive meaningful business results You value transparency, open feedback, and continuous improvement in yourself and your team What We Offer Generous training and development budget (10% of your annual salary) 2x a year company on-sites 1x per year company retreat (think, Mexico, Dominican Republic…) Flexible/Remote working 1 month paid sabbatical after 3 years with us! Generous PTO Day off on your Birthday Extended parental leave Health and Wellness Budget Health insurance Cool and modern office space Latest tech equipment Healthy snacks and drinks provided at all times All done! Your application has been successfully submitted! Other jobs To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kodify-senior-product-manager

items.title: Principal Data Engineer
items.summary: At Vomela our greatest asset is our people. As a full-service visual communications company, we are looking for creative and intellectual thinkers that work with our customers to create compelling brand solutions and foster meaningful connections. And while you're focused on creating big things for global and local brands, we will help you build a career you can be passionate about. Apply now to find your place at Vomela. Pay Range:Â $180 - 200k USD Job Summary The Principal Data Engineer is the highest-performing contributor on our data engineering team - the person who sets the technical bar, owns the data platform end to end, and delivers work that others study. You'll define and execute data strategy at the engineering level, operating as the technical point of the spear for how the organization builds, scales, and trusts its data. You write production code. You design the architecture. You solve the problems that block everyone else. You mentor without being asked, influence without authority, and deliver without handholding. You're a force multiplier and you're hungry to shape not just the platform, but the broader data strategy of the business. Microsoft Fabric is our data platform. This role is for someone genuinely energized by the Fabric ecosystem, who tracks its evolution closely and sees its breadth - Lakehouseâs, Event streams, Semantic models, Notebooks, Pipelines, Direct Lake as an opportunity, not a constraint. If you're looking for a role where your technical judgment shapes the trajectory of the entire data organization, this is exactly it. What You'll Do... Design and implement dimensional models, star schemas, and snowflake schemas with rigor Build and maintain semantic models that serve as the single source of truth for business reporting Implement Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) strategies appropriate to each domain Own master data engineering: golden record patterns, source-of-record authority, cross-system identity resolution Establish and enforce data modeling standards across the team Design and operate real-time and near-real-time pipelines using streaming technologies (Kafka, Confluent Cloud, Fabric Eventstreams) â and know when streaming is the right answer and when it isn't Relentlessly drive down data staleness in non-streaming scenarios through intelligent scheduling, incremental load optimization, and pipeline orchestration design Own performance tuning across the full stack â query optimization, partition strategy, indexing, Delta table compaction, semantic model refresh efficiency, and Direct Lake readiness Apply operational engineering discipline: pipeline observability, alerting, SLA definition, failure recovery, and capacity planning Design and implement controls appropriate for sensitive data (financials, PII, HIPAA, etc.) ETL / ELT Pipeline Development Build robust, scalable, observable pipelines â watermark-based incremental loads, CDC patterns, batch and streaming architectures Ensure pipelines are idempotent, recoverable, and production-hardened Serve as the senior technical voice in code review â your approval carries weight Report & Analytics Delivery Translate business requirements into semantic models and report-layer artifacts that non-technical users can trust and navigate Serve as the platform's primary technical interface across consumer groups: Power BI report builders needing trusted, well-modeled semantic layers; AI/ML developers needing governed, feature-ready data surfaces; application developers consuming data via SQL endpoints, REST APIs, or Direct Lake Define and enforce data contracts â schema stability, access patterns, SLAs â for each consumer class Own the developer experience of the platform: discoverability, documentation, and onboarding Required Microsoft Fabric: Lakehouses, Notebooks, Dataflows Gen2, Event streams, Semantic Models, Direct Lake mode Power BI: report development, dataset/semantic model design, DAX proficiency SQL Server / Azure SQL/Postgres: query optimization, schema design, stored procedures Azure DevOps: Git-based development workflows, CI/CD for data pipelines Â·Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Demonstrated use of AI coding assistants in a production engineering workflow Â·Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Ability to critically evaluate, edit, and improve AI-generated code and artifacts Â·Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Clear understanding of where AI accelerates work and where it introduces risk Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with broader Azure Data Services (Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, ADLS Gen2, Event Hubs) as complementary tooling Experience in a private equity-backed or multi-entity portfolio company environment Exposure to MDM platforms (Profisee, Semarchy, Ataccama, or equivalent) Experience with Confluent Cloud / Apache Kafka for streaming ingestion into Fabric or Synapse Familiarity with cross-tenant Azure / Fabric architecture Background in business analysis, solutions architecture, or pre-sales engineering Microsoft Fabric or Azure Data Engineer certifications Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision) Retirement Plan (401k) Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D) Paid Time Off Short Term & Long-Term Disability Training & Development Wellness Resources Please mention the word **GENTLEST** and tag RMjAuMTY4LjEyNy44NA== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuMTY4LjEyNy44NA==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.description: SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry. As a Senior Analyst on the Risk Analytics team, you will be the analytical engine behind our fraud prevention strategy. You will build models, run experiments, and develop tools that help us make smarter, faster decisions, reducing reliance on external black boxes and static rules. You will work closely with the Manager, Risk Analytics, owning the technical and statistical work that turns strategy into something measurable and executable. You will also be a key driver of how our team uses AI: not just adopting tools as they come, but actively building workflows, automating repetitive analysis, and thinking ahead about how AI can keep us one step ahead of increasingly sophisticated fraud. What you'll do Build and maintain Python-based analyses, models, and data pipelines that support fraud decisioning, vendor evaluation, and internal risk scoring Design and run statistical experiments from hypothesis through measurement and communication of results, including A/B tests on routing changes, holdout experiments, and vendor performance assessments Develop and iterate on internal fraud risk models using SeatGeek transaction and vendor data; own model calibration, validation, and ongoing performance monitoring Actively use AI tools including LLMs, code generation, and agentic workflows to move faster and build smarter; help define how AI gets embedded into the team's analytical processes, and identify opportunities to automate work currently done manually Contribute to vendor performance analysis: assess score calibration, measure lift across segments, and surface findings that inform routing decisions and contract discussions Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Looker and Hex; develop SQL models and data views to support the team's analytical needs Monitor fraud and operations metrics, investigate anomalies, and escalate findings with a clear point of view on recommended actions Collaborate with Risk Ops agents, the manager, and cross-functional partners in Engineering, Payments, and CX to translate analysis into action What you have 3+ years of experience in fraud analytics, risk, fintech, or a quantitatively demanding analytical role Strong Python skills; you build end-to-end analyses and pipelines independently, and are proficient with pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, or equivalent libraries Strong SQL; you can own complex data pulls, understand warehouse structures, and build views and models that others rely on Solid statistical grounding: you can design statistically valid experiments, perform significance testing, assess model calibration, and communicate findings clearly to a non-technical audience Hands-on experience building, training, and validating classification models independently; familiarity with model evaluation methods, handling class imbalance, and translating model outputs into business decisions Genuine enthusiasm for AI tools: you actively use LLMs and code generation in your day-to-day work, think about how to design AI-assisted workflows, and take initiative in identifying where AI can replace manual effort Comfort operating in ambiguity; you are expected to define the problem as much as solve it Familiarity with fraud vendors such as Forter, Riskified, or Sardine is a plus; experience with Looker or similar BI tools is a plus Perks Equity stake Discretionary annual bonus Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely A WFH stipend to support your home office setup Unlimited PTO Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave 401(k) matching Student loan matching program Health, vision, dental, and life insurance Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care $500 per year for wellness expenses Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical $360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music The salary range for this role is $108,000 - $157,000 USD. This role is equity eligible. In addition, you may receive a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation packages within that range are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location. items.summary: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization.
items.description: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization. We work with some of the world's largest organizations across a variety of industries, including Financial Services, Specialty Retail, Telecommunications, Hospitality, and Software, helping them gain a deep understanding of their customers, develop actionable insights, and improve business processes. Our client is a global leader in the Consumer Packaged Goods industry, with a focus on delivering data-driven insights that support commercial decision-making and business growth. Their Growth Analytics team develops dashboards and reporting solutions used by senior leadership across the organization. They are seeking a Data Liaison to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring reporting solutions accurately reflect business needs and industry metrics. This is a 6-month remote contract with the potential for extension. About the Role The ideal candidate is analytical, commercially minded, and an exceptional communicator who enjoys translating business needs into actionable data requirements. You will work closely with business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers to ensure dashboards and reporting solutions are built using the correct business logic, calculations, and data sources. This role is ideal for someone with experience in business analytics, commercial insights, or consumer insights who understands both the language of the business and the language of data. should be comfortable working closely with technical teams, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and validating data before it reaches senior leadership. You'll also play an important role in helping the analytics team build a stronger understanding of the business, enabling them to become increasingly self-sufficient over time. Responsibilities Include Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers, translating executive requests into clear business requirements, data specifications, and analytical approaches. Review dashboards, calculations, and reporting logic before release, ensuring the correct business logic, methodologies, metrics, and data sources (including syndicated datasets such as Nielsen) are used while proactively identifying and resolving reporting inaccuracies. Participate in business and executive reporting discussions to understand business priorities, reporting requirements, and how data is used to support decision-making. Document business metrics, calculation methodologies, and data source guidance to establish consistent reporting standards and best practices. Coach and mentor analytics developers to strengthen their understanding of business metrics, commercial context, and reporting expectations, with the goal of enabling greater independence over time. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve reporting processes, strengthen communication between business and technical functions, and develop scalable documentation and best practices that enhance the long-term capability of the analytics team. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Consumer Insights, Market Research, Strategy, or a related analytical role. Experience within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Retail, or a similar commercial environment is strongly preferred. Experience working with syndicated data sources, particularly Nielsen, with the ability to determine the most appropriate data source for different business questions. Strong understanding of retail and commercial performance metrics, including velocity, points of distribution, market share, merchandising, pricing, and related KPIs. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to validate data, calculations, business logic, and reporting accuracy. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into clear guidance for technical and analytics teams. Experience collaborating with analytics, BI, engineering, or dashboard development teams in a cross-functional environment. Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools is advantageous. Technical coding or dashboard development experience is not required; however, the ability to engage credibly with technical teams is essential. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher.
items.description: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher. Your core mission will involve a deep dive into the complex internals and mechanics of various blockchain networks, reverse engineering of sophisticated Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols, and translating these complex systems into actionable, structured data. Develop new derivative data models and datasets for client insights and competitive advantages. Map, cleanse, and normalize raw, disparate blockchain data (transaction logs, smart contract events, state changes) into consistent, structured relational and non-relational schemes for consumption by analytics, machine learning, and AI tools. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems, data engineering best practices, and a profound understanding of the crypto and decentralized ecosystem. What You’ll Do Maintain an AI-native and blockchain-forward mindset, proactively leveraging emerging trends and generative technologies to stay at the vanguard of the crypto revolution while maximizing work efficiency and uncovering novel, high-alpha data opportunities. Architect Intuitive Data Models: Turn the messiness of on-chain data into elegant, unified abstractions. You'll build the models that provide our users with granular, high-integrity insights across various protocols. Deconstruct DeFi Mechanics: Get under the hood of DeFi protocols. You'll reverse-engineer smart contracts and on-chain events, translating complex interactions into clean, production-grade SQL/dbt models. Scale Our Ecosystem Coverage: Lead the charge in indexing new blockchains. You’ll design the schemas that transform raw chain data into our internal "source of truth," ensuring every block is captured with 100% accuracy. Engineer Signal from Noise: Define the metrics that matter (TVL, Volume, Fees). You’ll be the gatekeeper of data quality, proactively identifying and filtering out wash trading, bot activity, and Sybil attacks. What You'll Need: Experience 3+ years hands-on in Data Science, Data Engineering, or a hybrid role; Blockchain or crypto analytics background strongly preferred, familiarity with on-chain data structures, transaction semantics, and asset classification; Streaming & Lakehouse Apache Flink or Spark Streaming building and operating real-time data pipelines; Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi managing large-scale Data Lakehouses with schema evolution, time travel, and ACID guarantees over petabytes of raw blockchain data; AWS Data Platform S3 for scalable data lake storage; RDS for structured relational workloads; Spark SQL and PySpark for interactive querying and ad-hoc analysis; Caching & Distribution Familiarity with Data Grid technologies (e.g. Hazelcast, Apache Ignite, Redis) for high-throughput, low-latency data access patterns; Languages & Tooling SQL advanced query writing, window functions, query plan analysis, performance tuning at scale; Python Pandas, Polars for data wrangling; Scikit-learn for model development; Proficient in architecting high-throughput ingestion pipelines that leverage external data sources REST/WebSocket APIs, JSON-RPC node queries; Strong grasp of ETL fundamentals (extract, transform, load), including managing schema mismatches between heterogeneous sources and destinations; Engineering Mindset Systematic approach to debugging: reproducing issues, isolating root cause, validating fixes; Comfortable working with large, semi-structured, or undocumented data sources. Why Join Lukka ? Are you looking for a challenge? Lukka solves the most complex data and technology challenges for an industry that is at the forefront of innovation. At Lukka , we strive to anticipate and respond to the needs of this new and ever-changing ecosystem of digital assets. That was true in 2014, while everyone was focused on trading & buying this new asset class, we were thinking about the tax implications of crypto. That innovative foresight continues today as we evolve and iterate on our product suite to address the regulations and educate our customers. We are looking for passionate, collaborative, and strategic individuals who want to help shape the future of, well, everything – starting with making crypto more accountable. We invest in our teammates, promote from within & are responsible to each other by fostering an inclusive space for curious minds to thrive and innovate. What’s life @ Lukka like? We move fast and continue to be ahead of the curve. You could be part of a growing company bridging the gap between business and blockchain. Here’s some insight into why our team members have joined: Ability to own the projects they work on; Less red tape to take ideas from inception to delivery; Being at the forefront of an industry; Small team, big dreams. Of course, let’s discuss some perks: Opportunity to work directly on data for digital assets, an industry-leading product with well-known clients. Working with multiple AI solutions daily. Exposure to both technical problem-solving and customer-facing challenges. A growing Poland-based team with direct collaboration across US and global stakeholders. A startup-style culture where your impact is visible every day. So you’ve scrolled, your interest is piqued and hopefully read all of the important things...now what? This is an exciting time to join a team that’s at the forefront of this rapidly growing industry. We are looking for people who constantly push themselves to think differently, are ready to face new challenges and chart exciting new paths. If this sounds like you, apply! items.title: Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will lead the analysis, interpretation and management of institutional performance information to support evidence-based decision-making across ALU . The role will translate complex business, financial, operational, academic and student data into clear insights, identify performance trends and gaps, assess their underlying drivers, and provide actionable recommendations to improve institutional outcomes. The role will also strengthen ALU 's performance management and business intelligence capabilities, ensuring that leadership has timely, reliable and forward-looking information to guide strategic and operational decisions. Working across functions and with senior leaders, the role will connect institutional strategy, performance targets and operational results, providing the analysis and challenge required to improve execution and organisational performance. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Institutional Performance Management Lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of ALU 's institutional performance framework, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance measures. Monitor performance against strategic and operational objectives, identify material variances, emerging risks and areas of underperformance, and recommend appropriate interventions. Lead periodic performance reviews and provide analysis that enables leadership to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening and what action is required. Analyse performance across key institutional areas including enrolment, recruitment, retention, student progression, programme performance, revenue, costs, resource utilisation and other strategic priorities. Establish appropriate performance benchmarks and support leadership in setting meaningful, measurable and outcome-focused objectives and targets. Business and Strategic Analysis Identify trends, patterns, performance drivers and root causes across multiple sources of institutional data. Develop business cases, investment analyses and decision papers, including assessment of financial, operational and strategic implications. Undertake scenario analysis and modelling to assess the potential impact of strategic and operational decisions. Conduct complex business and institutional analysis to support strategic planning, operational decisions and strategic initiatives and prioritization. Provide objective analysis and constructive challenge where data, assumptions or proposed interventions require further scrutiny. Conduct internal and external benchmarking to assess institutional performance against relevant peer institutions, competitors, sector standards and market trends. Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, implications and actions for senior leadership. Performance Intelligence and Reporting Lead the development of high-quality management information, executive performance reports, dashboards and analytical products for senior leadership and governance forums. Establish standards for performance reporting, data interpretation, and analytical storytelling. Ensure management reports focus on material performance issues, drivers, trends and decisions rather than simply presenting data. Develop forward-looking analysis and forecasts to support proactive management of institutional performance. Work with data and technology teams to improve access to, integration of and confidence in institutional data. Ensure the accuracy, consistency and appropriate interpretation of performance information used for management decision-making. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Develop clear standards for analytical quality, delivery and stakeholder service. Coach team members in analytical thinking, problem solving, business partnering and effective communication of insights. Develop and continuously improve analytical methodologies, tools and processes. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve performance reporting and analysis. Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and stronger use of data across ALU . Partner with other functions to develop integrated views of institutional performance. Executive Stakeholder Engagement Establish and maintain data supply arrangements with the functions that own the underlying data: agreed definitions, cut dates, quality standards, and named counterparts. Resolve definitional inconsistency across campuses, programmes and systems so that the institution reports a single number for each institutional metric. Build effective working relationships with senior leaders, Deans, Directors and functional teams across ALU . Present complex analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and translate findings into practical business implications. Facilitate performance discussions and support leaders in identifying appropriate responses to performance gaps. Influence decisions through evidence, insight and constructive challenge, including where findings may challenge established assumptions or practices. Provide analytical support to strategic, executive and governance forums as required. Maintain a strong understanding of the ALU ’s operating environment, priorities and strategic objectives to ensure analysis remains relevant to institutional needs. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 10+ years of relevant professional experience in business performance, institutional research, strategy, business intelligence, analytics, planning, consulting, financial analysis or a related field. Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing organisational or institutional performance frameworks, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance reporting. Proven experience analysing complex datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations for senior decision-makers, forecasting, scenario modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis. Experience producing executive-level performance reports, dashboards and decision-support materials. Experience using data to identify performance drivers, diagnose problems and support measurable improvements in organisational outcomes. Demonstrated experience delivering analytical or performance improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable business, operational, financial or institutional impact. Experience benchmarking organisational or institutional performance against external peers, competitors or sector standards is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Strategic and Performance Analysis: Analyse complex institutional issues, identify performance drivers and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Data & Business Intelligence: Analyse complex datasets and develop clear dashboards, management information and performance insights. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Understand the financial, operational and institutional implications of decisions. Forecasting & Modelling: Develop forecasts, scenarios and business models to support planning and decision-making. Problem Solving: Diagnose root causes, test assumptions and develop practical, evidence-based solutions. Executive Reporting: Distil complex information into clear insights, implications and recommendations for senior leaders. Analytics Tools: Advanced Excel and strong proficiency in Power BI and uses digital and AI-enabled tools effectively to accelerate analysis, improve productivity and generate insight, while independently validating outputs and exercising sound judgement. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking: Connect performance trends and analysis to broader institutional priorities. Critical Thinking: Question assumptions and assess evidence objectively. Influencing & Challenge: Build credibility with senior stakeholders and challenge constructively using evidence. Executive Communication: Communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively to varied audiences. Collaboration: Work effectively across academic and professional functions. Leadership & Coaching: Develop people, set high analytical standards and build team capability. Delivery Orientation: Focus on turning insight into action and measurable institutional improvement. Match the ALU Archetype: Alignment with the ALU Archetype, including ownership, courage, and stewardship. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one. You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career. We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals. These solutions are provided through Learning A-Z® (online differentiated instruction for elementary school reading, writing and science), ExploreLearning® (online interactive math and science simulations, a math fact fluency solution, and a K–2 science solution), Voyager Sopris Learning® (blended solutions that accelerate struggling learners to achieve in literacy and math and professional development for teachers), and VKidz Learning (online comprehensive homeschool education and programs for literacy and science). We believe that every student has unlimited potential, that teachers matter, and that data, instruction, and practice are the keys to success in the classroom and beyond. In this role, you will lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative research cycles within our K-12 educational data and assessment platforms. Beyond traditional data synthesis, you possess a strong sense of visual and layout design, allowing you to translate raw researcher findings directly into clean, interactive, and tangible UI prototypes. Conduct Market & Competitive Analysis: Perform targeted market and competitive research to evaluate industry trends, benchmark rival EdTech solutions, and identify strategic positioning opportunities for our platform features. items.description: Data and Analytics Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers. The Role As a Lead AI Consultant (Field) (known internally - Lead Deployment Engineer) of the Iberia & LATAM region, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance. You will lead the team of junior Consultants and team with experts (AI, Product, Functional) to make sure the customer achieves value and adoption. As a strategic driver in the pre-sales stage, you will partner closely with Account Teams to shape and position our Services solutions. You won't just present offerings—you will architect the foundation for long-term customer success, ensuring rapid adoption and value realization. This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are Product expert and an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, to ensure the platform delivers measurable impact and adoption. The Work You’ll Do Pre-Sales: Designing tailored deployment roadmaps and implementation strategies aligned with the customer's maturity. Estimating project timelines, team structures, and overall professional services effort to support commercial proposals. Partnering with Account Executives and Value Engineers to translate business cases into actionable deployment plans. Drafting clear Statements of Work (SOW), defining project scope, deliverables, assumptions, and acceptance criteria. Aligning client expectations with operational feasibility to prevent post-sale scope creep. Post-Sales: Initiate and Connect Define the strategy and oversee junior Consultants covering - Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required Build & Value Direct AI deployment agents to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements – do we make this less of a must have? Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance Rollout, Adoption, and Handover Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff Domain & Industry Depth Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually – still hands on technical? You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable The Qualifications You Need Experience: 7+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. Consulting pre-sales experience Platform skills: Track record in complex IT/SAP transformations, process optimization, and PQL/SQL/Python technical capability AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus. Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus. Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences. Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact. Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field. Languages: Fluency in English and Spanish required. Portuguese beneficial. Travel : Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases. What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here .

items.description: We’re a small, growing marketing team. We’re seeking a systems thinker who can contribute marketing ideas, tasks and projects with a combination of elbow grease, AI skills, creative problem solving and drawing on their lived experience. This person will get pointed at a problem and expected to solve it, sometimes with minimal direction and assistance. Metabase is used by hundreds of thousands of people to answer questions about their own data, most of whom aren’t analysts. We’ve always believed the best marketing for a tool like ours comes from people who use it. So we’re looking for someone who is closer to our user than to a traditional marketing résumé: you’ve been the person on a team who figured out the data, wired up the integration, built the dashboard nobody asked for, and then explained it to everyone else. You bring that confidence to other tasks, including those you’re trying for the first time. If you’ve used Metabase, or you write SQL and have opinions about BI tools, we especially want to hear from you. You’d be marketing to yourself, which is a big advantage. You’ll be working closely with everyone on the marketing team, reporting directly to the VP of Marketing. You’d be joining at a point where the marketing team is small enough that what you build becomes how we do things. Responsibilities The specifics will shift dramatically. Over the first year, expect a mix of: Helping build and refine our marketing stack the way an engineer would: know what’s connected to what, what’s breaking, and what’s quietly costing us money. Building integrations and automations between our tools using APIs, webhooks, MCPs and whatever glue is appropriate Publishing and managing webpages via github; optimizing via A/B tests; spinning up landing pages with minimal direction. Owning smaller channel experiments end to end, from hypothesis to write-up, including (especially) the ones that fail. Supporting our community events programs, including logistics, speaker wrangling, pre- and post-event comms, the data collection that makes an event worthwhile. Pressure-testing our messaging against your own experience as a data-curious person who uses tools like ours. What we’re looking for You don’t need a traditional marketing background. You do need to be data-curious, technically fearless and close to our target persona. The core traits we’re looking for are some combination of: You’ve used Metabase or are comfortable writing SQL. You have fluency with AI tools and know when to apply them. You communicate clearly in writing, which is vital for our remote, async culture. You have high-agency, are resourceful and are comfortable learning new things. You have experience in analytics, ops, support, consulting, engineering, product, or marketing. Working at Metabase Amazing views from our beautiful downtown San Francisco office Zoom channel Unlimited PTO, and a team that takes it Substantial equity in a venture-funded company Remote-first and async by default Small, engineering-led, and opinionated about building a product people like using We’re bringing data tools with the elegance and simplicity of consumer products to the crufty world of enterprise business intelligence. Compensation The US base salary range for this role is $71.7K–$130K annually , plus equity and benefits. Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual qualifications, including skills, experience, and scope of responsibility. Pay may vary by geographic location and other job-related factors. US Benefits Our US benefits package also includes fully employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (with 75% coverage for dependents), a 401(k) with employer match available to enroll after the first 30 days. How to apply Send us a resume and a short cover note. We read them. In the note, we’d love to know: What you’ve built or figured out that you’re proud of, even if it was small and internal How you’ve used Metabase, or where you’ve used SQL Metabase is an equal opportunity employer. We’re building a team of people with different backgrounds, and we mean it. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.summary: About UsAt Digital Forms, we help companies grow through digital transformation — from process optimization and automation to AI and custom software development.
items.description: About Us At Digital Forms , we help companies grow through digital transformation — from process optimization and automation to AI and custom software development. Our technology team designs and builds the solutions that drive this change: scalable systems, data platforms, integrations, and products that make a real business impact. We work with international clients across industries, focusing on long-term, high-quality engineering that supports business growth. Every line of code we write serves a clear purpose — to make technology practical, efficient, and ready for scale. The Role As a Senior Back-End Engineer , you’ll play a key role in designing and building the systems that power our clients’ transformations. You’ll work on challenging, large-scale projects — from custom SaaS platforms to complex integrations — with modern technologies and high autonomy. You’ll collaborate closely with our technical leads, contributing to system architecture, implementing best practices, and delivering robust, maintainable back-end solutions. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who wants to deepen their expertise, take ownership of key parts of a system, and work in an environment that values quality and thoughtful engineering. Requirements Key Responsibilities Build & Deliver: Design, develop, and maintain scalable back-end systems and APIs in Python (Django, FastAPI), ensuring high performance and reliability. Collaborate: Work closely with front-end developers, DevOps engineers, and business analysts to deliver complete, production-ready solutions. Contribute to Architecture: Participate in architectural discussions and propose improvements that enhance scalability, maintainability, and security. Ensure Quality: Write clean, well-documented code, contribute to code reviews, and promote engineering best practices. Optimize Performance: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, ensuring stability and efficiency at scale. Deploy & Monitor: Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and observability improvements. Learn & Grow: Continuously improve your skills, exploring new technologies and patterns that make our solutions better. Must-Have Qualifications Strong Python Experience: Solid hands-on experience with Python and modern frameworks (Django, FastAPI). Cloud Experience: Practical knowledge of AWS services and deploying applications in cloud environments. System Design: Proven ability to design, implement, and maintain modular, scalable systems and APIs. Databases: Strong understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL) and experience with ORMs. CI/CD & Git: Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) and version control best practices. Problem Solving: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions with minimal supervision. Team Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and experience working in agile, cross-functional teams. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Experience with asynchronous/event-driven systems (Celery, RabbitMQ, Kafka). Knowledge of Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools. Familiarity with Docker and container-based deployments. Experience with monitoring and logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack). Understanding of NoSQL or in-memory databases (MongoDB, Redis). What We Offer Work on complex, international projects with tangible business impact. Competitive compensation based on experience and contribution. Full remote work setup with flexible hours. A strong engineering culture focused on long-term quality, not just delivery speed. Continuous learning and mentorship from experienced leads. Highlights If you are a passionate technologist who is ready to take the next step and build something lasting, we encourage you to apply. Originally posted on Himalayas
