items.description: Join Telaid as a Collections Specialist! Who We Are: Telaid is a leader in technology deployment solutions for multi-site enterprises. For over 40 years, we have been the trusted partner for accelerating the adoption of innovative technologies that drive positive business outcomes. Our mission is to reduce the time, effort, risk, and cost associated with implementing cutting-edge technology. Position Overview: As a Collections Specialist , you will play a vital role in ensuring the company receives timely payments from clients. This role requires strong financial analysis skills, customer service excellence, and problem-solving abilities to maintain Telaid’s financial health. If you’re a detail-oriented, results-driven professional who thrives in a collaborative environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Key Responsibilities: Use accounting software to generate reports and review open accounts for past-due balances. Track invoices nearing due dates and send reminders to customers proactively. Identify overdue amounts based on customer payment terms. Contact customers via phone or email in a professional manner to resolve outstanding payments while maintaining positive client relationships. Collaborate with Project Accountants and Project Managers to address billing issues and delinquent accounts. Reconcile discrepancies between customer records and company accounts. Escalate unresolved past-due accounts to the Credit & Collections Manager as needed. Provide timely follow-up on payment arrangements. Assist with generating and submitting invoices across various software platforms. Apply payments to customer accounts and review credit reports to establish credit limits for new customers. Identify trends in account delinquency and propose solutions to management. Qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent (Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred). At least 2 years of experience in billing and collections. Strong communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and excel in a fast-paced, multitasking environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Experience with ERP systems and project accounting environments is a plus. Knowledge of Crystal Reports, Power BI, and SQL is desirable. Why Join Telaid? Be part of a team that values proactivity, teamwork, and service excellence. Enjoy flexibility in a supportive, growth-oriented environment. Contribute to impactful technology projects with high-profile clients. If you’re ready to advance your career and contribute to Telaid’s success, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of our legacy of delivering excellence in technology deployments. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization.
items.description: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization. We partner with some of the world’s leading organizations across Financial Services, Specialty Retail, Telecommunications, Hospitality, and Software, helping them gain a deeper understanding of their customers, translate research into actionable insights, and improve business processes and customer experiences. One of our leading telecommunications clients is seeking an adaptable, detail-oriented Market Research Analyst to join our team during an upcoming high-volume period. In this role, you will serve as a key operational bridge between our Operations, Research, and UX teams, helping to coordinate research activities, support project execution, and ensure that insights and deliverables move efficiently from research through to implementation. This position is ideal for an "all-around player" who understands the nuances of primary and secondary research, excels at data evaluation, and feels comfortable navigating CX and research platforms. You will manage daily research work streams, validate survey data, and ensure seamless cross-functional execution across projects. This position is for 6 Months with potential extension based on workload demands. Key Responsibilities Operational Bridge: Serve as a central liaison connecting Operations, UX, and Research teams to align project goals and streamline workflows. Workstream & Data Management: Execute daily research workstreams, pull routine dataset reports, and validate survey and data outputs using Excel and internal tools. Cross-Functional Multitasking: Manage competing priorities and switch gears smoothly between different research and operations tasks during high-volume periods. Data Quality & Reporting: Review data critically to ensure accuracy, synthesize findings into clear reports, and share actionable, logical recommendations with stakeholders. Requirements Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an analyst role spanning research operations, CX, market research, or UX data validation. Research Fundamentals: Strong practical knowledge of primary and secondary research methodologies, survey design, and UX research principles. Advanced Excel & Tool Proficiency: Expert-level skills in Microsoft Excel (data cleanup, formatting, pivot tables, formulas). Comfort learning and navigating enterprise research and CX platforms without requiring programming or software development skills. Cross-Functional Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with a knack for presenting dataset insights to diverse teams. Project Management & Adaptability: Outstanding organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple deadlines, and adapt to shifting priorities. Background in Market Research, Customer Experience (CX), or Community Insights Operations (advantageous). Experience executing research initiatives or managing tasks within online community platforms or large enterprise environments (advantageous). Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day. Smartsheet is building the AI connectivity layer that lets enterprise teams work through the AI assistants they already use - Claude, Copilot, Gemini, and ChatGPT. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is at the centre of that strategy, and this role owns its adoption and growth. With 7,500+ organisations connected across five AI platforms and an Anthropic case study validating Smartsheet’s position, MCP is one of the most strategically significant product areas in the company. This is an individual contributor role for a senior product leader who owns product strategy through an adoption lens, and who lives with customers and power users to bridge field signals with engineering direction. The core personas are the people pushing AI hardest - CLI power users, agent builders, and the teams wiring tools and agents into their daily work. You are their voice inside Smartsheet, and Smartsheet’s voice to them. This person operates as the product peer to the engineering lead for MCP, planning and launching together day to day. As the platform matures and this role builds the track record to take on more, we expect the scope to grow, potentially into leading industry-vertical specialisation (for example Pharma, Fintech, Construction) as those needs emerge. You will work remotely from the UK and report to the Director, Product Management. You Will: Own the MCP adoption strategy and shape roadmap priorities based on usage and persona evidence, in partnership with the Director of Engineering who owns the technical roadmap. Own the activation and adoption pathway, understanding why connected organisations don’t become active tool callers, run research and data analysis against usage patterns, and shape product and go to market investments that convert connection into daily value Champion CLI power users, agent builders, and tool calling developers as core product personas, spending real time with them, understanding their workflows across Claude, Copilot, Gemini, and ChatGPT, and making their needs legible to engineering and product leadership Sit with customers on their actual use cases, run pilots and proof of concepts alongside client teams, capturing what they build with MCP tools and agents, and turning those engagements into showcases, reference stories, and adoption plays the field can run Be the field enablement engine for MCP, building the demos, playbooks, documentation, and enablement content that helps Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions teams tell the MCP story and land it with enterprise customers Document the platform for the people who use it, clear, current, use case driven documentation of MCP toolpoints, agents, and integration patterns that makes the ecosystem self serve for customers and internal teams Partner day to day with the MCP engineering lead as product and engineering peers, jointly owning the go live and launch plan for MCP capabilities, from how features are shaped and released to how the adoption curve is driven afterwards Help engineers see what customers see, bringing client use cases, research findings, and adoption data into engineering conversations so the team understands what to build to unlock more usage Be the internal front door for MCP, help other teams understand the tool surface, see where their capabilities fit, and take part in building toolpoints with us, maintaining a federated view of tool coverage and capability gaps across contributing teams Work closely with the Smart Assist team to ensure a coherent and aligned customer experience is delivered regardless of how customers access MCP capabilities, surfacing cross-team insights and dependencies Own business metrics, usage patterns, and data signals, partnering with Business Intelligence to define success metrics for every capability, instrument from day one, and use post launch data to guide iteration and prioritisation Author crisp product briefs and use case narratives grounded in customer evidence that give engineering and design unambiguous direction on the problem and the outcome Drive cross-functional alignment across UX research, GTM, Customer items.description: About League League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side. Position Summary: This is a builder role, not a maintainer role — equal parts strategy and execution. You're the most senior growth marketing hire on a team that's re-building its demand generation engine. You'll have the budget, a team, and direct access to leadership to do it. You'll be marketing into two of the most sought-after B2B buyer groups in health tech: payers with long procurement cycles and multiple clinical/financial stakeholders, and providers balancing patient experience against margin pressure. If you want to prove you can build and run demand gen at enterprise scale, in a category where the sales cycle actually tests your craft, this is that proving ground. You're inheriting a full, well-funded MarTech stack — Salesforce, Pardot, Bizible, Demandbase, and Qualified — and the website itself, but the job isn't to just run any of it as-is. We want someone who rebuilds how that stack operates to be agentic-first: designing AI agents that pull signal to plan campaigns, launch and sequence them across channels, and continuously test and optimize without manual hand-offs between tools. What You'll Do: Own and optimize our tech stack and website Own pipeline generation across paid search, paid social (LinkedIn), SEO, content, lifecycle/email, and account-based marketing Continuously test messaging, creative, and campaign structure — and bring examples of non-boilerplate campaigns that actually moved pipeline Own reporting: define KPIs and dashboards, and keep pipeline numbers trusted by Sales Own the AI-Native Workflow strategy and AI Engine Optimization (AEO): as buyers increasingly use LLMs to research vendors, you have ideas on how to build League's presence in those results Strategically partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing and Revenue Operations Security-Related Responsibilities Compliance with Information Security Policies Ensure access management is performed in compliance with the employee's role and responsibilities Responsibility and accountability for executing League's policies and procedures within the department/ team Notification of HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches or policy violations What You'll Bring: 7+ years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, with real ownership of pipeline outcomes — not just campaign support Enterprise background: you've marketed to large, complex organizations with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders; payer or provider experience is a strong plus Hands-on across the full stack: paid search, paid social (LinkedIn), SEO, content, and account-based marketing Fluent in the pipeline metrics that matter here — MQL/SQL/SQO conversion, pipeline contribution, cost per opportunity — not just CAC/LTV/ROAS Real experience building AI agents or automations, not just prompting a chatbot — bonus if you already gravitate toward MCP-first, Salesforce-native tools Strategic and hands-on: you're equally excited to set the plan and execute it Bonus: experience with ABM platforms like Demandbase or 6sense Bonus: experience in HealthTech, FinTech, InsurTech, or other large enterprise-focused products CANADA APPLICANTS ONLY: The Canada-specific compensation range below for this full-time position is exclusive of bonus, equity and benefits. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for base salaries for the position across all Canadian locations. The salary range is intentional to account for the performance and career progressions a Leaguer will experience in the role throughout their time at League. Where in the band you may land is determined by job-related skills/experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range specific to your skills and experience during the hiring process. Compensation range for Canada applicants only $145,000—$170,000 CAD AI Fluency & Ways of Working At League, we are an AI-native organization . We expect all employees regardless of role or level to thoughtfully leverage AI to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. What this means in practice: Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making (e.g., drafting, analysis, coding, research, or process automation) Apply judgment and accountability when using AI by reviewing outputs for accuracy, bias, and quality before use Continuously learn and adapt as new AI tools and capabilities emerge, incorporating them into your ways of working Identify opportunities to improve how work gets done from personal productivity to team-level workflows by leveraging AI effectively Operate with strong data responsibility and security awareness , especially when working with sensitive or regulated information How this scales by level: Individual Contributors: Use AI to improve personal productivity and quality of output Senior ICs / Managers: Integrate AI into team workflows and improve processes Leaders: Drive AI adoption at the organizational level and shape how work is done across teams What we look for: Demonstrated experience using AI tools in a practical, responsible way Curiosity and openness to experimenting with new technologies Ability to balance efficiency with quality and sound judgment Our employees come from different backgrounds, and we celebrate those differences. We are looking for the best candidates for our open roles, but do not expect applicants to meet every qualification in order to be considered. If you are excited about what you could accomplish at League and believe you can add value to our team, we would love to hear from you. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you are an individual in need of assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please contact us at recruitinginfo@league.com . Our Application Process: Applying to a role you love can be exhausting, and understanding the next steps can feel vague and uncertain. You have done the hard part of submitting your application; let's do ours by sharing potential next steps You should receive a confirmation email after submitting your application. A recruiter (not a computer) reviews all applications at League. If we see alignment with League's needs, a recruiter will reach out to learn more about your goals. The recruiter will also share the team-specific interview process depending on the roles you are exploring. The final step is an offer, which we hope you will accept! Prior to joining us, we conduct reference and background checks. Additional checks could be required for US Candidates, depending on the role you are exploring. Here are some additional resources to learn more about League: Learn about our platform, leadership team and partners Highmark Health, Google Cloud, League: new digital front door to seamless care Former Providence President and Workday EVP of Corporate Strategy join League Board of Directors League raises $95 million USD in Series C to build world’s leading healthcare CX platform Forbes x League: The Platformization Of Healthcare Is Here Fast Company x League: If we want better innovations in healthtech, we need more competition Work Location: We have a mix of office-centric roles based in our vibrant Toronto office, and remote-eligible roles based anywhere in Canada or US. Each job posting will indicate where the role will be based. Regardless of the role’s posted location, all Toronto-area Leaguers (living within 65 km of our downtown HQ) collaborate in-office Monday through Thursday. Depending on your distance to the office, you’ll enjoy 10 or 20 Flexible Remote Days each quarter for focus and deep-work time. We are committed to fostering a meaningful work environment and connections for all Leaguers regardless of location. Recognize and Avoid Employment scams. Practice safe job searching. Scammers are getting craftier and leveraging fake job postings to get personal information. Know the warning signs and protect yourself from scammers. Learn more here . Use of AI Notice We are committed to ensuring fairness and transparency throughout our hiring process. League may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the screening of applicants for this position. Please check out our stance on using AI in recruitment here . We are student-focused, digitally forward, and committed to academic excellence. The Role Lead UK and global student recruitment by managing agent partnerships, developing new business, improving conversion and compliance, and supporting teams to achieve growth targets. Manage between 12-18 agent/accounts and ensure they are meeting expectations and are providing the quality of learners that is expected. Identifying potential new agents/accounts/businesses to further develop UKBDL and UKDL student recruitment and any other global remit. Managing junior business development executives and supporting teams – Ensuring their activities support the objectives of student recruitment. Providing a smooth journey for both the agent/account and students, ensuring the application process is efficient to support improved conversion. This can include getting feedback from relevant parties to continuously improve processes. Have a detailed understanding of all systems used by both agents and students to ensure advice and guidance in this area is clear Ensuring KPI’s set by the Head of Business Development are met. This includes delivery of targets set via agents/account, onboarding new business, improving conversion rate from application to enrolment, and improving brand awareness in existing and new markets. Proactively support all colleagues in pursuit of the University’s central objectives and values within the business at all levels. Gathering intelligence and data to propose new initiative to further develop new and existing UK and global opportunities. This will include – interpreting of data, and articulating key messages, and publishing papers for relevant committees. Ensure that the University’s reputation is protected by getting all agents/accounts to adhere to the University’s processes and acting with integrity internally and externally. Part of this to ensure existing and new agents/businesses recommended have a good track record in HE Adhere to the universities admissions processes and regulations ensuring a clear audit trail for training and compliance purposes. Ensuring all students recruited through agent meets the required levels of progression/AU benchmark, this will include the continuous auditing of students referred via agents. 2. Analysis and Reporting Identify gaps or shortfalls in recruitment strategies and identifying how to solve these issues. Analyse data/statistics, interpreting and reporting patterns and trends and highlighting and prioritising any issues for further investigation to support informed decision making. Provide daily reports on student activity to agents and partners. Provide reports and updates to key commercial leads within the business. Analysing agent performance not only from a recruitment perceptive but from a student engagement perceptive as well. 3. Customer/Service Support Provide advice to peers and partners to respond and independently resolve a range of standard and unforeseen issues, within pre-determined operational limits. Support and lead Business development Executives, support teams, and other relevant departments. Advise and update the team on regulatory/compliance/product/process changes providing appropriate training as needed. items.description: ABOUT OUTRIGHT INTERNATIONAL Founded in 1990, Outright International strives to help lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, and queer (LGBTIQ) people live safer, healthier, and more empowered lives worldwide. With staff in 18 countries and global headquarters in New York City, Outright documents human rights violations, helps resource LGBTIQ movements and allies, and advocates for the rights of LGBTIQ people. Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Programs and Grantmaking, the Program Manager will manage the program's implementation across its target regions, serving as the primary link between Outright's leadership, regional program staff, and in-country partners to ensure the program is delivered in a locally owned, demand-driven, and donor-compliant manner. Key Responsibilities Program Oversight and Implementation Lead day-to-day management of a large, multi-country grant portfolio, ensuring activities align with donor requirements and organizational strategy Coordinate across regional program staff to ensure coherent implementation in high-risk, conflict-affected, and restrictive operating environments Oversee program inception phase, including finalization of Theory of Change, MEL plan, and capacity strengthening plans with in-country partners Partner Management Manage relationships with a diverse portfolio of in-country partner organizations, including selection, risk assessment, and reassessment processes Oversee co-design and rollout of individualized capacity strengthening plans with partners, ensuring demand-driven and participatory approaches Support flexible, partner-led financing mechanisms including emergency, programmatic, and organizational development funding Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning Coordinate participatory MEL processes with partners, including outcome mapping, baselines, and qualitative assessment tools in close cooperation with Outright´s MEL team Track programmatic and contextual risk registers, escalating significant shifts and coordinating adaptive management responses Liaise with external MEL consultants and support donor-led baseline and mid-term evaluation processes Risk and Safeguarding Monitor evolving political, security, and civic-space risks across the program's regions and adjust implementation accordingly Ensure safeguarding standards (including SEAH prevention) are upheld across all partner relationships Coordinate risk-sharing arrangements and contingency planning with partners and internal compliance teams Advocacy Coordination Support in-country partners' engagement with regional and multilateral human rights mechanisms Coordinate logistics and strategic input for partner participation in international convenings and advocacy weeks Ensure advocacy priorities remain demand-driven and reflect partner-identified needs Compliance and Reporting Ensure adherence to donor financial and narrative reporting requirements across all in-country partners Coordinate with finance and grants teams on disbursement schedules, compliance checks, and sanctions screening Prepare consolidated narrative and financial reports for donor submission Qualifications restrictive, high-risk, or conflict-affected contexts Strong understanding of grantmaking, localization principles, and partner-led program design Experience with MEL frameworks, particularly outcome mapping or similar qualitative approaches Familiarity with donor compliance requirements (e.g., government or multilateral funding instruments) Cultural competency and sensitivity to SOGIESC dynamics and intersectional analysis Willingness to travel to program regions as security conditions allow Language skills relevant to program regions are considered an asset. items.description: Role Title: Clinician (Oncology / Hematology) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Clinician (Oncology / Hematology)s to contribute to a customer’s project at the forefront of AI in healthcare. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Author and review evaluation tasks that require nuanced clinical judgment, leveraging Clinical Study Reports, periodic safety reports, and regulatory correspondence in oncology and haematology. Assess the clinical defensibility of efficacy and safety conclusions, ensuring endpoints and effect sizes reflect true clinical significance. Apply advanced judgment to dose escalation, dose-limiting toxicity, modifications, adverse event grading and attribution, and the coherence of patient narratives. Evaluate benefit-risk reasoning, scrutinizing the durability of conclusions in light of new events, and the realism of described management strategies. Identify and flag content that is clinically implausible or internally inconsistent, distinguishing these from legitimate clinical variation. Provide structured, guideline-based written rationales that clearly explain the validity or limitations of clinical interpretations for a non-clinical audience. Preferred Qualifications Specialist registration or board certification in medical oncology and/or haematology, with 5+ years of post-training clinical experience. Direct involvement in clinical trials as investigator, sub-investigator, or sponsor-side medical monitor, safety physician, or clinical development physician. Proficiency with CTCAE grading, relevant response criteria (RECIST, Lugano, IMWG, IWCLL, ELN), and outcome endpoints (ORR, DoR, PFS, OS, MRD). Hands-on experience with trial documents such as protocols, investigator brochures, CSRs, safety narratives, or DSMB/IDMC materials. Demonstrated excellence in written communication, with clear, structured explanations of clinical reasoning tailored for non-clinical readers. Previous roles in medical monitoring or as medical director on oncology or haematology programmes, and committee participation (IDMC, DSMB, adjudication, or independent review committees). Peer-reviewed publication record or authorship on clinical trial manuscripts, with any exposure to AI-assisted clinical review tools seen as a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Review complex adolescent cases to assess sexual safety and exploitation (CSE/CSA) risks. Active clinical license or registration in good standing. Current or recent (within the last two years) adolescent caseload or safeguarding practice. Demonstrated expertise in CSE/CSA risk assessment and mandatory-reporting requirements. Strong skills in trauma-informed practice and documentation. Exceptional written communication in research-grade English (native, or IELTS 7.5+/writing 7.0+, TOEFL 100+, Cambridge C1–C2, or equivalent). Experience in a designated safeguarding or expert-witness capacity, and familiarity with ACEs and trauma frameworks, is a plus. Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24 – 48 hours of completing onboarding. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: External Communications Strategist
items.summary: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?
items.description: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference? Make an impact. Join PMI. How will you make a difference to PMI? The External Communications Strategist III is an execution-first, senior individual contributor responsible for driving earned media opportunities and narrative enablement in support of PMI’s corporate reputation, thought leadership, and strategic priorities. This role sits within the PR + Communications team and operates with a high degree of autonomy, judgment, and ownership. As a Level III individual contributor, this role is expected to operate as a trusted advisor within Communications—anticipating opportunities, identifying risks, and independently driving work forward while ensuring alignment to broader narrative and reputational priorities. You will provide strategic counsel to senior stakeholders on external narrative direction, message discipline, and reputational considerations, and recommend narrative adjustments based on trends, current events, and performance insights. What you’ll bring to the role: Earned Media Strategy & Agency Partnership Collaborate with PR agency to identify story opportunities and develop timely, compelling pitch angles aligned to priority narrative beats for both B2B and consumer audiences. Maximize PR agency performance helping to sharpen briefs, challenge thinking, and ensure proactive, high-quality execution against PMI’s strategic communications goals. Partner with PR agency (and consult with internal stakeholders, including regional and functional leads) on developing strategy and positioning for global media house moments. Partner with the broader Marketing organization to source appropriate community or executive spokespeople; vet, prepare, and align them for earned media pitching and engagements. Use media intelligence and performance insights (e.g., message pull-through, tier-1 quality, topic traction) to identify narrative opportunities and gaps, and to refine story angles and pitching strategy. Shape earned media strategies that strengthen PMI’s discoverability and influence in search and AI-driven answer environments, ensuring coverage reinforces desired brand perception, priority narratives, and authoritative topic associations. Earned & Sponsored External Opportunities Independently or collaboratively identify and execute strategic earned opportunities for PMI executives or community spokespeople to reach unaware or new audiences (e.g., third-party events, podcasts, partner activations, key account–adjacent moments). Partner with PR agency and relevant internal teams to evaluate, secure, and execute selective sponsored opportunities (e.g., panels, conferences, tentpole events) that advance PMI’s narratives and reputational goals. Assess external opportunities for narrative fit, audience value, and reputational considerations; recommend go/no-go decisions and execute approved engagements end-to-end. Identify and shape thought leadership platforms (e.g., executive bylines, strategic reports, high-impact forums, and selective partnerships) that reinforce priority narratives and differentiate PMI’s point of view. Narrative Ownership & Enablement Lead efforts for defined corporate message houses, including maintenance of current proof points, examples, and data, ensuring they reflect evolving business priorities and external context. Own external narrative governance for assigned topics (message architecture, claims/proof points, and executive-ready guidance), ensuring consistency across earned media, executive platforms, and thought leadership moments. Define what is included in narrative-specific enablement kits (e.g., message houses, executive-ready slides, talk tracks, FAQs, supporting materials) and proactively distribute to internal stakeholders and executives ahead of external opportunities. Maintain and refresh enablement kits on a regular cadence; communicate updates clearly and ensure adoption across PR, Marketing, and regional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Judgment Work closely with Director of PR & Communications, Marketing, regional teams, and agency partners to ensure narrative consistency and executional excellence across external touchpoints. Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners to align on narrative, timing, and external positioning—often without direct authority—and deliver clear recommendations (including go/no-go) in ambiguous, high-visibility situations. Maintain issues readiness for assigned narratives, including rapid response positioning, Q&A, and escalation recommendations in reputationally sensitive moments. Navigate nuanced, high-visibility topics with maturity and discretion; identify risks early (misalignment, gaps, timing, tone) and recommend solutions. Independently manage multiple workstreams and deadlines; maintain clear tracking of opportunities, deliverables, approvals, and outcomes. Role Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, or related field (or equivalent experience). 8-10+ years of experience in corporate communications, PR, or earned media–focused roles. Demonstrated experience partnering with and managing PR agencies to drive earned media outcomes. Proven track record of developing and executing proactive earned media or external engagement strategies tied to corporate narratives. Experience operating with senior-level autonomy and judgment in complex, matrixed organizations. Strong earned media instincts with the ability to translate narrative strategy into executable story angles. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex topics into clear, compelling messages. High judgment and discretion; comfortable operating in reputationally sensitive areas. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Highly organized, self-directed operator with strong prioritization and follow-through. Ability to anticipate needs, proactively identify opportunities, and execute with minimal oversight. Stakeholder management is paramount; ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment on narrative direction and recommendations. Strategic, analytical mindset with the ability to use insights and reporting to optimize external communications strategy and outcomes. Proficiency in the business language for PMI (English). Possible travel up to 5% What you can expect from us We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you.. Join us and you’ll get: an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location. skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future. access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience. flexible options to help balance work time and your time award and bonus opportunities. The salary offer will be based on several factors, including the candidate’s demonstrated skills, qualifications and relevant experience. Let’s help make the world work better for everyone. Apply today! Project Management Institute, Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. items.description: About Us Mighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events. Through its advanced technology, called people magic, Mighty helps the members of those networks build relationships with each other by surfacing the most relevant and interesting connections. Because of this novel approach and member-centered experience, Mighty has produced the most $1M communities and helped its Hosts earn over $500M. The Role As a Community Strategist, you’ll work with our premium Mighty Pro customers to help them create deeply engaging community experiences that lead to powerful outcomes. You will lead workshops, co-create launch strategies, and shape the early member experience for some of the world’s boldest and most influential Hosts. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in both structured systems and creative problem-solving, and is excited to model excellence, mentor peers, and scale success through repeatable frameworks. What You'll Do Serve as a strategic partner to new Mighty Pro Hosts during their onboarding phase as they set up their Network in the way that leads to maximum member adoption, engagement, and retention. Facilitate impactful workshops with Hosts and their teams that establish strong foundations in community design, content cadence, and engagement strategy. Deliver targeted training on feature utilization, member onboarding flows, and tactical programming to drive adoption, activation, and retention. Provide creative input and feedback on brand elements like landing pages, welcome experiences, email sequences, and network messaging to ensure a cohesive and compelling member journey. Own the development and delivery of strategic Community Design Plans—including network architecture, monthly themes, onboarding flows, and launch programming calendars. Collaborate closely with Launch Specialists and Implementation teams, providing timely information and handling lightweight setup tasks directly where appropriate. Ensure clarity, consistency, and excellence in the execution of space configuration, access structure, and end-to-end member experience. Maintain regular updates to internal stakeholders on Host performance, needs, risks, and outcomes—contributing to visibility and cross-functional alignment. Contribute to shared knowledge across the Customer Success team by capturing and scaling best practices, identifying emerging trends, and improving playbooks. What We're Looking For 6+ years of client-facing experience, ideally working with strategic accounts or supporting 5–6 figure engagements in a SaaS, media, or creator-focused business. 2+ years experience in a consulting, business coaching, or agency role. Strategic thinker and tactical executor—you can map out long-term plans, define metrics for success, and follow through on details to deliver. Deep understanding of community-building and digital member experiences; you’re passionate about helping others create belonging at scale. Excellent communicator and facilitator, with confidence in guiding executive teams through planning, decision-making, and feedback cycles. Master of meetings—you show up with a plan, gather input with nuance, read the room, and close with clear decisions and next steps. Adaptable and proactive, energized by growth and ambiguity, and always seeking ways to streamline and improve. Highly collaborative and cross-functional, thriving when working across CS, Implementation, Product, and Strategy to elevate outcomes. Radically curious, with a growth mindset and drive to keep learning about Hosts, their businesses, and how digital communities are evolving. What We Offer A dynamic, remote-first work culture that values creativity, autonomy, and bold thinking. Comprehensive benefits, including health, vision, dental, and generous paid time off. Clear opportunities for professional growth, including leadership pathways and skill development support. The chance to shape the future of how communities, creators, and brands thrive online—with the team that’s building what’s next. Join us in shaping the future of community-driven digital businesses with Mighty Pro! Compensation: The base salary for this role ranges from $80,000–$145,000, with exact compensation based on location, experience, and cost of living. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Who is Boulevard? Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most. Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? items.description: About Mozilla.org Mozilla is a mission-driven portfolio of companies and organizations working together to shape an internet that serves people and the public good. Currently, this portfolio includes: the Mozilla Foundation, which champions our mission through philanthropic risk capital; Mozilla Corporation, which makes Firefox; MZLA, which makes Thunderbird; Mozilla Ventures, which invests in responsible tech startups; Mozilla.ai, which creates open source AI developer tools; Mozilla Data Collective, a data sharing platform for human agency and fair value exchange. It also includes a handful of smaller strategic investments and Mozilla's investment reserve. Mozilla.org serves as a steward of this portfolio, managing Mozilla's assets and investments to ensure they are used to advance the vision outlined in the Mozilla Manifesto. In this role, it shapes long term strategy, allocates funding and manages Mozilla’s brands. Ultimately, its job is to enable the success of all of Mozilla’s organizations in the pursuit of the overall nonprofit mission. Over the coming years, our ambition is to actively grow the portfolio—helping existing organizations grow and mature while creating or investing in new organizations that can extend Mozilla’s reach and build long-term financial value. About the Role As a part of the Mozilla.org team, the Director, Portfolio Management sits at the intersection of portfolio planning, governance, performance management, and cross-organizational execution. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for an operator who can bring structure to complexity, translate portfolio priorities into clear plans and processes, and ensure leaders across Mozilla have the information, forums, and operating rhythms needed to make effective decisions. The role reports directly to Mozilla’s COO and, along with everyone on the Mozilla.org team, is housed within the Mozilla Management Company. Key Responsibilities Portfolio Planning & Performance Lead the portfolio planning process, integrating organizational strategies, operating plans, capital requirements and portfolio-level priorities. This includes double bottom line goal setting and capital allocation across Mozilla’s portfolio organizations. Develop and maintain the information architecture for portfolio management, including portfolio-level dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide visibility into organizational priorities, performance, risks, and dependencies. Partner with Finance and operating organization leaders to connect strategic priorities, operating plans, and resource allocation. Develop comparative analyses, benchmarks and portfolio insights. Identify trends, opportunities and areas requiring management attention. Synthesize information across the portfolio into clear insights, recommendations, and decision points for Mozilla.org leadership. Portfolio Governance & Operating Model Maintain and evolve operating frameworks, decision rights, authority matrices, and playbooks that clarify how Mozilla.org, and portfolio organizations work together. Serve as a systems thinker — constantly looking to optimize the interface between strategic ambition and operational muscle. Coordinate portfolio governance processes and help prepare materials for leadership and Board discussions. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve decision-making, and reduce unnecessary coordination across organizations. Cross-Portfolio Execution Lead or coordinate high-priority initiatives that span multiple Mozilla organizations. Translate Mozilla.org portfolio priorities into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, and delivery cadences. Surface risks and execution gaps early and work with leaders across the portfolio to resolve them. Build lightweight processes that create accountability without adding unnecessary bureaucracy. Leadership & Decision Support Serve as a strategic and operational partner to the COO and broader Mozilla.org leadership team. Design and facilitate portfolio-level operating forums and working sessions. Build trusted relationships across Mozilla’s portfolio organizations and influence effectively without relying on direct authority. What You Bring 10+ years of experience in a multi-entity holding company or an investment management, private equity, venture capital, or development finance organization. Direct prior experience in a portfolio-level role, along with experience in strategy, business operations, portfolio operations, strategic program management, or related roles. A strong connection to Mozilla’s mission and an interest in helping build an organizational model that combines mission impact with strong operational and business discipline. Familiarity with Board governance and capital allocation processes strongly preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actions. Expertise in managing qualitative and quantitative metrics tracking, dashboards, and systems thinking. Experience leading significant cross-functional initiatives involving senior stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level materials. Strong judgment and discretion when working with sensitive organizational and leadership topics. Ability to operate effectively in environments with distributed decision-making and significant stakeholder complexity. What Success Looks Like You help Mozilla.org provide an effective management and coordination layer across the Mozilla portfolio. Leaders across Mozilla understand priorities, decision rights, performance, and dependencies; portfolio-level decisions are supported by useful data and analysis; and important cross-organizational initiatives move from strategy into execution with clear ownership and accountability. Ultimately, your work helps Mozilla.org more effectively steward its organizations, resources, and mission over the long term. The Target Annual Base Salary and Pay Range for this role is between $240,000-$280,000 USD . Additionally, this role is eligible for an Annual Bonus. Applicant Privacy Notice

items.description: Customer Success Manager - Remote Application Deadline: 30 September 2026 Department: Talent Team Employment Type: Full Time Location: Philippines Reporting To: Andrew Valle Compensation: ₱60,000 - ₱80,000 / month Description Why does this role exist? This is an in-house Magic role — you'll be a Magic employee owning client relationships on behalf of the company, not a VA placed with a client. Magic's business runs on retention and expansion, and the CSM is the engine behind both. Our clients are busy founders and executives who need their remote workers to deliver real ROI — and they need a strategic partner who ensures that happens. You're not here to answer tickets. You're here to protect revenue, grow accounts, and turn satisfied clients into long-term advocates. Your success directly translates to company growth. Every account retained and every expansion closed is a measurable outcome you own. What's In It For You Compensation Salary: ₱60,000–₱80,000 gross monthly Employment type: Permanent, Full-Time Fully remote, global Benefits HMO coverage (after regularization) 12 vacation days + 10 sick days per year 13th month pay SSS, PhilHealth, PAG-IBIG Paid training Growth Path CSM (0–12 months) → Senior CSM (12–24 months) → Team Lead / CS Manager (24–36 months) → CS Director (3+ years) Magic promotes from within — top performers move into leadership, enterprise accounts, and CS strategy What Winning Looks Like You maintain 90%+ gross revenue retention and 110%+ net revenue retention across your full book of business — consistently, not occasionally You spot at-risk accounts before clients say a word, and your save plans are already in motion You run QBRs that clients actually look forward to — data-driven, strategic, and action-oriented You identify expansion opportunities organically and build the business case without being prompted Your HubSpot is always clean — account health scores current, touchpoints logged, zero renewals sneaking up on you Core Responsibilities Strategic Account Management & Revenue Growth (40%) Own a portfolio of accounts segmented by size, health, and growth potential — prioritize ruthlessly Maintain 90% gross revenue retention and drive 110%+ NRR through proactive expansion identification and closure Navigate renewals 60–90 days before expiration; address concerns and negotiate terms before they become problems Facilitate comprehensive QBRs for enterprise and growth accounts with data-driven presentations on value delivered Customer Onboarding & Enablement (25%) Execute Magic's 30-60-90 day onboarding framework for every new client; conduct kickoff calls within 24–48 hours of signing Build tailored success plans with specific milestones and success criteria for each client's business objectives Introduce clients to their remote workers and actively facilitate early relationship-building Relationship Management & Communication (20%) Build trusted advisor relationships with C-suite executives, founders, and senior decision-makers Multi-thread across client organizations to reduce churn risk from champion departure Own escalations end-to-end — intake through resolution — coordinating cross-functionally to deliver results Data, Reporting & Process Improvement (15%) Analyze usage data and behavioral patterns to predict churn risk and expansion potential Prepare monthly portfolio health reports tracking retention rate, NRR, CSAT, NPS, and QBR completion Document playbooks, identify process inefficiencies, and share learnings with the broader CSM team Required Experience What You Bring 3–5 years of B2B customer success or account management experience managing a portfolio of accounts simultaneously Direct ownership of revenue retention and expansion targets, with proven experience from onboarding through renewal US market experience — strong understanding of US business culture, SMB challenges, and executive communication norms HubSpot proficiency (or expert-level Salesforce with transferable skills) used daily for pipeline and health tracking Intermediate to advanced Excel/Google Sheets — pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX MATCH, dashboards, trend analysis Strong English proficiency, written and spoken, at a level sufficient for daily C-level and Director-level client conversations Your Superpowers Strategic Relationship Builder · Proactive Problem Solver · Data-Driven Thinker · Ownership Mentality · Resilient & Adaptable · Cross-Functional Influencer Our Hiring Process Application + Pre-Qualifying Questions → HR Interview (45 min) → 24-Hour Reflection Period → Panel Interview with Senior CSMs → Interview with CS Leadership → Final Interview with Head of Sales & CS → Background Check → Job Offer The Reality This is a US-hours role. Your shift follows Eastern Time (9:00 AM–8:00 PM ET, Monday–Friday), with occasional flexibility for West Coast clients or urgent situations. You'll be running client calls, managing escalations, and tracking account health across a live portfolio — every single day. If you thrive on ownership and outcomes, this is the environment for you. Before You Apply — Quick Gut Check Do you have 3–5 years of B2B customer success or account management experience with direct revenue retention accountability? Is your English strong enough for daily executive-level conversations with U.S.-based C-level and Director clients? Do you approach customer success as a revenue-driving function — not a reactive support role? Do you have a professional home office setup with high-speed internet (50+ Mbps), a headset, and a quiet environment right now? If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. About Magic Magic is a leading modern outsourcing platform that connects SMBs to high-quality remote workers, from SDRs to virtual assistants and more. With roots in Silicon Valley and backing from top venture capitalists, our workers are supercharged with a combination of the latest AI technology and training. We came out of Y Combinator in 2015, have grown to 1,000+ remote workers, and are backed by Sequoia Capital with over $30M in funding.

items.description: To learn the Hiring Ranges for this position, please select your location from the Apply Now dropdown menu. To learn more about our Hiring Range System, please click this link. Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: In the past few years, Marketing has emerged as a key vector and focus of Firefox’s growth, with Data Science playing an essential role in evaluating Marketing’s impact and developing clear strategies to ensure that success. Marketing Data Science supports Firefox through the standard fare of marketing (ongoing measurement, experimentation/lift testing, adhoc analysis, forecasting/budget optimization), and beyond that as thought leaders at Firefox in translating broad goals into clearly defined objectives and identifying the path towards succeeding in them. In this role, you will continue to build on the Marketing team’s recent successes as Firefox’s Marketing program continues to expand its footprint throughout the funnel. You’ll look to support this success in owning global data strategy for Firefox Marketing, developing new data capabilities to unlock future business growth, collaborating with Data Science counterparts in other domains domains, and working closely across marketing and adjacent cross-functional teams to translate your team’s work into practical recommendations and enablement that drive Firefox’s growth. What you’ll do: Set the strategy and roadmap for Marketing Data Science, prioritizing the highest-impact opportunities with key partners. Establish goals and measurement approaches for attribution, ROI, and campaign performance; deliver insights that improve marketing investment and outcomes. Lead and develop the team’s core capabilities across: Performance marketing: budget optimization, causal lift measurement, and conversion-signal testing Brand marketing: measurement planning and assessment of long-term and lower-funnel impact User insights: retention/LTV modeling and audience segmentation Reporting and infrastructure: build self-service dashboards, deliver ad hoc and executive reporting, and develop scalable data models and internal tools that expand our understanding of the acquisition landscape. Bring a forward-looking perspective on advertising, media innovation, and marketing analytics methods. Partner with Data Science leaders to evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging AI tools that improve team workflows and impact. What you’ll bring: 6+ years of marketing data science experience, ideally at a media agency or in-house marketing organization. Proficiency with marketing analytics tools, including Google Analytics and advertising platforms, and familiarity with modeling methods such as MMM, causal lift/synthetic control, saturation modeling, optimization, and Bayesian approaches. Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing talent, with strong stakeholder management and the ability to prioritize multiple complex workstreams. Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to tailor data-driven insights and recommendations to different audiences. What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly well-being stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla , you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose. items.description: At Bondora , our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone. Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products. As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value. Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together! What is this role about? 🚀 As a Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager at Bondora , you'll take ownership of the affiliate marketing channel for Go & Grow, managing and growing the partnerships that bring new investors to the platform. You'll work with content creators, publishers, comparison sites, communities, and affiliate networks across Europe, while building a strong pipeline of new partners. This is a highly autonomous, hands-on role where you'll combine partner management with business development — strengthening existing relationships, sourcing and onboarding new affiliates, negotiating commercial agreements, and using data and AI to continuously improve partner performance. You'll work closely with Product, Data, Engineering, Brand, CRM, Legal, and Compliance to optimise the full journey from first click to long-term investor value. You'll have the opportunity to own and shape one of Go & Grow's key growth channels , with direct access to senior leadership and significant freedom to improve how the affiliate programme operates and scales. Your main responsibilities 🎯 Own and Execute the affiliate marketing channel strategy, operating plan, forecast and performance. Source, qualify and close direct partnerships with affiliates (in other words publishers: content creators, comparison sites, communities and relevant affiliate networks). Create clear segmentation, outreach, onboarding and activation routines that move partners from prospect to live Design and negotiate CPA, CPL, fixed-fee and hybrid deals Define and improve the funnel from click and sign-up through funded investor, first 30-day deposits, repeat deposits and 30/60/90-day retained value. Operate and improve Target Circle/Circlewise Build partner- and cohort-level reporting covering acquisition cost, revenue (deposits) value, retention, net revenue (net deposits) Test placements, content, landing pages, incentives, creative and localized messaging with Brand, CRM, Product and Design. Apply country-specific financial-promotion rules, execute approval workflows, required disclosures, content monitoring and documentation together with Legal and Compliance. What would ensure success in this role?💪 Expert in at least one partner management platform (Affiliate platforms such as Target Circle/Circlewise, Impact, Awin or Partnerize, CJ Advanced Excel or Google Sheets and BI dashboard experience AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools for data analysis, partner research and qualification, and content/compliance review, with strong judgment on when human verification is essential. Fluent in English and German is a plus What can you expect at Bondora ? 🎯 Be part of Bondora ’s ambitious journey toward 1BN in revenue - your work will have a real impact. 💰 Enjoy a competitive salary and amazing benefits: 5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental health support, share options, and much more! 📈 Work in an environment that encourages growth and innovation - with resources and budget for continuous learning. The next steps If you have the guts, ideas, and a team vision, apply now! Our hiring process: 1️⃣ Meet Anna , our Recruiter — your first chat to share your story and ambitions. 2️⃣ Meet Krzysztof Schmidt , CMO at Go&Grow 3️⃣ Tackle a home task to showcase your skills. 4️⃣ Complete our personality and logic assessments via Alva Labs. 5️⃣ Meeting Pärtel Tomberg , CEO of Bondora 6️⃣ Chat with Olga Kikas , our Chief of People 7️⃣ 🎉 If the stars align — welcome to Bondora ! Join our team of Bondorians, and let's make it happen! If you'd like to read how Bondora collects, uses, and protects your personal data during recruitment, please see HERE. items.description: Description Anchor closed $40M in top-tier VC funding and grew 500% last year, transforming the $74B services payments market. Our platform automates billing and collections so businesses can focus on growth. At Anchor, we’re redefining the future of B2B Payments. Our innovative, end-to-end billing and collections platform eliminates the frustrations of manual processes, making financial workflows seamless, automated, and stress-free. We empower businesses to focus on their core strengths while we handle the complexities of billing and collections. Our Customer Support organization sits at the core of Anchor and is a key driver for our growth, ensuring every customer has an exceptional experience. As we continue to grow rapidly, we’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Director of Customer Success to build, grow, and lead our customer organization across the entire journey - from onboarding through activation and retention. Reporting directly to the COO of Anchor, the ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional ownership, a holistic business mindset, meticulous attention to detail, and a consultative, action-oriented approach that truly sets them apart. Responsibility Lead and scale Anchor’s Customer Success function across the full customer journey—from onboarding to long-term retention. Develop and execute a comprehensive CS strategy that aligns with customer goals and drives measurable value. Own and evolve onboarding, account management, and customer support processes that maximize adoption and satisfaction. Build deep, trusted relationships with customers—including executive stakeholders—and act as their strategic advisor. Define and track KPIs to measure customer health, satisfaction, and team effectiveness; drive data-informed improvements. Own systems and tooling for customer success (e.g., ticketing, reporting, support infrastructure). Build and maintain a robust knowledge base for internal and customer use. Collaborate closely with product, sales, R&D, and marketing to represent the voice of the customer and shape our roadmap. Develop customer success stories and use cases for both internal learning and external marketing. Hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing CS team that delivers excellence at scale. Requirements 2+ years of experience managing CS team leaders, plus 3+ years leading CS teams directly in a fast-paced, data-driven, B2B SaaS company- (Fintech experience is a strong plus.) Highly detailed and structured professional, with experience designing and implementing scalable CS processes. Superb capabilities in managing even the most challenging customer relationships—able to turn difficult moments into positive, productive outcomes. A highly motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative, prioritize effectively, and adapt quickly. items.description: About Dutchie Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups. Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors. About This Role Dutchie is looking for a Senior Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst to help drive the financial operating rhythm of the company. You’ll partner across Finance, Accounting, and business leaders to build forecasts, evaluate performance, improve planning processes, and deliver insights that influence executive decision-making. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable financial infrastructure, automating manual work, and using data to tell compelling business stories. You’ll report to the Senior Director of FP&A while helping establish the next generation of planning capabilities across Dutchie . What You’ll Do Financial Planning & Forecasting Own portions of the annual operating plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range financial planning process. Develop financial models that improve visibility into company performance and future investment decisions. Analyze monthly results, identify business drivers, and communicate actionable insights to leadership. Partner closely with Accounting to ensure accurate reporting and alignment between actuals, forecasts, and KPIs. Operational Excellence Improve and automate planning workflows using AI, modern financial tooling, and scalable processes. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual reporting through automation and self-service analytics. Help evolve executive reporting and dashboards that improve decision-making across the organization. Support board materials, leadership presentations, and strategic planning initiatives. Cross-Functional Partnership Collaborate across R&D, G&A, and Operations to understand business performance and financial impact. Become a trusted finance partner capable of simplifying complex business questions into clear financial recommendations. Help establish consistent planning disciplines as Dutchie continues to scale. What You’ll Bring 3–5 years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, or corporate finance. Advanced financial modeling and Excel skills with experience building dynamic forecasting models. Experience working in high-growth SaaS or technology environments preferred. Strong analytical curiosity and comfort working through ambiguity. Experience leveraging AI tools to automate analysis, improve workflows, and increase productivity. Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into executive-ready recommendations. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field. What You’ll Get We are targeting a starting salary of $124,000 - $166,000 based on the intended level for this role. In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes: Full medical benefits including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care. Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees. Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance Flexible vacation and sick days At Dutchie , we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Dutchie believes that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. items.title: Product Designer
items.summary: Shape the Future on AutopilotAt Autopilot, you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works.
items.description: Shape the Future on Autopilot At Autopilot , you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works. As a Product Designer , you’ll own product experiences end-to-end and help redefine what great UX means in a complex, data-driven industry. We’re building a high-performance, AI-native Fintech Operating System designed to optimize cost and revenue for digital businesses. Join us on a multi-year mission to build smarter infrastructure for commerce. Why Join Us? You’ll help build an ambitious product from the ground up, with a team that values speed, craft, and autonomy. If you’re ready to make an outsized impact in fintech, we’d love to meet you. About the Role You'll join a fast-moving team building modern, data-intensive web applications that help digital businesses operate more intelligently. This is a founding design role with strong emphasis on product logic, systems thinking, and end-to-end collaboration with engineers. 🛠️ What You'll Do Translate complex financial logic and backend systems into intuitive user flows Design dashboards, workflows, and visual systems for payments, orchestration, and automation Build and maintain our scalable design system in Figma (aligned with React components) Collaborate with engineers on real-world UX states — success, failure, pending, retry Prototype and validate features with real data and user context Participate in product discussions, shaping user journeys before pixels are drawn Uphold usability and domain accuracy as the standard for design quality 🎯 What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience designing digital products with complex logic (fintech, B2B SaaS, or data-heavy systems preferred) Strong product and systems thinking — you design for states and workflows , not just screens Deep Figma expertise (Auto Layout, Variants, Tokens, Components) Ability to translate backend logic, APIs, and data models into coherent user experiences Excellent communication and documentation skills (Linear, Figma, Slack) Comfortable working directly with engineers and iterating quickly without handoffs 🌟 Bonus Points Experience in fintech, payments, or compliance-related products Exposure to analytics or developer tooling Understanding of design-to-code workflows (React component parity, tokens) Strong interaction or motion design craft (Framer, ProtoPie, etc.) Our Hiring Process We focus on real-world collaboration, not design showreels. Here’s what to expect: Apply with LinkedIn Profile And Resume We’ll review based on the requirements above. If shortlisted, you’ll receive an email to schedule a 90-minute live design collaboration session once you’re comfortable with our pre-interview brief. 90-Minute Live Design Collaboration You’ll work with our product and engineering team on a small feature challenge — from user problem to Figma prototype. We’ll look at: How you think through logic and flows How you translate constraints into UX decisions Your interaction, hierarchy, and state management How you communicate trade-offs and rationale The session mirrors our actual workflow: accessible pragmatic collaborative Design Review & Feedback After the session, we’ll walk through your design decisions together. You’ll get feedback from our CTO and team, and discuss potential improvements or extensions to your solution. Culture & Alignment Chat A final call with CEO to discuss your long-term goals, how you work best, and whether Autopilot is the right fit for both sides. Originally posted on Himalayas
