items.title: Revenue Cycle Denials Consultant-Project Management
items.summary: Wilshire hires only the brightest and most experienced professionals in the healthcare revenue cycle management industry.
items.description: Wilshire hires only the brightest and most experienced professionals in the healthcare revenue cycle management industry. Wilshire will take the time to get know you and your employment history. We will then place you in a role that will lead to a path of career success. Revenue Cycle Denials Consultant – Project Management The Wilshire Group | Remote | Contract | 6 Months Compensation: $80.00 per hour About The Wilshire Group The Wilshire Group is a boutique healthcare consulting firm specializing in revenue cycle, Epic, and healthcare technology solutions. We work with healthcare organizations to improve financial performance, optimize revenue cycle operations, and successfully navigate complex transformation initiatives. We are seeking an experienced Revenue Cycle Denials Consultant with strong project management experience to support a client engagement focused on denials management and revenue cycle performance. About the Opportunity This is a 6-month remote contract opportunity for a seasoned revenue cycle professional who combines hands-on denials expertise with the ability to manage projects, coordinate stakeholders, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive initiatives through completion. The ideal consultant will understand the full denials lifecycle—from prevention and root-cause analysis through follow-up, appeals, resolution, and reporting—and have the project management skills necessary to lead improvement initiatives across revenue cycle teams. Key Responsibilities Assess current denials processes, workflows, and performance. Analyze denial trends and identify root causes, opportunities, and areas of financial risk. Develop and implement strategies to reduce preventable denials and improve overall revenue cycle performance. Lead denials-related projects and initiatives from planning through implementation. Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and status reporting. Coordinate activities across revenue cycle teams and other key stakeholders. Facilitate project meetings and communicate progress, risks, issues, and opportunities. Monitor project deliverables and ensure initiatives remain on track. Evaluate denial data and develop actionable recommendations for improvement. Partner with operational leaders and revenue cycle stakeholders to implement process improvements. Identify opportunities to improve workflows, payer processes, authorization practices, coding, billing, and other upstream factors contributing to denials. Support the development and implementation of denial prevention strategies. Track key performance indicators and measure the impact of improvement initiatives. Assist with developing standard operating procedures, workflows, and process documentation. Provide subject matter expertise related to revenue cycle denials and best practices. Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to both operational and executive-level stakeholders. Qualifications 7+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience , with significant experience in denials management. Strong knowledge of the end-to-end revenue cycle and denials management process . Demonstrated experience identifying denial trends and performing root-cause analysis. Experience developing and implementing denial prevention and reduction strategies. Project management experience required. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple project workstreams, timelines, and deliverables. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience working with revenue cycle data, reporting, and performance metrics. Strong understanding of payer requirements and denial/appeal processes. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently in a consulting environment while effectively collaborating with client teams. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to communicate complex revenue cycle issues and recommendations to executive and operational stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading revenue cycle transformation or optimization projects. Experience working with large health systems or complex healthcare organizations. Experience with Epic or other major EHR/PM systems. Formal project management certification such as PMP, CAPM, or equivalent is a plus. Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, finance, or a related field is preferred. Contract Details Position: Revenue Cycle Denials Consultant – Project Management Contract: 6 months Location: Remote Hourly Rate: $80.00 per hour Start Date: Based on project requirements Why Join The Wilshire Group ? The Wilshire Group offers experienced healthcare professionals the opportunity to apply their expertise to meaningful consulting engagements while working alongside a team that understands the complexity of today's healthcare environment. If you are a revenue cycle denials expert who can turn analysis into action and lead a project from strategy through execution , we'd love to hear from you. Join The Wilshire Group and bring your expertise to the next challenge. Wilshire is honored that you have taken the time to review/apply to our open position. We will now take the time to review your experience and be in touch with you soon. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Revenue Operations Specialist (SaaS)
items.summary: Role Title: Revenue Operations Specialist (SaaS)Role Type: ContractorLocation: Remotemicro1 is engaging Revenue Operations Specialists (SaaS) to contribute to a customer's project focused on elevating operational effectiveness and data integrity in complex SaaS business environments.
items.description: Role Title: Revenue Operations Specialist (SaaS) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Revenue Operations Specialists (SaaS) to contribute to a customer's project focused on elevating operational effectiveness and data integrity in complex SaaS business environments. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideally suited for a professional with hands-on ownership of CRM systems and adjacent SaaS revenue tools, especially in regulated or multi-product contexts where operational judgment and clear communication are essential. Scope of Work: Assess and refine CRM data models to align with evolving sales, customer success, and revenue operations requirements. Identify, arbitrate, and document resolutions for conflicting operational policies, explaining logical choices and tradeoffs. Design and validate compliance-constrained workflows for SaaS revenue processes, ensuring adherence to vertical-specific regulations. Diagnose and address gaps in revenue data integrity, supporting accurate, actionable reporting and analytics. Deliver detailed process walk-throughs based on personal system configuration experience, highlighting decision points and lessons learned. Contribute written and verbal insights for scenario-based operational training tasks in collaboration with project stakeholders. Recommend system improvements with a focus on scalability, compliance, and cross-functional alignment. Preferred Qualifications 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience in SaaS revenue, sales, customer success, or implementation operations (not adjacent or management-only exposure). Proven CRM ownership (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) with configuration experience, plus at least two additional tools such as billing, CPQ, ticketing, or project tracking. Demonstrated ability to resolve policy conflicts and explain operational tradeoffs in high-complexity, high-compliance environments (fintech, healthtech, insurtech, or similar fields strongly preferred). Strong operational judgment: adept at making and justifying process decisions where rules, regulations, or business needs intersect. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of documenting logic and collaborating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience in process design for regulated industries or multi-product SaaS implementations, with a focus on compliance and reporting accuracy. Comfort navigating ambiguity, prioritizing what to change versus what to leave stable, and articulating the rationale behind each decision. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: চাকরির বিবরণ আপনি কি বিস্তারিত বিষয়ে মনোযোগী ব্যক্তি যার গবেষণার প্রতি আবেগ এবং জাতীয় এবং স্থানীয় ভূগোলের ভালো বোঝাপড়া আছে? এই ফ্রিল্যান্স সুযোগ আপনাকে নিজের গতিতে এবং নিজের বাড়ির আরামে কাজ করতে দেয়। একজন অনলাইন ডেটা বিশ্লেষকের একটি দিন: এই ভূমিকায়, আপনি একটি প্রকল্পে কাজ করবেন যা বিশ্বব্যাপী লক্ষ লক্ষ মানুষ দ্বারা ব্যবহৃত ডিজিটাল মানচিত্রের বিষয়বস্তু এবং গুণমান উন্নত করার লক্ষ্যে রয়েছে। ওয়েব-ভিত্তিক পরিবেশে গবেষণা এবং মূল্যায়ন কাজ সম্পন্ন করা যেমন ডেটা যাচাই এবং তুলনা করা, এবং তথ্যের প্রাসঙ্গিকতা ও নির্ভুলতা নির্ধারণ করা। আজই আমাদের সাথে যোগ দিন এবং একটি গতিশীল এবং উদ্ভাবনী দলের অংশ হন যা বিশ্বে পরিবর্তন আনছে! TELUS Digital AI Community আমাদের বৈশ্বিক AI কমিউনিটি হলো বিভিন্ন পটভূমির দশ লক্ষেরও বেশি অবদানকারীর একটি প্রাণবন্ত নেটওয়ার্ক। তাঁরা গ্রাহকদের উন্নতমানের AI মডেল তৈরির লক্ষ্যে কন্টেন্ট সংগ্রহ, পরিমার্জন, প্রশিক্ষণ, অনুবাদ এবং স্থানীয়করণের কাজে সহায়তা করেন। আমাদের ক্রমবর্ধমান এই কমিউনিটির অংশ হোন এবং বিশ্বের শীর্ষস্থানীয় কিছু ব্র্যান্ডের ব্যবহৃত উদ্ভাবনী AI প্রযুক্তির উন্নয়নে অবদান রাখুন। যোগ্যতার পথ এই ভূমিকায় আবেদন করার জন্য কোন পূর্ববর্তী পেশাদার অভিজ্ঞতার প্রয়োজন নেই, তবে এই প্রকল্পে কাজ করার জন্য আপনাকে মৌলিক প্রয়োজনীয়তাগুলি পূরণ করতে এবং একটি মান মূল্যায়ন প্রক্রিয়ার মধ্য দিয়ে যেতে হবে। এটি একটি অংশ-সময়ের দীর্ঘমেয়াদী প্রকল্প এবং আপনার কাজ এই চুক্তির শর্তাবলীতে আমাদের মান গুণমান নিশ্চিতকরণ পরীক্ষার সাপেক্ষে থাকবে। মৌলিক প্রয়োজনীয়তা বাংলা এবং ইংরেজি ভাষায় সম্পূর্ণ পেশাদার দক্ষতা গত ৫ বছর ধরে ভারতের বাসিন্দা থাকা এবং ভারতের বর্তমান এবং ঐতিহাসিক ব্যবসা, মিডিয়া, ক্রীড়া, সংবাদ, সোশ্যাল মিডিয়া এবং সাংস্কৃতিক বিষয়ে পরিচিত থাকা নির্দেশিকা অনুসরণ করার এবং সার্চ ইঞ্জিন, অনলাইন মানচিত্র এবং ওয়েবসাইট তথ্য ব্যবহার করে অনলাইন গবেষণা পরিচালনা করার ক্ষমতা মানচিত্র, সংবাদ, অডিও কাজ এবং প্রাসঙ্গিকতা সহ বিভিন্ন ধরনের কাজ জুড়ে কাজ করার নমনীয়তা প্রতিদিন ব্রডব্যান্ড ইন্টারনেট সংযোগ, কম্পিউটার এবং প্রাসঙ্গিক সফটওয়্যার অ্যাক্সেস মূল্যায়ন প্রোগ্রামে নিয়োগ করার জন্য, আপনি একটি খোলা বই যোগ্যতা পরীক্ষা নেবেন যা আপনার এই অবস্থানের জন্য উপযুক্ততা নির্ধারণ করবে এবং আইডি যাচাইকরণ সম্পন্ন করবেন। আমাদের দল আপনার যোগ্যতা পরীক্ষার আগে নির্দেশিকা এবং শেখার উপকরণ প্রদান করবে। আপনাকে নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের মধ্যে পরীক্ষা সম্পন্ন করতে হবে কিন্তু আপনার সুবিধা অনুযায়ী। এখানে আবেদন করুন: স্বাধীন ঠিকাদার সম্পর্ক এই সুযোগটি একজন স্বতন্ত্র ঠিকাদার (independent contractor) হিসেবে কাজ করার ভিত্তিতে প্রদান করা হচ্ছে। প্রকল্পের প্রাপ্যতা ও গুণগত মানের শর্ত সাপেক্ষে, অবদানকারীরা কখন এবং কতটা কাজ করবেন, তা নির্ধারণ করার স্বাধীনতা তাদের রয়েছে। এই সুযোগটিকে TELUS Digital-এর সাথে কোনো কর্মসংস্থান বা চাকরির সম্পর্ক হিসেবে গণ্য করা যাবে না। Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ವಿವರಣೆ ನೀವು ವಿವರಗಳಿಗೆ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೇ, ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಗಾಧ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕತೆಯ ಉತ್ತಮ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ?
items.description: ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ವಿವರಣೆ ನೀವು ವಿವರಗಳಿಗೆ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೇ, ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಗಾಧ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕತೆಯ ಉತ್ತಮ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ? ಈ ಫ್ರೀಲ್ಯಾನ್ಸ್ ಅವಕಾಶವು ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸ್ವಂತ ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಘರದ ಸುವಿಧೆಯಿಂದ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲು ಅನುಮತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಡೇಟಾ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಕನ ಜೀವನದ ಒಂದು ದಿನ: ಈ ಪಾತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ನೀವು ವಿಶ್ವಾದ್ಯಂತ ಲಕ್ಷಲಕ್ಷ ಜನರು ಬಳಸುವ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ವಿಷಯವಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಗುಣಮಾನವನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸುವ ಗುರಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವಿರಿ. ವೆಬ್-ಆಧಾರಿತ ಪರಿಸರದಲ್ಲಿ ಡೇಟಾ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಮತ್ತು ತುಲನೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಾಸಂಗಿಕತೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಖುರತೆ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುವುದುಹೀಗಿನ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸುವುದು. ಇಂದು ನಮ್ಮೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಆನುವುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಶೀಲ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಭಾವನೀ ಹೃದಯದ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರಿ! TELUS Digital AI Community ನಮ್ಮ ಜಾಗತಿಕ AI ಸಮುದಾಯವು ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಗಳಿರುವ ಹತ್ತು ಲಕ್ಷಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೊಡುಗೆದಾರರ ಒಂದು ಕ್ರಿಯಾಶೀಲ ಜಾಲವಾಗಿದೆ. ಉತ್ತಮ AI ಮಾದರಿಗಳನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಿರುವ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು (content) ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಲು, ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸಲು, ತರಬೇತಿ ನೀಡಲು, ಅನುವಾದಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಇವರು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ನಮ್ಮ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಮುದಾಯದ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವದ ಕೆಲವು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಗಳು ಬಳಸುವ ನವೀನ AI ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನಗಳ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೊಡುಗೆಯನ್ನು ನೀಡಿ. ಯೋಗ್ಯತೆ ಹಾದಿ ಈ ಪಾತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಲು ಯಾವುದೇ ಹಿಂದಿನ ವೃತ್ತಿಮಾನ ಅನುಭವದ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ, ಆದಾಗ್ಯೂ ಈ ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲು ನೀವು ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಮೂಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಹೋಗಬೇಕು. ಇದು ಒಂದು ಅರ್ಧ-ಸಮಯದ ದೀರ್ಘಾವಧಿಯ ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸವು ಈ ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ಖಚಿತ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಳಪಟ್ಟಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಗಳು ಕನ್ನಡ ಮತ್ತು ಇಂಗ್ರಜಿ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ವೃತ್ತಿಮಾನ ನಿಪುಣತೆ ಕಳೆದ 5 ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿವಾಸಿ ಆಗಿರುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಮತ್ತು ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ, ಮಾಧ್ಯಮ, ಕ್ರೀಡೆ, ಸುದ್ದಿ, ಸೋಶ್ಯಲ್ ಮೀಡಿಯಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಪರಿಚಯವಿರುವುದು ಮಾರ್ಗನಿರ್ದೇಶನಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಚ್ ಇಂಜಿನ್‌ಗಳು, ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಬಳಸಿ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ನಡೆಸಲು ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು, ಸುದ್ದಿ, ಆಡಿಯೋ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತತೆ ಸಹ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರಗಳಾದ್ಯಂತ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲು ನಮ್ಯತೆ ಬ್ರಾಡ್‌ಬ್যಾಂಡ್ ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ, ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್‌ಗೆ ದೈನಿಕ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಮೂಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಯೋಜಿತರಾಗುವುದಕ್ಕೆ, ನೀವು ಒಂದು ಓಪನ್ ಬುಕ್ ಯೋಗ್ಯತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೀರಿ ಅದು ಆ ಪಾತ್ರದ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಐಡಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೀರಿ. ನಮ್ಮ ತಂಡವು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಯೋಗ್ಯತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಮೊದಲು ನಿಮಗೆ items.title: Identity Trust & Fraud Intelligence Specialist - Intermediate (AI Community)
items.summary: Job description About the Role: At TELUS Digital, we are building the "Shield of Trust" for global digital identity.
items.description: Job description About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are building the "Shield of Trust" for global digital identity. You will join an elite freelance pool focused on training AI to detect fraud, verify identity documents, and maintain the highest standards of KYC (Know Your Customer) . Your role is to teach AI models how to distinguish between a real human and a high-fidelity synthetic mask, and between a genuine passport and a masterfully forged document. At TELUS, you ensure that digital access remains secure for everyone. Key Responsibilities: Document Authenticity Auditing: Review and annotate high-resolution scans of international IDs (Passports, Visas, Licenses) to identify microscopic markers of forgery or tampering. Liveness & Biometric Verification: Evaluate "Liveness" test data to help AI detect deepfakes, playback attacks, or 3D masks during the face-matching process. OCR & PII Data Validation: Audit the accuracy of AI-extracted data (Name, DOB, Expiry) from documents, ensuring the model handles different scripts and localized document formats. Adversarial Fraud Testing: Act as a "Fraudster" by testing the system with edge-case documents and synthetic identities to find vulnerabilities in the KYC model. Qualification path Mandatory Qualifications: Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Cybersecurity, Criminal Justice, Forensic Science, or Information Security. Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory to identify localized document types and regional identity nuances. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English. Analytical Eye: Exceptional attention to detail, specifically in identifying pixel-level anomalies in digital images. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. Apply Here: ﻿ Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Contact email Originally posted on Himalayas

As our business and product portfolio continue to grow, we are strengthening our Talent Acquisition team and looking for a Senior Recruiter to own complex, business-critical hiring across the company. This is a full-cycle role with a strong focus on direct search, hiring manager partnership, and measurable outcomes. You will lead 4-6 roles at a time - including Senior, Lead, and Head-level positions - and help us build the systems that make every next hire more focused, predictable, and effective. What You’ll Do Own 4-6 vacancies end to end, with a focus on senior, leadership, and business-critical roles. Partner with hiring managers from the kick-off stage: clarify the business need, shape a realistic candidate profile, define the scorecard, and align on the hiring process. Build a sourcing strategy for each role, including talent-market mapping, donor-company research, Boolean and X-ray search, LinkedIn sourcing, and personalized outreach sequences. Proactively engage passive candidates instead of relying mainly on inbound applications. Conduct structured interviews, assess candidates against agreed criteria, and provide clear, evidence-based recommendations. Prepare and calibrate hiring managers and interviewers to ensure consistent, high-quality assessment across all stages. Own the recruitment funnel and use data to identify bottlenecks, improve stage conversions, and keep stakeholders aligned on progress and risks. Manage the offer process and candidate communication through to the person’s first working day. Bring market intelligence to the business: talent availability, compensation expectations, competitor insights, and realistic hiring timelines. What We’re Looking For 6+ years of experience in full-cycle recruitment, including at least 4 years in a product IT company. Experience hiring for Growth Marketing, Product, Analytics, or Engineering roles. Experience in B2C subscription products, mobile apps, EdTech, or another high-growth digital environment. A proven track record of closing Senior, Lead, or Head-level roles, with the ability to explain your approach, funnel metrics, timelines, and results. Strong hands-on sourcing expertise and confidence working with passive talent across multiple channels. Experience partnering with hiring managers, challenging unclear or unrealistic requirements, and translating business needs into an actionable search strategy. A structured, data-informed approach to recruitment: you understand funnel metrics, conversion rates, and how to use them to improve outcomes. Experience with competency-based assessment, scorecards, and structured interviews. Strong ownership and communication skills, with the ability to manage several priorities and keep stakeholders aligned. Practical use of AI tools in day-to-day recruiting - for research, sourcing, communication, analysis, or workflow automation. Fluency in Ukrainian with English at B2 level or above. Why You’ll Love Working With Us High-impact hiring: You’ll own roles that directly affect product delivery, team capability, and business growth. Room to shape the function: Our Talent Acquisition system is evolving, and you’ll have a real voice in how we build processes, tools, and standards. Direct partnership: You’ll work closely with hiring managers and business leaders, with clear access to decision-makers. AI-enabled workflow: We provide access to AI subscriptions and modern recruiting tools to automate routine work and focus on higher-value decisions. Health support: We offer medical expense compensation. Work-life balance: You’ll have flexible paid time off, including 21 days of annual leave plus 10 bank holidays. Collaborative culture: You’ll work with curious, driven people who value ownership, clarity, and evidence-based decisions. Hiring Process Introductory call with the Head of People - 30 minutes. Functional interview - 60 minutes. Live recruitment case - 60 minutes, with no take-home assignment. Final meeting - 30 minutes. If you enjoy solving complex hiring challenges, working closely with the business, and building systems rather than simply following them, we’d love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI?
items.description: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple conversational tools into systems capable of analyzing financial markets, interpreting investment strategies, and supporting decision-making across asset classes. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can help improve financial literacy, strengthen portfolio analysis, and support investors and analysts worldwide. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for individuals with familiarity in areas such as equity and fixed-income markets, portfolio management, asset allocation, derivatives, valuation methods, financial modeling, risk management, behavioral finance, and macroeconomic influences on markets. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics such as fundamental and technical analysis, portfolio construction, diversification strategies, market cycles, performance evaluation, and investment research—documenting failure modes so we can strengthen model reasoning and analytical accuracy. On a typical day, you will engage the model with investment scenarios, analytical questions, and market-based reasoning tasks; verify factual correctness and financial logic; assess the validity of investment reasoning; capture reproducible error traces; and provide structured feedback to improve prompts, evaluation frameworks, and analytical depth. You may also help identify where models oversimplify market behavior or misinterpret financial data. A background in finance, economics, accounting, business, or a related field is preferred but not required. Experience in asset management, brokerage, research, financial planning, or related roles is valuable, and entry-level candidates with foundational knowledge of investments and strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication—explicitly articulating reasoning and decision processes (“showing your work”)—is essential. Ready to turn your knowledge of investments into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that support investors, analysts, and financial professionals worldwide. We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. Self-directed work style with strong written communication skills. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Palo Alto, CA, US; Remote, US About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . This role focuses on advancing the science and systems behind ML measurement, feature understanding, and causal inference at scale. The work spans areas such as production feature importance platforms, observational causal estimation in Pytorch, large-scale proxy metric development, and data-driven approaches to ML infrastructure efficiency. We're looking for an enthusiastic individual contributor to perform high-impact technical work across this space. This person will drive foundational innovations, own the end-to-end design of production ML systems, establish rigorous methodological standards, and partner cross-functionally to turn successful research into durable platform capabilities that raise the ceiling for the entire ML organization. What you’ll do: We are looking for an experienced and highly capable Data & Applied Scientist to help us drive step function improvements in our ML capabilities at Pinterest. In this role, you will: Translate research-grade DS workflows (e.g., proxy metrics, staleness models) into production ML pipelines using Airflow, WandB & Ray while establishing reusable patterns for other teams. Apply and productionize causal inference methods using the production ML stack (propensity scoring, IPW, TMLE) to address high-stakes measurement questions beyond experimental capabilities. Build self-serve tooling to empower non-experts to derive rigorous causal insights at scale. Partner with ML engineers and product teams to identify opportunities for improved tooling, metrics, and measurement methods, unlocking step-change improvements in model quality and business outcomes. Leverage Pinterest's rich metadata and engagement signals to build data-driven frameworks, from feature importance to content deindexing, that improve platform efficiency and speed. Design and build centralized ML platform tooling to improve feature and model creation, evaluation, and trust, including production systems that operate daily at scale across all models. What we’re looking for: 2+ years of hands-on experience as an applied scientist, ML engineer, research scientist or software engineer, with significant ML production experience. Strong Python skills; experience with PyTorch or equivalent deep learning frameworks; familiarity with distributed compute (Spark, Ray). Ray specifically is a strong plus. Enthusiasm for building tools and platforms that multiply the impact of an entire ML organization; not just solving one-off problems. Deep ML theory knowledge with extremely strong fundamentals that can help us reason about ML models from first principles. Proficiency in software development best practices including version control, code review, and reproducible ML pipelines. Experience with workflow management tools (Airflow, Prefect, Jenkins, or similar) for reliable ML pipeline orchestration. Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience. Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. In-Office Requirement Statement: We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 3-5 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country. #LI-NM4 #LI-REMOTE At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada - Remote Description de l'entreprise Workleap est une entreprise tech basée à Montréal avec comme mission de rendre le travail plus simple. Depuis 2006, on bâtit des produits innovants qui aident les équipes RH et TI à relever leurs plus grands défis. Workleap offre deux lignes de produits distinctes : La plateforme Workleap , une solution RH propulsée par l’IA qui élève la performance des équipes et stimule l’engagement des employés. ShareGate , le leader incontesté en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, reconnu par les professionnels TI du monde entier pour sa grande simplicité. Aujourd’hui, c’est plus de 20 000 entreprises partout dans le monde qui comptent sur les produits Workleap pour croître, évoluer et opérer. On est des bâtisseurs dans l’âme et ce qui nous passionne est clair : créer les produits les plus simples qui amènent de la valeur exceptionnelle à nos clients, un point c’est tout. Description du poste Concrètement à quoi va ressembler ton poste ? En tant que Senior Designer de Produit sur ShareGate Migrate , tu travailleras au sein d’un trio produit étroitement collaboratif (PM, Tech Lead, Designer) pour façonner l’expérience d’un produit utilisé dans des projets à fort impact et à forte sensibilité opérationnelle. Tu concevras des solutions qui aident les administrateurs TI à naviguer dans des scénarios de migration complexes avec clarté et confiance. Ton travail couvre à la fois la stratégie et l’exécution : définition des problématiques, conception des parcours et des interactions, affinage des détails d’interface, et itérations rapides basées sur les apprentissages. Tu exploreras de manière réfléchie comment l’ IA peut enrichir l’expérience, que ce soit pour simplifier la planification, faire émerger des insights pertinents ou guider les équipes dans leurs décisions techniques. C’est une occasion de travailler sur des enjeux concrets ayant un impact réel sur l’évolution des environnements numériques des organisations. Tu t’épanouiras dans ce rôle si tu aimes la complexité, collabores naturellement avec les ingénieurs et les PM, et accordes une grande importance à la création d’expériences utilisateur fiables, réfléchies et capables de passer à l’échelle. Responsabilités : Piloter le design de bout en bout au sein de ton équipe produit, de la définition des problèmes jusqu’au raffinement des interactions finales ; Transformer des parcours ambigus ou techniques en expériences intuitives et utiles pour des professionnels TI ; Concevoir des parcours, interfaces et interactions qui simplifient les scénarios de migration Microsoft 365 et cloud ; Collaborer étroitement avec les PM, les ingénieurs et les experts métier pour clarifier le périmètre et aligner la stratégie ; Prototyper, tester et itérer rapidement afin de valider les hypothèses et renforcer les solutions ; Utiliser les données, les retours clients et les insights produit pour guider les décisions et améliorer les résultats ; Explorer des opportunités liées à l’IA pour rendre les flux de migration et de gouvernance plus efficaces, prédictifs et fiables ; Contribuer à l’amélioration des pratiques design à l’aide de nouveaux outils, d’innovations et de nouvelles méthodologies ; Participer à l’évolution du design system et veiller à la cohérence de l’expérience à travers ShareGate. Une semaine typique? Tu évolueras naturellement entre exploration stratégique, design concret et collaboration étroite. Concrètement, tu pourras : Contribuer à la direction produit lors des activités de planification et de découverte en trio ; Traduire les besoins clients et les opportunités business en parcours clairs, wireframes et prototypes ; Travailler avec l’ingénierie pour affiner le périmètre, comprendre les contraintes et maintenir un haut niveau de qualité design tout au long du développement ; Présenter des travaux en cours aux équipes et aux parties prenantes lors de critiques ou de revues asynchrones ; Analyser les données de migration, les tendances de support et les comportements utilisateurs pour éclairer les décisions ; Raffiner les détails d’interaction et assurer des hand-offs clairs et cohérents ; Documenter les décisions et communiquer efficacement le raisonnement derrière les choix effectués ; Utiliser des outils d’IA pour mieux comprendre nos utilisateurs et augmenter ton efficacité ; Prototyper régulièrement avec des outils de prototypage assistés par l’IA pour communiquer, tester et valider les solutions. Tu bénéficieras d’autonomie, de responsabilité, et d’une équipe qui valorise l’exécution réfléchie et l’apprentissage continu. Qui est l’équipe que tu vas rejoindre ? Tu rejoindras une équipe multidisciplinaire où les designers sont impliqués tôt, influencent la direction produit et collaborent étroitement avec l’ingénierie et la gestion de produit. Le design chez Workleap est collaboratif, riche en feedback, et engagé à constamment élever le niveau, autant dans les processus que dans la qualité du craft. Quels sont les prochains défis qui attendent ton équipe ? ShareGate évolue rapidement, et les défis design à venir demandent à la fois créativité et rigueur. Tu contribueras notamment à : Des scénarios de migration à l’échelle entreprise, où la clarté, la prévisibilité et l’efficacité sont essentielles ; La modernisation des expériences clés de ShareGate Migrate et de l’écosystème plus large ; L’évolution d’un design system en croissance, soutenant de nouveaux patterns, l’accessibilité et la cohérence multi-produits ; Des expériences de planification et de guidance AI-native pour aider les équipes TI à anticiper les risques et prendre des décisions éclairées. C’est un rôle où tu peux influencer non seulement le fonctionnement du produit aujourd’hui, mais aussi son évolution sur les prochaines années. Qualifications 6+ ans d’expérience en design de produits B2B SaaS au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires ; Fort sens de l’utilisateur et aisance dans des environnements ambigus et techniquement complexes ; Maîtrise de la stratégie, des parcours UX, du design UI et des détails d’interaction soignés ; Capacité à trouver l’équilibre entre rapidité d’exécution et haute qualité ; Expérience auprès d’audiences techniques (TI, outils d’administration, plateformes) — un atout ; Expérience en conception ou collaboration sur des fonctionnalités propulsées par l’IA ; Excellentes compétences en communication et en storytelling ; Grand souci du détail et engagement fort envers la qualité du design. Fourchette salariale : 120–145 k $ CAD. La fourchette salariale affichée reflète notre échelle de rémunération au Canada. Au moment de formuler une offre, selon la région où le candidat est basé, certains ajustements peuvent s’appliquer afin de refléter les conditions du marché local. Qui nous sommes On est une équipe de curieux et de créateurs passionnés, rassemblés par le même objectif : rendre le travail plus simple - et meilleur - pour tout le monde. Les défis stimulent notre créativité, on carbure à l'intensité, et repousser les limites fait partie de notre ADN. On pense que les meilleures idées naissent de l’expérimentation, de l’apprentissage continu, et parfois même de l’inconfort—c’est comme ça qu’on évolue. Depuis 2006, on réinvente la façon dont les équipes travaillent, en alliant créativité et technologie pour résoudre de vrais problèmes en TI et en RH. On avance vite, on apprend constamment, et on garde toujours nos clients au coeur de nos décisions. Si tu es une personne proactive, qui prend les choses en main, adore collaborer et n’a pas peur de plonger dans l’inconnu - tu trouveras parfaitement ta place parmi nous. Informations supplémentaires Chez Workleap, on bâtit ensemble, on se fait confiance et on se soutient, dans la réussite ou dans l'échec. Tu pourras t'exprimer, évoluer et développer ta créativité dans un environnement qui s'adaptera à ton quotidien et à tes besoins. Nos aspirations sont de bâtir un environnement de travail sain et inclusif. Il s’agit là de l’affaire de tous et de toutes. Notre processus Expérience Candidat chez Workleap : Entrevue téléphonique - Entrevue virtuelle par Teams - Mise en situation - Offre d'emploi En tant qu’entreprise technologique, nous utilisons l’IA pour optimiser le recrutement, tout en veillant à ce que toutes les décisions d’évaluation restent humaines. On a hâte d'apprendre à te connaître ! En postulant à ce poste, tu confirmes avoir lu et être en accord avec notre politique de confidentialité . #LI-Remote To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sharegate-migrate-chezworkleap-senior-product-designer-sharegate-migrate

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada Rockstar is recruiting for a digital product studio that specializes in turning ideas into extraordinary digital experiences. This client is a dynamic, remote-first team of savvy professionals known for pushing creative boundaries and delivering high-quality, user-centered products through a collaborative and lean approach. This client is building a bench of talented product designers for upcoming client work. They are looking for mid-to-senior-level freelance designers who can bring strong UX thinking, sharp visual design skills, and a collaborative spirit to the team. What they're looking for If you're a seasoned product designer with a passion for digital excellence, this opportunity is for you. You’ve honed your craft over the years, with a deep understanding of UX design, visual storytelling, and collaborative product development. You’re equally comfortable working independently and alongside a cross-functional team. You manage your time well, take ownership of your work, and make confident decisions with minimal oversight. You’re fluent in tools like Figma and Adobe Suite, and you bring a user-first mindset to everything you do — whether designing mobile apps or contributing to product strategy. If you're the type of designer who pushes creative boundaries, communicates clearly, and still knows how to have a little fun in the process — they’d love to hear from you. The Details As a Product Design Contractor, you’ll contribute to a range of client-facing projects, collaborating with the Chief Creative Officer and team across the following areas: - Digital Product Design (Web & App): Shape intuitive experiences by applying research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that elevate functionality and user engagement. - User Research & Discovery: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform feature planning and prioritization. Help build products grounded in real user needs and business goals. - User Experience (UX): Apply UX methodologies like journey mapping, user flows, and usability testing to define products beyond UI — ensuring seamless and strategic user experiences. - Visual Design: Lead visual direction on select projects, producing compelling layouts and assets that translate beautifully across platforms — from product to marketing. - Presentation Collateral: Design high-impact presentation decks and visuals that bring ideas to life for clients and stakeholders. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and product teams by providing annotated designs, QA support, and input during handoff and development. - Additional Design Support: Contribute to project-related needs like case studies, marketing assets, and content design for social media or internal documentation. Qualifications - 4–6 years of experience in product and visual design, with a strong focus on digital experiences across web and/or mobile - Solid understanding of UX principles, including user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design decisions - Demonstrated ability to own features or tracks of work with minimal oversight — from wireframes to high-fidelity execution - Comfortable leading or contributing to discovery phases and helping define product direction in collaboration with strategy and engineering - Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with experience working in a Mac environment - Familiarity with remote collaboration tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Harvest - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-first mindset and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale - Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own time in a fast-paced, remote work environment - Bonus: experience working in client-facing or agency settings where flexibility, autonomy, and cross-functional teamwork are key What to Expect from the Process This is a contract-based role and part of an ongoing effort to build relationships with experienced designers for future client projects. Interviews are being conducted on a rolling basis, and while there may not be immediate openings, strong candidates will be added to the contractor roster and considered as new work becomes available. Hiring timelines are directly tied to the sales pipeline, so project start dates vary. The team is committed to matching the right designer to the right project — and they will reach out when there’s a fit. About the Client This client is a digital product studio that brings together design, technology, and creativity to build meaningful experiences. They believe in pushing boundaries, working collaboratively, and delivering high-quality products that they are proud of. The remote-first culture values autonomy, trust, and open communication. The team is always exploring new ideas, evolving their process, and building products that move the needle for their clients. This position is remote and open to all candidates, but applicants based in New York City are prioritized for potential in-person collaboration. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/rockstar-product-designer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote (Within 3 hours of EST timezone preferred) What excites you You want to be early. You like being close to the product, the customer, and the messiness of figuring things out. You enjoy turning sharp customer insight into positioning that actually changes behavior. You care about story-telling. You want to build narratives from launches and words to be thoughtful and useful, not generic or AI slop. You’re energized by hospitality. Hotels are complex, human, and operationally intense. That makes the work interesting, particularly in an age of AI. You want real ownership. If something ships poorly, you fix it. If something lands well, you know exactly why. What excites us You’ve spent 5–7 years in product marketing at a high-growth company, ideally B2B SaaS or complex marketplaces. You can explain technical or operational products in a way that feels simple and grounded. You’ve owned messaging and positioning end to end in close partnership with product, sales, and leadership. You’ve rewritten it when it didn’t work. You’ve led go-to-market for real products, not just features. You know how to scope a launch, make tradeoffs, and ship. You care to measure impact post-launch. You’re not precious about what “typical” PMMs look like. You like wearing different hats and can go beyond product marketing to engage contractors for events planning, or work with an agency to test some ads, when needed. You’re comfortable going deep. Customer calls, sales calls, demos, win-loss. You look for signal, not anecdotes. You’re hands-on. You write the first draft. You build the deck. You partner with design, but you don’t wait on them. Bonus if you’ve worked in hospitality, travel, fintech, or vertical SaaS. Bigger bonus if you genuinely like hotels. Working at Folio We're a remote-first company. Three times a year, we travel to work together in-person and stay with one of our hotel partners. We love experimenting with new tools. For the most part, we rely on Google Meet, Linear, Notion, and Slack to make decisions and get things done day-to-day. You will have the opportunity to travel frequently and meet our customers in person at conferences and events, which you will be helping plan for. We're a small team who work collaboratively and meet daily for stand up What we value Craft . We take pride in our work, find joy in execution, and believe that the best companies are built at a steady yet resilient pace. Optimism . We believe in ourselves and each other and know anything is possible with the right amount of hustle and grit. Ownership . We love making things better and have a strong sense of shared responsibility over everything we create together. Hospitality. The industry we’re building for has a culture of service to others, and we bring that energy to how we work together each day. Everything we create is designed to make designers' lives easier, and our marketing reflects that. We focus on education, practical advice, and helping designers succeed—not pushy sales tactics. Apply for the job: Love writing clear, helpful content and keeping marketing projects moving? Join DesignFiles as a remote Content Marketing Coordinator. With a rent-to-own marketplace of DA
items.description: WHO WE ARE: Splice is a creative platform for people who make music. Serious producers choose Splice Sounds to bring their ideas to life. A subscription to Splice inspires and accelerates creative success for digital music creators with an industry-leading catalog of sounds and samples and an expanding AI stack. With a rent-to-own marketplace of DAWs and plugins, the Splice experience seamlessly integrates into any music production workflow, regardless of DAW (Digital Audio Workstation). Via Splice, an unparalleled team of sound designers and sample creators are fueling the success of a growing global community of chart-topping producers, students, and DIY creators. HOW WE WORK: At Splice, DISCO is a rallying cry for collaboration, accountability, and unity within our organization; Direct, Inclusive, Splice Together, Creator Centric, and Optimistic. Our shared success depends on our ability to support one another, work well together, and communicate directly. By embracing flexibility and a unified approach, we can navigate anything that’s thrown at us. Splice embraces a culture of remote work. You’ll see your colleagues showing up from across the US and the UK. In order to keep us working well as a team, we have regular communication, including Town Halls, departmental all-hands and get-togethers. When you join Splice, you join a network of colleagues, peers, and collaborators. Are you ready? Junior Freelance Video Editor (Longform YouTube) Remote -US The Role We are looking for a talented Freelance Video Editor to help produce high-quality, longform YouTube videos. If you have a sharp eye for pacing, a strong background in audio, and the technical skills to seamlessly blend multi-cam footage with screen recordings, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Multicam Workflow: Seamlessly sync, cut, and transition between 1-2 camera angles and a separate high-resolution screen recording file. Audio Sweetening: Leverage your music production knowledge to clean up dialogue, balance audio levels, and score the video to keep viewers engaged. Storytelling & Pacing: Edit raw footage into polished, compelling longform content tailored specifically for audience retention on YouTube. Requirements & Qualifications Video Software: 3+ years of professional editing experience using Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve . Audio Expertise: A background as a music producer or strong familiarity with Digital Audio Workstations (DAWs) is highly preferred. Platform Knowledge: Proven experience editing longform content specifically for YouTube. Bonus Skills: Any working experience with Blender for 3D elements, text, or animation is a major plus. This is a contract role: The pay range for this role is $1,000 per long form video edit completed. Splice is an Equal Opportunity Employer Splice provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

items.title: Sales Development Representative (Hybrid - Waltham, MA / Fort Collins, CO) at Constant Contact
items.summary: At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. There’s something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams . Here, we all play an integral part in helping busi
items.description: At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. There’s something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams . Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We’re energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we’re just getting started! As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you’ll be the first point of contact in our sales cycle, responsible for inbound follow-up or outbound prospecting into partner ecosystems, identifying qualified business opportunities, and fueling the sales pipeline for our Indirect Sales team. You’ll prospect into multi-domain and franchise organizations, engaging decision-makers and influencers across various industries and geographies. This role is ideal for a self-starter seeking a career in sales who thrives on cold outreach, consistently exceeds activity goals, and brings a blend of hustle, curiosity, and professionalism to every interaction. What You’ll Do: Inbound Lead Engagement Effectively and quickly respond to inbound inquiries and marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) via phone, email, and chat per Inbound SLAs. Qualify leads based on customer fit, business needs, and buying signals. Utilize CTCT Sales Methodology for effective discovery and qualification. Guide prospects through the early stages of their journey and deliver a positive first impression of Constant Contact. Coordinate and schedule meetings with Account Executives (AEs) to advance qualified leads through the sales funnel, generating pipeline and revenue. Maintain a high speed-to-lead response time, meeting team SLAs, and actively monitor lead queues and routing. Outbound Prospecting & Expansion For Outbound SDRs - Make a minimum of 75 outbound calls per day (while maintaining an omnichannel approach) to target accounts, re-engagement lists, and dormant customers. Inbound SDRs make a minimum of 50 calls daily. Clearly communicate the value of Constant Contact’s platform. Overcome objections and build trust with prospects through consultative outreach. Meet or exceed team SLAs for leads, greenfield, and day-to-day responsibilities. Have minimal or no Overdue steps daily. Sales Operations & Continuous Improvement Maintain meticulous CRM documentation that enables successful handoff and accurate pipeline forecasting. Leverage sales engagement platforms to optimize touch patterns, experiment with messaging, and increase conversion rates. Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, and sales to provide feedback and enhance pipeline quality. Participate in weekly performance reviews with a growth mindset—identifying trends, diagnosing challenges, and proposing strategic improvements. Who You Are: 1-2 years of SDR/BDR or relevant outbound sales experience in a SaaS or tech-driven environment. Proven ability to generate and qualify leads through cold outreach. Entrepreneurial mindset—you’re excited to build new playbooks and go after untapped opportunities. Looking to kickstart a career in sales. Strong communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable engaging with business owners and marketing teams. Organized, self-motivated, and goal-oriented with a track record of hitting activity or meeting targets. Experience with Salesforce and engagement platforms, such as Salesloft, Outreach, or Groove, is a plus. Bonus: Familiarity with small business challenges and the digital marketing landscape. This is a hybrid (40 hr a week) role, requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in our Waltham, MA, or Loveland, CO office. The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including the candidate’s experience, their education and work location. In addition, some roles may be eligible for additional on target commission pay or bonus. The compensation package includes health and welfare benefits including paid leave. Pay Transparency - All Full Time Employees $22.12—$23.56 USD Why You’ll Love Us: We celebrate one another’s differences. We are proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion, and we’re always working hard to strengthen and improve this culture. We have programs in place that bring us together on important issues and provide educational opportunities for all employees. Join the experts. If you’re passionate about supporting businesses and organizations, you won’t find a better spot to share your talent. We’re dedicated to improving the quality of our product from a customer standpoint and have a true desire to enable the success of businesses, non-profit organizations, and community groups. You’ll have opportunities to grow your career. We encourage and support our team members to learn different aspects of the business, take on stretch assignments, seek coaching opportunities and professional development opportunities. A generous paid time off policy and a competitive benefits package that supports the health and well-being of you and your family At Constant Contact, we’re all about work flexibility and are proud to serve our customers as a hybrid workforce. Our hybrid work model combines the convenience of remote work with access to our great office locations to collaborate in-person, participate in live trainings, and socialize with colleagues. Application Deadline: 30 days. We may fill this job opening prior to the deadline if a candidate is selected by us. Vision6 Pty Limited is an affiliate of Constant Contact, Inc. and a part of the Constant Contact group of brands. Constant Contact is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, veteran status or any other status protected under applicable law. If you require accessibility assistance applying for open positions, please contact talentacquisition@constantcontact.com. The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or © consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35© It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. At Constant Contact, we respect personnel privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information we obtain and maintain from both current, former, and prospective employees. We maintain this Personnel Global Privacy Notice (this “Notice”) in compliance with applicable privacy laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (the “CCPA”) and the UK General Data Protection Regulation (collectively, the “Data Protection Laws”). Click here for a full copy of our General Personnel Privacy Notice. Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: Constant Contact has an internal talent acquisition department and designated career site for individuals looking to join our team. Constant Contact will not accept unsolicited resumes from any external recruiters, staffing firms, search agencies or any fee-based referrals. Any unsolicited resumes sent to directly to Constant Contact, in any capacity will be considered property of Constant Contact. Constant Contact will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.

items.title: Associate Director, Technical Accounting at Airwallex
items.summary: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business acco
items.description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You’re humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About the team The Finance & Corporate Development team at Airwallex drives the company’s financial strategy and growth. Our team focuses on financial planning, analysis, and corporate transactions to ensure Airwallex’s long-term success. We collaborate across departments to identify opportunities, manage risks, and execute strategic initiatives. Our goal is to support the company’s mission to empower businesses to operate anywhere, anytime. What you’ll do We’re looking for an Associate Director, Technical Finance to join our Financial Controllership team. You will be the primary authority and architect for our most complex accounting treatments. This is not a “maintenance” role; it is a strategic functional position designed for a US GAAP expert who thrives in a high-velocity, global environment. You will be responsible for navigating the technical complexities of a rapidly scaling business, ensuring our financial narrative is robust, compliant, and forward-looking. You will lead the Global Technical Accounting function, translating complex business initiatives into sound accounting positions that stand up to the highest level of scrutiny. This role is remote based in the US. Responsibilities: Oversee the technical integrity of the monthly reporting process by providing expert US GAAP oversight on regional submissions. You will ensure that high-risk accounting areas are treated with technical precision. Partner with Product and Business teams. You will assess the accounting implications of new product launches (including gross vs. net revenue, embedded derivatives, cost of sales vs OPEX classification etc) before they go live. Own the resolution of technical accounting issues and judgmental estimates. Lead the expansion and evolution of our global US GAAP reporting framework. You will author and maintain the Global Accounting Policy Manual to ensure consistency and compliance. Architect and oversee the Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) for technical accounting areas. You will ensure that all complex accounting judgments are backed by robust, SOX-compliant documentation and that “Reviewer Controls” are designed with sufficient precision to meet public company standards. Lead the preparation and defense of high-quality technical memos, ensuring all documentation meets PCAOB auditing standards regarding management’s estimates, assumptions, and data integrity. Spearhead department-wide initiatives to mature the Controllership function, focusing on the automation of technical accounting workflows and the implementation of AI technology and new accounting standards. Provide continuous technical guidance and training to regional finance teams, uplifting their capability to maintain high standards of financial control and reporting accuracy. Who you are We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field 7+ years of professional experience in technical finance roles Deep expertise in US GAAP standards with a proven ability to apply them to complex business transactions Strong working knowledge of PCAOB Auditing Standards and SOX requirements Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and thrive in a hyper-growth environment Preferred qualifications: Active CPA license or equivalent professional qualification Prior experience at a Big Four accounting firm Direct experience with the pre-IPO process and scaling finance functions for public market readiness Strong “thought leadership” skills with a history of driving innovative solutions and influencing organizational change Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

items.description: At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. So, what’s the role all about? NiCE Actimize, the industry’s largest and broadest provider of financial crime, anti-money laundering, enterprise fraud and compliance solutions is the leader in Autonomous Financial Crime Management. NiCE Actimize drives the Autonomous journey with ActOne for investigation and case management, as well as X-Sight, a cloud-based Financial Crime Risk Management Platform-as-a-Service. NiCE Actimize AML solutions are acknowledged for technology leadership and expertise in AI, machine learning and intelligent automation. NiCE Actimize is currently seeking a dynamic individual with high energy and drive to join our team as a Presales/Solutions Consultant. How will you make an impact? Provide key subject matter expertise within financial crime and compliance. Engage with NiCE Actimize’s prospects and clients to understand technical and functional requirements, from both current and aspirational perspectives Position solutions for specific prospect requirements, and articulate how value and business benefits can be achieved Explain features and benefits of the NiCE Actimize solutions in comparison to competitive products Deliver product presentations to technical and management personnel, and bring Actimize’s differentiation to life through the medium of a demo Develop relationships with prospects and customers Communicate with sales and product management regarding customer needs Lead Proof of Concept engagements, working with the client, sales, and technical presales Completing RFI/RFPs; identifying client requirements and ensuring proactive communications with customers to ensure customer satisfaction Participate in trade shows, seminars and other industry events. Have you got what it takes? Essential: Experience in a client facing role providing solutions to, or within, the financial services, financial software or enterprise software industries. Ideally have experience in financial crime solutions Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills Proven ability to quickly and deeply learn new technologies and clearly communicate their value proposition Proven track record of solving problems and driving business success and revenue Consultative and confident, with an ability to thrive in a fast paced, dynamic environment Experience in gathering requirements, documenting business needs and presenting solutions to a senior audience Must be willing to travel to customer sites 40%+ Preferred Detailed knowledge of fraud, financial crimes and compliance industry Experience using or implementing Actimize financial crime products. Good insight into business value and business case driven solutions Confidence in AI (NLP, Analytics & Decisioning, Automation, Machine Learning, etc) Good understanding of statistical data modelling concepts Experience in enterprise-wide case management About NiCE Actimize: NiCE Actimize is the largest and broadest provider of financial crime, risk and compliance solutions for regional and global financial institutions, as well as government regulators. Consistently ranked as number one in the space, NiCE Actimize experts apply innovative technology to protect institutions and safeguard consumers’ and investors’ assets by identifying financial crime, preventing fraud and providing regulatory compliance. What’s in it for you? Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr! Requisition ID: 11712 Reporting into: Director, Sales Role Type: Individual Contributor #LI-Remote About NiCE NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

items.description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: We are looking for an experienced Senior Analyst to join the Care Operations team! Our analysts develop a deep understanding of the day-to-day performance of the Care Operations business, using data to identify opportunities, improve processes, and drive better outcomes. Reporting to the Director of Business Operations, you will surface insights that shape key initiatives and process improvements, helping deliver a world-class experience for both patients and providers. This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role that partners closely with teams across the organization. You Will: Lead complex analyses across Care Operations to identify trends, diagnose root causes, and translate ambiguous business problems into actionable strategies and recommendations. Monitor business performance and Care Operations KPIs to proactively identify risks and opportunities, using data and patient insights to advocate for improvements to the patient and Care team experience. Own analytical and operational workstreams independently, applying judgment to prioritize issues, develop solutions, and drive measurable improvements across growth, efficiency, quality, and care delivery. Partner with cross-functional teams, including Product, Medical Affairs, Growth, Customer Support, and Clinical Operations, to influence priorities, solve complex problems, and translate operational insights into product and process improvements.
