items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote, United States Director of Production Engineering Remote, United States About this Position Are you passionate about building the reliability, automation, and security foundations that let engineering teams move fast with confidence? At Legion, we are seeking a Director of Engineering, DevOps & SRE to lead the teams responsible for the availability, scalability, and security of our production environment. Our production infrastructure runs on AWS, leveraging services such as EKS, RDS, and a broad set of AWS-native technologies. You will partner closely with engineering and IT to build resilient systems, drive operational excellence, and ensure our platform meets the highest standards of security and compliance. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll spend ~20-30% of your time contributing directly to architecture, tooling, and incident response, and the rest driving vision, roadmap, and cross-team execution. Responsibilities Hire and build a globally-distributed DevOps/SRE engineering team. Recruit, mentor, and manage engineers, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Own the reliability and infrastructure roadmap for our AWS-based production environment, including EKS, RDS, and related AWS services, ensuring scalability, high availability, and cost efficiency. Lead the organization's security operations (SecOps) practice, including vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and remediation, to proactively identify and resolve security issues before they impact customers. Define and drive engineering OKRs for infrastructure reliability, automation, and security, and track progress against measurable outcomes. Champion observability and alerting best practices (e.g., Datadog), including automating alert triage and response to reduce mean-time-to-resolution. Solid understanding of agentic AI infrastructure and how AI agentic workflows apply to SDLC and DevOps processes (e.g., automated investigation, remediation, and PR-generation pipelines). Drive Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automation practices to increase engineering velocity and reduce operational toil. Work closely with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure standards, access controls, tooling, and compliance requirements across the organization. Ensure the platform meets the highest standards of security, compliance, and data protection; implement and maintain robust security controls and audit-readiness. Lead and participate in the Incident Management on-call rotation, working with SRE and development teams to meet and exceed availability goals. Stay current on cloud, DevOps, and security best practices, and provide technical guidance and thought leadership to the broader engineering organization. Required Qualifications 8-12 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or production infrastructure roles, including people management experience. Deep hands-on experience running production workloads on AWS, including EKS (Kubernetes), RDS, and other core AWS services (e.g., VPC, IAM, Lambda, S3). Demonstrated experience running security operations (SecOps) — vulnerability management, incident response, and remediation of production security issues. 5+ years of experience leveraging observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana) to drive reliability, performance, and alerting improvements. Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD automation. Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or Bash, with day-to-day use of Git and test automation pipelines. Hands-on experience operating Linux/Unix production platforms (Amazon Linux, Ubuntu, RHEL/CentOS). Proven track record partnering cross-functionally with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure, tooling, and security standards. Demonstrated experience leading incident management and on-call practices for high-availability production systems. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; Master's degree preferred. Preferred Qualifications Experience with major cloud providers beyond AWS, such as Google Cloud Platform or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, CKS). Experience with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA. 3+ years of experience with Kubernetes or other containerization/orchestration platforms at scale. Experience with Kubernetes-native delivery tooling, including Argo Workflows and Helm. 5+ years of experience leading teams in an agile/scrum environment. Experience building or scaling automated investigation and remediation pipelines for production error classes. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Salary Range: Base Salary Range $220,000 - $265,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and the internal equity for the same position within the company. Benefits include, but are not limited to: $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment 401k plan Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Parental Leave Equity Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Monthly Lunch on Legion ABOUT LEGION Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones. For more information, visit https://legion.co EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. The ideal candidate is a delivery-minded leader who is comfortable with technical projects and oil & gas business applications, sets clear priorities against finite capacity, and builds a high-performing team and a culture of continuous improvement. Essential Duties Strategy & portfolio: Develop and maintain the STAQ strategy — project prioritization frameworks, value-realization tracking, and portfolio management — so EQT focuses on its highest-value initiatives. Pipeline ownership: Own the SPC pipeline end to end — intake, triage, scoping, prioritization, development hand-off to IT delivery teams, documentation, and post-implementation lookback. Cross-functional governance: Lead recurring cross-functional Special Project Reviews with business departments and internal team standups and architecture-collaboration sessions to align priorities and unblock delivery. Architecture & quality: Govern solution architecture and data-quality standards so the pipeline stays reliable, fast, supported, valuable, and clean (the Innovation Engine scorecard). People leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the STAQ team (Business Process Operations Manager and Business Process Engineers); foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement. Budget & capacity: Develop and manage the STAQ budget and capacity plan; balance incoming demand against the standing backlog and available staffing. Stakeholder alignment: Communicate with executive and cross-functional stakeholders to align department portfolios, delivery priorities, and enterprise strategy; steward STAQ’s knowledge base and operating standards. Continuous improvement: Research and evaluate emerging technologies (automation, analytics) for business applicability and pursue continuous improvement of the pipeline and its supporting infrastructure. Minimum Qualifications 8+ years of combined experience in technology delivery, business operations, and/or process improvement, including team leadership Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical or quantitative field (e.g., Engineering, Computer/Data Science, Information Systems, or Business). An engineering degree is beneficial but not required. Experience delivering technology programs or products from inception through delivery to post-launch. Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, define project scope, and translate business needs into technical solutions. Demonstrated understanding of data structures, analytics, and solution architecture (conceptual fluency required; hands-on engineering not required). Proven ability to coordinate, organize, lead, and develop teams, and to manage competing priorities across many stakeholders. Comfort working on technical projects and with oil & gas business applications, with a strong understanding of how the business works. Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing or leading Salesforce-based business processes and custom solutions. Experience with data tools, pipelines, and analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks). Engineering and/or operational experience in the oil & gas industry (beneficial, not required). Experience leading a portfolio, delivery, or business-process function. Familiarity with EQT’s “Way We Work” operating model (Programs, Utilities, Insights, Sessions, and Knowledge). Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level. EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer -- Disabilities/Veterans. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Track & Trace Coordinator (#2)
items.summary: Zelh is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Track & Trace Coordinator to support our freight brokerage operations.
items.description: Zelh is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Track & Trace Coordinator to support our freight brokerage operations. This position is responsible for monitoring active shipments from pickup through final delivery, maintaining accurate load information, communicating with carriers and drivers, and quickly identifying potential service issues. The Track & Trace Coordinator plays an important role in providing excellent customer service by ensuring our team always knows where each shipment is and whether it is operating according to schedule. This is a fast-paced position requiring strong communication, organization, follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously. Key Responsibilities •Monitor active shipments from dispatch through final delivery. •Contact carriers and drivers to obtain accurate pickup, transit, and delivery updates. •Confirm drivers are on schedule for pickup and delivery appointments. •Verify arrival and departure times at shippers and receivers. •Update shipment status, notes, ETA information, and appointment details in the TMS. •Identify late trucks, missed appointments, breakdowns, detention, rejected product, temperature issues, and other potential service failures. •Immediately escalate significant service issues to the appropriate operations or sales team member. •Proactively communicate delays rather than waiting for customers or internal team members to discover an issue. •Maintain consistent communication with carriers until problems are resolved. •Obtain and upload Bills of Lading, Proofs of Delivery, lumper receipts, and other required shipment documentation. •Assist with scheduling and confirming pickup and delivery appointments as needed. •Ensure completed loads contain the information and documentation necessary for billing. •Maintain clear, professional, and accurate notes so another team member can quickly understand the status of any shipment. •Assist Customer Sales and Carrier Sales representatives with operational support as needed. Working conditions: Work schedule: T&T #2 Wednesday–Thursday: 11 PM–7 AM CST Friday: 7 PM–3 AM CST Saturday–Sunday: 3:30 PM–11:30 PM CST Monday & Tuesday: Days off 1-hour unpaid lunch break during each shift Competitive Salary in USD Remote mode of work 10+ business days of paid time off Team building and corporate events Equipment provided A supportive team Requirements Extremely dependable with strong follow-through. Detail-oriented and organized. Comfortable making frequent phone calls, sending emails, and communicating by text. Able to manage a high volume of shipments without losing track of details. Strong sense of urgency when something is going wrong. Able to recognize potential problems before they become customer service failures. Comfortable working independently and making decisions within established procedures. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Able to remain professional when dealing with frustrated drivers, carriers, customers, or facilities. Experience in freight brokerage, trucking, transportation, dispatch, or logistics is preferred but not required. Experience with a Transportation Management System (TMS) is preferred. What Success Looks Like A successful Track & Trace Coordinator doesn't simply enter updates into the system. They own shipment visibility. Originally posted on Himalayas

Principais Responsabilidades Sustentação de Sistemas Financeiros Atuar como responsável funcional pelos sistemas de finanças, garantindo sua operação contínua e aderência às necessidades do negócio. Levantar requisitos, mapear processos e traduzir necessidades de negócio para equipes técnicas. Garantir comunicação clara e permanente entre stakeholders, usuários-chave e times de tecnologia. Gestão de Projetos Liderar projetos de evolução sistêmica, automação e transformação digital para as áreas financeiras. Coordenar atividades desde a definição do escopo até implantação em produção. Elaborar cronogramas, planos de ação, análise de riscos e acompanhamento de entregas. Conduzir cerimônias de projeto e reuniões executivas de status. Apoiar processos de testes, homologação, treinamento e gestão da mudança. Gestão de Backlog e Priorização Manter backlog de melhorias e demandas atualizado e priorizado. Definir critérios de priorização considerando impacto financeiro, riscos regulatórios, experiência do usuário e valor para o negócio. Trabalhar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento para refinamento de requisitos e acompanhamento das entregas. Conhecimento de processos O2C, P2P e R2R. Experiência em sustentação de aplicações corporativas críticas. Participação em projetos de implementação ou transformação de sistemas financeiros. items.title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. Classify sellers and verify their authorization status. Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues. Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content. Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables. Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy. Strong written English and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and follow SOPs. Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces. Nice-to-Have Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience. Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools. Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance. Experience with dashboards and reporting. Experience using AI research and translation tools. Key Qualities Detail-oriented Analytical Investigative Highly organized What We Offer 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines. Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning. Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence. Application Process We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible. The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us. items.title: Category Manager Asian & Tribal Arts
items.summary: At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day. We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by…
items.description: At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day. We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts. Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us. Taking ownership and driving impact Being open to change and feedback Being passionate about our mission and our customers. Asian & Tribal is one of the most culturally rich and commercially complex categories within Collectables. It spans Asian Art, Tribal & Ethnographic Art, and related subcategories where heritage, craftsmanship, provenance, and collector trust are critical. The category attracts a diverse global buyer base ranging from emerging collectors to highly specialised, repeat buyers, and requires strong judgement, commercial sharpness, and leadership to balance growth with quality. This is an opportunity to lead an established category with real depth, a strong expert team and clear headroom for growth. You will set the commercial direction, turn opportunity into focused execution and build a category that grows in both scale and quality. It is not a role for maintaining the status quo: you will make choices, create momentum and take ownership of the outcomes. As Category Manager, you own the category strategy and commercial performance. You lead and develop an international team of Experts, build strong external networks with sellers and institutions, and ensure a high-quality buyer experience that reinforces trust and repeat engagement. This role is based in the Netherlands with a hybrid setup. You are expected to work from the Amsterdam office two days per week to collaborate closely with other Category Managers, Commercial teams, and key stakeholders. The Opportunity Shape a clear growth plan for a category with global reach, cultural credibility and significant untapped commercial potential. Improve the category mix, auction performance and seller portfolio - choosing where to invest, what to stop and how to turn insight into measurable action. Build a stronger, more repeatable pipeline of high-quality sellers alongside Sales and Business Development, while representing Catawiki credibly in the market. Create a high-performing, engaged team that combines specialist expertise with commercial ownership, pace and accountability. What You’ll Do Build, own and execute the strategic growth plan for Asian & Tribal. Set a clear ambition, identify the few growth bets that matter most and translate them into practical, time-bound execution. Own the category P&L and commercial outcomes. Use data to make firm calls on where to invest, improve or stop - balancing growth, margin, quality and operational stability. Steer the full auction-performance funnel: supply quality and mix, curation pace, pricing and reserve-price strategy, sell-through, cancellation and buyer experience. Shape auction planning around seasonality, market dynamics, collector behaviour and seller portfolios, with a focus on increasing repeatable high-quality supply and long-term buyer trust. Work closely with Sales and Business Development to build and convert a stronger seller pipeline. Develop your own external network and represent Catawiki with credibility among sellers, dealers, institutions and professional networks. Lead, coach and develop an international team of Experts. Set clear expectations, create ownership and follow through on performance, development and accountability. Create focus and pace in a complex environment. Prioritise clearly, make decisions with imperfect information and address resistance or underperformance directly and constructively. Influence Marketing, Operations, Product, Commercial and other Category teams to unlock growth opportunities. Build alignment where it helps execution, but do not wait for consensus to move the business forward. Stay close to global Asian & Tribal market trends, pricing dynamics, collector demand and competitive movements, turning relevant insight into action. What You’ll Bring A strong commercial track record in category management, marketplace, retail, sales or another complex, customer-led business. You have owned meaningful commercial outcomes, not only supported them. Experience building and executing a growth strategy, including planning, budgeting, pricing and P&L management. You can explain the commercial logic behind your decisions and measure whether they worked. A data-led, action-oriented approach. You can move from dashboards and ambiguous signals to a clear diagnosis, a prioritised plan and accountable follow-through. Proven people-leadership experience. You know how to coach specialists, set a high bar, create engagement and handle difficult performance conversations when needed. Commercial curiosity and entrepreneurial energy. You actively look for opportunities, test assumptions and keep learning - particularly where the market or customer behaviour is changing. Decisiveness and resilience in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. You are comfortable making trade-offs, defending a point of view and adapting when evidence says the approach needs to change. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. You can influence across seniority levels and functions, communicate concisely and bring people with you through change. A hands-on mindset balanced with strategic thinking. You are willing to get close to the detail when needed, while building systems and capability that allow the team to scale. Comfort working with Google Suite or similar tools. Interest or background in Asian Art, Tribal Art or Collectables is a plus. Deep expertise can grow on the job; commercial leadership, judgement and the ability to build trust are essential. What Success Looks Like A focused, credible category growth plan is in motion, with clear priorities, owners, milestones and leading indicators. The team understands what good looks like and works with greater clarity, ownership and commercial pace. Auction quality and commercial discipline are more consistent, with deliberate choices on supply mix, pricing and reserve-price strategy. A stronger pipeline of repeat, high-quality sellers is being built with Commercial partners and through your own market network. Stakeholders experience you as a clear, constructive business owner who moves decisions into action and communicates progress honestly. Where You’ll Be This is a hybrid role based in the Netherlands. You will work from the Amsterdam office at least two days per week to collaborate with fellow Category Managers, Commercial teams, and key stakeholders. What We Offer A category with cultural depth, global reach, and significant commercial potential. You will have real ownership, the space to shape strategy and execution, and the opportunity to lead and develop a strong expert team. You will work alongside ambitious international colleagues in a collaborative environment with clear expectations, strong development opportunities, and a focus on sustainable growth. Why You'll Love Working with Us Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business. Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression. A culture of connection defines us . We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work. Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion ” . We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location. Our Offices and Way of Working Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based. Interested? Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

The insurance industry is a $1T market that has remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here changing that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner…
items.description: Overview of the role: We’re on a mission to modernize insurance, making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that has remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here changing that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to help us build the future of insurance in Canada and beyond. Joining a small, collaborative People & Culture team, you’ll combine hands-on recruiting with creativity, problem-solving, and continuous improvement while partnering with leaders across the organization. You’ll hire exceptional people to PolicyMe through innovative sourcing strategies, meaningful candidate relationships, while strengthening our recruiting processes, systems, and employer brand. What you'll be doing Own recruitment processes from beginning to end, including everything from intake and job-posting through sourcing, candidate communication, interviews, feedback, rejections, and close. Partner with hiring managers to clarify role requirements, design effective interview processes, calibrate on candidates, and keep searches moving. Develop sourcing strategies and build qualified pipelines for a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical hiring (think, software engineers, some QA, product managers, etc.) Use LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, professional communities, referrals, events, and other creative channels to source and engage candidates. Use data to drive how you recruit, including maintaining updated dashboards and organized processes within our ATS (currently Lever), tracking recruiting metrics and using funnel insights to improve how we recruit. Identify recruitment bottlenecks and implement practical improvements that reduce friction for candidates and hiring teams. Support employer-brand initiatives, including regular content for the PolicyMe LinkedIn page and careers content. Contribute to a thoughtful, inclusive, and consistent candidate experience at every stage of the process. What we are looking for 2–5 years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology, startup, scale-up, agency, or similar environment. Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, or a related field, or equivalent experience. End-to-end recruiting experience, from intake through offer and close, with strong partnerships across hiring managers and recruiting teams. Hands-on technical recruiting experience across software engineering, product, QA, and design roles. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple searches, projects, timelines, and stakeholders. Proactive, clear communicator who builds trust with candidates and cross-functional partners while effectively surfacing progress, priorities, and risks. Analytical and action-oriented problem solver who diagnoses issues, recommends solutions, and follows through. Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox or similar sourcing tools, Brighthire, and Lever or another ATS. Curious and committed to continuously improving recruiting skills, tools, and processes, including a keen interest in using AI in how we build best-in-class recruitment and candidate experiences. Preference for Toronto-based, with interest in coming into our office on Thursdays (office is in Yorkville, there is no mandate to come in!). Why join us: Generous PTO - 20 vacation days A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!) Access to stock options based on performance Compensation: The total target cash compensation for this role is $88,000–$100,000 CAD , based on experience. We’ll walk through the details together during the interview. Compensation Additional Information About PolicyMe: At PolicyMe, we are Canada’s leading digital insurance solution, offering straightforward and affordable financial protection for families from coast to coast. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs. We also offer B2B2C solutions, partnering with organizations to provide seamless digital insurance options. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible. Since our launch in 2018, we have grown exponentially, selling over $10 billion in insurance coverage to Canadians. We are proud of the team we’ve built and are excited for those that are yet to join us. We operate with a remote-first culture, attracting top talent from across Canada. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working alongside incredibly ambitious yet humble humans, we may be the right place for you! To learn more, visit www.policyme.com . Additional Notes: Job Vacancy: This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope. We’re hiring to support increasing demand and continue delivering an exceptional customer experience. Commitment to Equal Opportunity: PolicyMe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and provide fair consideration regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability. Accessibility Statement: We are committed to providing an accessible hiring experience. If you require accommodations during the application process, please indicate this in the “Additional Information” section of your application. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

items.summary: Hi, I’m Harriet, Ashby’s VP Marketing. I joined Ashby in August 2022 to lead the Marketing function. My career journey has been anything but linear starting out as a yoga teacher, working as an M&A lawyer, before finding my happy place in marketing. This is a common theme across the team, and we love to…
items.description: Hi, I’m Harriet, Ashby’s VP Marketing. I joined Ashby in August 2022 to lead the Marketing function. My career journey has been anything but linear starting out as a yoga teacher, working as an M&A lawyer, before finding my happy place in marketing. This is a common theme across the team, and we love to see people who have built their skills both inside and outside the marketing discipline. Over the past ~4 years, we’ve gone from a stealth brand to the default operating system for over 5,000 of the most ambitious companies in tech, finance, and healthcare. On this journey, we’ve also amassed a marketing team of ~30 folks from across North America and Europe who are some of the brightest and most humble humans that want to ‘win’, and have fun doing so. Our culture is focused on creating a space to do lots of career-defining work with the tools, people, and focus that means minimal thrash and lots of autonomy. You can learn a little more about how we work here and why our investors are excited about us here . For this role, we are looking for someone to lead demand generation for our enterprise segment in Europe. You will have a fantastic thought partner and US counterpart, Ben , as well as the autonomy to rethink and define the strategy and execution to fit the nuances of the different European markets. It’s ABM but not in its traditional form: we’re seeking a first-principles thinker who prioritizes meaningful engagement over generic tactics / outdated playbooks (for example, prioritizing a few key impactful moments of engagement over running a laundry list of generic tactics across digital channels). If working with both the sales and marketing team to find and convert enterprise pipeline in a low ego, highly ambitious environment appeals, we’d love to hear from you! What you’ll be responsible for in this role Partner with Ben to define our EMEA enterprise ABM strategy and the channels we bet on with consideration to broader global strategy and nuances of respective European markets. Here you play the critical role of orchestrator, pulling together all of the relevant marketing channels to support a delightful discovery and prospect journey and are the point person for your counterparts in Sales. Research and build prospect journey maps for target accounts, and develop the messaging, content, and creative that bring them to life, with support from our PMM, content, and creative teams. Work with sales and revenue operations to build target account lists that combine data signals with rep input, and own the methodology behind them — how cohorts are built, what assumptions they rest on, and how we measure whether accounts are actually moving. Manage our agency partners, including our gifting agency, Wildcard, to get campaigns executed well and fast. Execute on the strategy you define which will include activities like working with your events counterpart on the coordination of dinners, activations , ancillary conference events, and stunts. Apply our experimentation framework to run short sprints, learn quickly what works, and localise content, creative, and campaign strategy for EMEA markets. You will probably love this role if: You enjoy combining data and creative thinking — and you have taste. You can tell the difference between messaging that's genuinely compelling and messaging that's generic or cheesy. You're prospect-obsessed. You can step into the seat of the personas you're marketing to and build campaigns that meet them where they are, at the right time, with the right message. You are deeply curious and not afraid to break from traditional ABM playbooks. You build trust across functions. Sales managers and reps are excited to work with you, and the marketing team is fully bought into your campaign ideas and asks. You understand (and leverage) the massive advantage AI creates but not so pilled that you let efficiency gains undercut creativity and taste. This role is not for you if: You'd rely solely on 6sense (or equivalent) as your only source of truth. You're strong on one half of the job but not the other. You need to move comfortably between building and interpreting dashboards, and writing compelling copy and developing creative with our gifting agency and creative teams. You lean heavily on existing playbooks and tactics rather than stepping back and thinking from first principles. A lot of how we market at Ashby is deliberately different; curiosity and adaptability are critical. You aren't able to operate with autonomy and run strategies end-to-end. We give clear ownership and trust you with it; you should be proactive and resourceful. You believe that EMEA is one homogeneous market Interview Plan At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via project working sessions. Our interview process is five rounds: 30-minute intro call with Michelle (Recruiting). 45-minute interview with Harriet (Hiring Manager). 45-minute interview with Ben (US lead on ABM). A take-home assignment, which you’ll have 40 mins to discuss with the hiring team. A virtual on-site of 1.5 hours with a panel of interviewers. Nhi (Strategic Projects Lead) Casper (Head of ENT Sales, EMEA) Antonio (AI & Automations Lead, Demand Gen) Benefits Competitive salary and equity. Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team. 10-year exercise window for stock options . Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply. Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. items.description: About Securly Securly is the K-12 market leader in AI-powered student safety and wellness solutions, protecting more than 20 million students across 20,000+ schools. Our mission is to create safer, more supportive learning environments by detecting potential harm, supporting student mental health, and empowering educators with actionable insights that help students thrive. By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support — driving measurable improvements in safety and wellbeing. We're proud to be recognized as a Top Place to Work , named to TIME's America's Top EdTech Companies 2026 list, a Top 40 Most Used EdTech , and one of the 150 most transformational growth companies. The Role Securly is looking for a Director, Customer Success Operations to lead the systems, processes, and people behind our entire post-sale customer journey. You'll lead our CS Ops and Renewals function - a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and a team of Renewals Specialists - and own Vitally, our Customer Success platform, as the operational backbone of the business. This is a builder's role. Vitally has been live for about a year, and the next chapter is yours to write: deepening adoption, sharpening health scoring, automating renewals workflows, and turning good instincts into a repeatable, data-driven system that scales. You'll be the operational thought partner to CS executives - using data and process design to make sure customer growth and success directly fuel Securly's growth. Location: Remote (U.S.) Type: Full-Time, Exempt Reports to: SVP, Customer Success What Success Looks Like In your first 90 days, you'll get under the hood - auditing our Vitally configuration, current CS Ops and renewals workflows, and team structure. You'll build real relationships with your team and ship your first wave of improvements: sharper health scoring, better dashboards, and a more programmatic renewals process. By 6 months, you're driving measurable gains - better renewals efficiency, stronger forecast accuracy, and dashboards that CS and company leadership actually rely on to run the business. By your first year, you own a mature CS Ops and Renewals function that consistently meets or exceeds retention targets, backed by a trained, accountable team and a Vitally instance that scales with Securly's growth. What You'll Do Lead the team Hire, coach, and manage a team of a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and Renewals Specialists - setting clear goals and holding the team accountable to them Structure team capacity and coverage to match renewal volume and customer segmentation Build a real growth path for your team, from onboarding through career development Own the process Design, implement, and continuously refine scalable playbooks that support the entire post-sale customer journey Own the end-to-end renewal process - timely, accurate, and built to minimize churn Design and run a programmatic renewals process suited to a high-volume, complex customer base Turn data into decisions Own customer health scoring, tracking, and measurement across the install base Define and build the dashboards CS and executive leadership use to manage the business Surface customer insights to Product, Support, and Sales to drive real improvements Build the tech stack Serve as the internal owner of Vitally - driving adoption, configuration, and continuous optimization Identify, build, and implement Agentic AI and automation that genuinely moves the needle on CS Ops and renewals outcomes Manage the broader tech stack, including integrations with Salesforce and other GTM systems What We're Looking For 3+ years leading a Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, or Renewals team - this is a leadership track record, not an individual-contributor background, with proven experience scaling CS tools, systems, and AI Real examples of scaling a CS Ops function - taking a team, process, or system from early-stage to measurably better performance, with strong examples of building tools, systems, and process, and applying AI Hands-on experience building tech, systems, and automation - you've architected workflows, integrations, or automation inside a CS platform (Vitally, Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce or HubSpot, not just used tools someone else set up Applied experience with Agentic AI and automation - you've actually built or implemented AI-driven workflows (like automated health scoring or renewals triage), not just explored the space A track record of building and coaching a team, with strong data analytics skills and fluency in core SaaS metrics (GRR, NRR, churn, CLV, NPS, CSAT) Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple cross-functional initiatives at once Experience in K-12, EdTech, or education-adjacent SaaS is a strong plus Why You'll Love Working at Securly Meaningful impact - build the operational engine behind a company that helps protect millions of students People-first culture - consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work Remote-first flexibility - work from home with a supportive, distributed team Real ownership - shape a growing platform and team, not maintain someone else's system Mission-driven work - what you build directly supports student safety and wellbeing Benefits & Perks Competitive salary up to $165K with performance incentives Medical, dental, and vision coverage 401(k) with employer match 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave Unlimited PTO, paid holidays, and a paid one-week year-end shutdown $1,000 annual professional development stipend Free mental health resources and Employee Assistance Program Equal Opportunity Employer Securly is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process - just let us know at recruitment.us@securly.com #LI-Remote #LI-DO1

items.title: Business Operations Manager
items.summary: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s. 3. Product Rollout Support Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Deputy Chief of Staff – Research & Growth
items.summary: About Offshore LaunchOffshore Launch is a staffing agency that specializes in helping small business owners scale their operations with the top 1% of global remote talent.
items.description: About Offshore Launch Offshore Launch is a staffing agency that specializes in helping small business owners scale their operations with the top 1% of global remote talent. We are a people-centered agency with a passion for leaving every person and business in a better position than we found them. Why Join Offshore Launch ? Impact the growth and success of small and medium-sized businesses. Work in a people-first, remote environment that values growth and ongoing development. Access comprehensive benefits that include HMO, PTO, professional development, and an overall emphasis on teamwork and collaboration. Contribute to a culture that values partnership, service, and excellence. Your Role As an employee of Offshore Launch , you are being hired for a unique role within a target Client’s company. We value long-term partnerships, and seek to recruit talent that will serve an individual Client’s business for multiple years. You will work full-time with the Client company. However, the Agency provides ongoing support to ensure your continued success. As such, we create space for ongoing check-ins, feedback and development through: Membership in the Offshore Launch Slack workspace Bi-weekly All Team meetings Monthly reviews Your job is to help the Client succeed. Our job is to help you succeed. About the Client This is a high-ownership role, not a support or admin function. You'll set the standard for how research gets structured, prioritized, and delivered across a multi-client portfolio, working with significant autonomy and direct visibility into how your work shapes client outcomes. Responsibilities Serve as the founder's strategic partner across multiple concurrent client engagements — bringing structure, prioritization, and follow-through to a fast-moving, multi-account portfolio Lead market and competitive intelligence research (e.g., mapping vendor ecosystems, ranking competitors in fragmented markets), with full citations and transparent sourcing Drive synthesis, not just data collection — translate research into clear patterns, trends, and "must-have" recommendations that leadership can act on immediately Own pipeline-building efforts: source executive and decision-maker contacts (LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, or equivalent) and draft personalized, research-backed outreach Prepare sales and discovery materials — pre-answering key questions ahead of client meetings using public intelligence, and flagging strategic positioning insights Build and manage project plans and Gantt charts (Monday.com or comparable) spanning phases, milestones, dependencies, timelines, risks, and KPIs — built for leadership visibility at a glance Produce polished competitive teardowns and comparison materials (positioning, differentiators, target verticals, UX walkthroughs, comparison tables) ready for executive and client-facing use Bring order and continuity across unrelated client accounts and industries, adapting tone and depth to each without dropping rigor Requirements Must-have 3+ years in a Chief of Staff, strategic research, competitive intelligence, or senior business/sales analysis role — ideally supporting a founder, executive, or multi-client portfolio Strong business English writing; able to independently produce structured, citation-backed, executive-ready reports Demonstrated experience sourcing executive/decision-maker contacts (LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, or equivalent) Comfortable drafting personalized outreach/cold emails as part of a research or business development deliverable Working knowledge of Monday.com or a comparable PM tool (Asana, Smartsheet) for Gantt charts and KPI dashboards Track record of multi-source verification and transparent sourcing/citation practices High discernment and tenacity — able to operate with minimal oversight and context-switch cleanly across multiple, unrelated client accounts Nice-to-have Prior exposure to legal tech, insurtech, investigations, or litigation consulting sectors Familiarity with luxury travel, ground transportation, or corporate meetings & events Experience directly supporting sales/BD teams (SDR/BDR-adjacent research background Compensation & Benefits (to be provided by Offshore Launch ) Up to $1800, depending on experience 13th month pay Performance-based bonuses up to 150% of one month's salary Comprehensive HMO policy, including dependents. Annual continuing education budget to support professional development Note The Client is not involved in compensation or benefits. As an employee of Offshore Launch , all compensation and benefits are to be provided by the Agency. Please note that we anticipate a response from candidates within 24 hours of our outreach. If we do not receive a reply within this timeframe, we will assume that you are no longer interested in pursuing this opportunity. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: TA Analytics Specialist
items.summary: OverviewWe are seeking a highly organized and analytical Talent Acquisition Analytics Specialist to optimize and support recruitment operations across the organization.
items.description: Overview We are seeking a highly organized and analytical Talent Acquisition Analytics Specialist to optimize and support recruitment operations across the organization. Talent Acquisition Analytics Specialist will bridge the gap between raw recruitment data and hiring decisions. The ideal candidate will extract, analyze, and visualize hiring metrics to help Cotiviti optimize their recruitment processes, reduce costs, and hire top talent efficiently & will also serve as a partner to Talent Acquisition and business stakeholders by driving process excellence, recruitment technology optimization, reporting, compliance, and operational efficiency throughout the hiring lifecycle. Responsibilities Data Analytics & Reporting Develop and maintain recruitment dashboards and hiring metrics. Analyze key TA performance indicators, including: Time-to-fill Time-to-hire Cost-per-hire Source effectiveness Offer acceptance rates Recruiter productivity Diversity hiring metrics Synthesizing complex data into actionable presentations and executive-ready reports for leadership and hiring managers. Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly hiring reports. Recruitment Technology & Systems Serve as a primary administrator for ATS and recruiting technologies. Configure workflows, approval processes, templates, dashboards, and integrations. Partner with HRIS, IT, and vendors to resolve system issues and implement enhancements. Evaluate and recommend new recruiting tools and automation opportunities. Stakeholder & Vendor Management Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, HR business partners, and leadership teams. Supports relationships with recruitment agencies, job boards, assessment providers, and recruiting technology vendors. Monitor vendor performance and ensure service-level expectations are met. Talent Acquisition Operations Support and optimize end-to-end recruitment operations and hiring workflows. Ensure consistency, efficiency, and compliance across all recruiting processes. Identify process improvement opportunities and implement scalable solutions. Develop and maintain recruitment SOPs, playbooks, and operational guidelines. Support workforce planning and hiring demand forecasting initiatives. Data Hygiene & Auditing: Auditing recruitment data across Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) to ensure data accuracy and compliance. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field. 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Reporting & Dashboards. Advanced proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, and reporting tools. Experience creating dashboards and analyzing recruitment data. Understands Talent Acquisition Operations, HR Operations, or related functions. Strong experience administering ATS platforms such as Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, Taleo, or SuccessFactors. Strong project management and process improvement skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior PPC Specialist
items.summary: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms.
items.description: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that successful paid media isn't just about launching campaigns; it's about maximizing profitability. You'll be responsible for optimizing the entire acquisition funnel, analyzing campaign performance, improving conversion rates, and making strategic decisions that drive sustainable growth. The ideal candidate is analytical, data-driven, and comfortable balancing campaign execution with performance strategy. Requirements Key Responsibilities Plan, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other advertising platforms. Monitor and improve key performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, Conversion Rate, and LTV. Identify profitability issues and optimize the entire conversion funnel. Conduct A/B testing for audiences, creatives, landing pages, and offers. Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights through dashboards and reports. Manage advertising budgets and scale high-performing campaigns. Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to improve campaign results. Implement and maintain tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advertising platforms. Stay up to date with industry trends, AI tools, and platform updates. Requirements Resume in English. Native or near-native English proficiency (spoken and written). 4+ years of experience managing Meta and Google Ads campaigns. Proven experience optimizing campaigns based on ROAS, CPA, CAC, and profitability. Strong understanding of conversion funnels and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards. Experience managing six-figure monthly advertising budgets is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with eCommerce, SaaS, Lead Generation, or Performance Marketing campaigns. Ability to translate data into actionable optimization strategies. By applying to this position, we'll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match. items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! Originally posted on Himalayas

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! Job Description: This job is responsible for capturing and refining business or system requirements that may involve a software change. Key responsibilities include working with stakeholders to understand their needs, analyzing problems, capturing requirements, creating solutions, solving problems either manually or through software, and providing subject-matter expertise on products to support scope and requirement decisions. Job expectations include collaborating with project stakeholders to analyze and confirm requirements, creating, analyzing, and improving processes and writing user and technical stories. This job is responsible for supporting centralized intake management, demand forecasting, resource management, and executive communications activities for a Data Management organization within Global Technology. Key responsibilities include managing engagement intake processes, assessing demand, forecasting resource and funding requirements, monitoring portfolio performance, and developing executive reporting and governance materials that support strategic decision-making. The role drives continuous improvement through the development of cost efficiency metrics, optimization tracking, and performance insights that enable leadership to make informed investment, prioritization, and workforce planning decisions. Job expectations include partnering across business and technology teams to coordinate potential engagements, manage planning and forecasting processes, monitor risks and dependencies, track the realization of optimization benefits, and provide clear, data-driven communications to senior leadership. Responsibilities: Understands stakeholder needs to help envision and create a solution to solve a problem Supports cost and benefit analysis to align technology solutions to business strategy Gathers and catalogs functional, non-functional, and technical requirements for stakeholder requests Identifies the impact of modifications and enhancements to applications and assists with identifying integration points and the end-to-end solution design Assists users and development teams in application testing and troubleshooting, and may help with test planning and configuring test solutions to validate functional and system needs Documents processes, procedures and workflows for technology as needed Manage engagement intake and portfolio planning activities, partnering with stakeholders to assess demand, prioritize work, align resources, and ensure delivery commitments support strategic business objectives. Create and deliver executive communications, reporting, governance materials, and insights that provide transparency into delivery health, financial performance, resource utilization, risks, dependencies, optimization outcomes, and strategic priorities, enabling informed decision-making by senior leadership. items.title: ROBOT PILOT - Customer Service at Keywords Studios - Montréal
items.summary: At Keywords Studios, we bring together people, technology, and expertise to support some of the world’s leading companies in the video games and interactive entertainment industries. Our global teams work across a wide range of services, helping our clients deliver high-quality experiences to their customers and players. For this role, you’ll be jo
items.description: At Keywords Studios, we bring together people, technology, and expertise to support some of the world’s leading companies in the video games and interactive entertainment industries. Our global teams work across a wide range of services, helping our clients deliver high-quality experiences to their customers and players. For this role, you’ll be joining a team in the robotics field , helping ensure the reliable performance of robotic arms deployed at client sites. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, real-time monitoring, and customer support, while gaining experience in an evolving and highly technical environment. If you’re naturally curious, enjoy troubleshooting and are comfortable keeping a close eye on systems and details, we’d love to hear from you! Role overview We’re looking for Remote Robot Pilots - Customer Service to monitor the performance and system health of robotic arms deployed at client sites , identify anomalies or issues, investigate problems, and apply known solutions where possible. You’ll also document and escalate unresolved issues, communicate with internal teams and occasionally with clients on-site, and help maintain continuity across shifts through clear updates and documentation. This fully remote role combines technical observation with clear communication, helping ensure issues are spotted and addressed quickly. Key responsibilities: Monitoring & Support Actively monitor robot performance and system health through internal dashboards and monitoring tools. Detect anomalies, errors, or performance concerns through observation or automated alerts. Investigate issues, apply known solutions, and attempt resolution where possible. Document and escalate unresolved issues based on established workflows. Communication Stay in sync with teammates across shifts by sharing timely updates and status changes in Slack. Work with internal escalation teams when issues require further investigation or support. Communicate clearly about what is happening and what needs to be done. Take occasional calls from the clients owning and operating the robots on-site. Analytics Accurately document incidents, including symptoms, actions taken, and resolution outcomes. Maintain continuity across shifts through effective written updates and documentation. Evaluate and escalate external questions or concerns related to robot behavior or system status. Requirements Strong communication and listening skills; ability to clearly explain what’s happening and what needs to be done. Observant, detail-oriented, and able to stay focused during repetitive tasks. Technically curious — you don’t need to be an engineer, but you are comfortable using internal tools and asking good questions. Calm under pressure, especially when things break. Comfortable working independently and as part of a team, including across shifts. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving ability. Willingness to work rotational shifts. Comfortable using Slack and learning internal monitoring systems. Prior experience in a support, monitoring, or gaming environment is a plus. Operations run 24 ⁄ 7 , so you can expect rotating shifts (morning, afternoon, and night). -$10,500 gross (before taxes) -Law Benefits -2 days off After 3 months: Medical expenses insurance. Saving funds. Grocery tickets ($1,200) PRIVACY POLICY: By providing your information in this application, you understand that we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information, please see our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://www.keywordsstudios.com/en/applicant-privacy-notice. Role Information: EN Studio: Keywords Studios Location: Americas, Mexico Area of Work: Player Engagement Service: Engage Employment Type: Permanent Working Pattern: Full Time, Remote
